tools: one type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice

classFeatures.name: Incantation
entries: Vous avez appris à canaliser l'énergie magique à travers les objets. Consultez le Manuel du joueur pour connaître les règles relatives aux sorts. Les informations ci-dessous détaillent comment appliquer ces règles aux sorts d'Artificier, qui figurent dans la liste des sorts d'Artificier plus loin dans la description de la classe.

entries.name: Outils requis
entries: Vous produisez vos sorts d'Artificier à l'aide d'outils. Vous pouvez utiliser des outils de voleur , des outils de bricoleur ou tout autre type d' outils d'artisan que vous maîtrisez comme focalisateur de sorts , et vous devez avoir l'un de ces focalisateurs en main lorsque vous lancez un sort d'Artificier (ce qui signifie que le sort a une composante magique lorsque vous le lancez).

entries.name: Sorts mineurs
entries:
Vous connaissez deux sorts mineurs d'Artificier de votre choix. {@spell Aspertion d'acide} et {@spell Prestidigitation} sont recommandés.

Lorsque vous terminez un repos long , vous pouvez remplacer l'un de vos sorts mineurs de cette capacité par un autre sort mineur d'artificier de votre choix.

Lorsque vous atteignez les niveaux 10 et 14 d'Artificier, vous apprenez un autre sort mineur d'Artificier de votre choix, comme indiqué dans la colonne Sorts mineurs du tableau des caractéristiques d'Artificier.

entries.name: Emplacements de sorts
entries: Le tableau des aptitudes d'artificier indique le nombre d'emplacements de sorts dont vous disposez pour lancer vos sorts de niveau 1 et plus. Vous récupérez tous vos emplacements dépensés après un repos long .

entries.name: Sorts préparés de niveau 1 et plus
entries: Vous préparez la liste des sorts de niveau 1 et plus que vous pouvez lancer grâce à cette capacité. Pour commencer, choisissez deuxd' Artificier de niveau 1. {@spell Soins} et {@spell Graisse} sont recommandés.

Le nombre de sorts de votre liste augmente à mesure que vous gagnez des niveaux d'Artificier, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Sorts préparés » du tableau des aptitudes d'Artificier. À chaque augmentation de ce nombre, choisissez des sorts d'Artificier supplémentaires jusqu'à ce que votre liste en contienne autant que celle du tableau. Les sorts choisis doivent être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts. Par exemple, si vous êtes un Artificier de niveau 5, votre liste de sorts préparés peut inclure six sorts d'Artificier de niveaux 1 et 2, dans n'importe quelle combinaison.

Si une autre capacité d'Artificier vous donne des sorts que vous avez toujours préparés, ceux-ci ne sont pas comptabilisés dans le nombre de sorts que vous pouvez préparer avec cette capacité, mais ces sorts sont par ailleurs considérés comme des sorts d'Artificier pour vous.

entries.name: Modification de vos sorts préparés
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un repos long , vous pouvez modifier votre liste de sorts préparés, en remplaçant n'importe quel sort par d'autres sorts d'artificier pour lesquels vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts.

entries.name: Capacité d'incantation
entries: L'intelligence est votre capacité d'incantation pour vos sorts d'artificier.

classFeatures.name: La magie du bricoleur
entries: Vous connaissez le sort mineur {@spell Réparation}.

En tant qu'action magique , lorsque vous tenez des outils de bricoleur , vous pouvez créer un objet dans un espace inoccupé situé à moins de 1,5 mètre de vous, en choisissant l'objet dans la liste suivante :

Consultez les règles de l'objet dans le Manuel du joueur . L'objet dure jusqu'à ce que vous ayez terminé un repos long , après quoi il disparaît.

Vous pouvez utiliser cette capacité un nombre de fois égal à votre modificateur d'Intelligence (minimum d'une fois), et vous récupérez toutes les utilisations dépensées lorsque vous terminez un repos long .

classFeatures.name: Répliquer un objet magique
entries: Vous avez appris des plans ésotériques que vous utilisez pour fabriquer des objets magiques.

Lorsque vous obtenez cette capacité, choisissez quatre plans à apprendre dans le tableau des plans d'objets magiques (niveau d'Artificier 2 et plus) (consultez le Guide du Maître pour la description des objets). Le Sac sans fond , le Casque de respiration aquatique , les Pierres de communication et la Baguette du Mage de guerre sont recommandés. À chaque niveau d'Artificier gagné, vous pouvez remplacer l'un des plans que vous connaissez par un nouveau plan pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises.

Vous apprenez un autre plan de votre choix lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux d'Artificier, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Plans connus » du tableau des Capacités d'Artificier. Lorsque vous choisissez un plan à apprendre, vous le sélectionnez dans n'importe quel tableau de Plans d'objets magiques auquel vous avez accès ; votre accès dépend de votre niveau d'Artificier.
entries.name: Plans connus
Création d'un objet
entries: Après un repos long , vous pouvez créer un ou deux objets magiques différents si vous possédez des outils de bricoleur . Chaque objet est basé sur l'un des plans que vous connaissez pour cette capacité.

Si un objet créé requiert une harmonisation , vous pouvez vous y harmoniser dès sa création. Si vous décidez de vous y harmoniser ultérieurement, vous devrez suivre la procédure d' harmonisation habituelle .

Lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux d'Artificier, indiqués dans la colonne Objets magiques du tableau des Capacités d'Artificier, le nombre d'objets magiques que vous pouvez créer à la fin d'un repos long augmente. Chaque objet créé doit être basé sur un plan différent que vous connaissez.

Vous ne pouvez pas posséder plus d'objets magiques grâce à cette capacité que le nombre indiqué dans la colonne « Objets magiques » du tableau des capacités d'artificier correspondant à votre niveau. Si vous tentez de dépasser ce nombre maximal, l'objet le plus ancien disparaît et est remplacé par un nouvel objet.

entries.name: Durée
entries: Un objet magique créé par cette capacité fonctionne comme un objet magique normal, à ceci près que sa magie n'est pas permanente ; à votre mort, l'objet magique disparaît après 1d4 jours. Si vous remplacez un plan que vous connaissez par un nouveau plan, tout objet magique créé avec ce nouveau plan disparaît immédiatement.
Si un objet que vous avez créé avec cette fonctionnalité est un conteneur, comme un sac sans fond , et qu'il disparaît, son contenu apparaît sans danger dans et autour de son emplacement.

entries.name: Focalisation de sorts
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser n'importe quelle baguette ou arme créée par cette fonctionnalité comme focalisateur de sorts au lieu d'utiliser un ensemble d' outils d'artisan .

entries.name: Fabriquer plus d'objets magiques
entries: La capacité « Réplique d'objet magique » n'est pas la seule façon pour un artificier de créer des objets magiques. Le Guide du Maître du Donjon propose des règles pour les personnages — et pas seulement les artificiers — qui souhaitent fabriquer des objets magiques de toutes sortes. Bien que de nombreux personnages puissent créer des objets magiques, les artificiers sont plus rapides ; chaque sous-classe d'artificier améliore la vitesse de fabrication d'objets d'une catégorie spécifique.

Lorsqu'un Artificier crée un objet magique en suivant les règles normales du Guide du Maître , le personnage ne développe aucun lien particulier avec cet objet. Les capacités de classe qui font référence aux objets créés par le pouvoir « Réplique d'objet magique » ne s'appliquent pas aux objets créés par d'autres moyens.

entries.caption: Plans d'objets magiques (Artificier niveau 2+)
rows: Objet magique courant qui n'est ni une potion, ni un parchemin, ni un objet maudit *
Enveloppements de puissance à mains nues, +1

entries: *Vous pouvez découvrir cette option plusieurs fois et devez sélectionner un élément différent à chaque fois ; chaque élément sélectionné compte comme un plan différent.

entries.caption: Plans d'objets magiques (Artificier niveau 10+)
rows: Objet merveilleux rare qui n'est pas maudit *
Enveloppements de puissance à mains nues, +2

entries: *Vous pouvez découvrir cette option plusieurs fois et devez sélectionner un élément différent à chaque fois ; chaque élément sélectionné compte comme un plan différent.

entries.caption: Plans d'objets magiques (Artificier niveau 14+)
rows: Objet merveilleux peu commun qui n'est pas maudit *

entries: *Vous pouvez découvrir cette option plusieurs fois et devez sélectionner un élément différent à chaque fois ; chaque élément sélectionné compte comme un plan différent.

classFeatures.name: Sous-classe d'Artificier
entries: Vous obtenez une sous-classe d'Artificier de votre choix. Les sous-classes d'Alchimiste , d'Armurier , d'Artilleur , de Forgeron de Guerre et de Cartographe sont détaillées après la description de cette classe. Une sous-classe est une spécialisation qui vous octroie des capacités à certains niveaux d'Artificier. Durant toute votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de toutes les capacités de votre sous-classe correspondant à votre niveau d'Artificier ou à un niveau inférieur.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition. Vous recevez de nouveau cette aptitude aux niveau d'Artificier 8, 12, and 16.

classFeatures.name: Fonctionnalité de sous-classe
entries: Vous obtenez une capacité de votre sous-classe d'Artificier.

classFeatures.name: Bricoleur d'objets magiques
entries: Votre fonctionnalité Réplique d'objet magique bénéficie des options suivantes.

Par une action bonus , vous pouvez toucher un objet magique à moins de 1,5 mètre de vous, créé par le sort Réplication d'objet magique et utilisant des charges. Vous dépensez un emplacement de sort de niveau 1 ou plus pour recharger l'objet. Le nombre de charges récupérées est égal au niveau de l'emplacement de sort dépensé.
entries.name: Recharge d'objet magique
Drain d'objet magique
entries: Par une action bonus , vous pouvez toucher un objet magique situé à moins de 1,5 mètre de vous, créé grâce au sort Réplication d'objet magique, et le faire disparaître, convertissant son énergie magique en un emplacement de sort. Cet emplacement est de niveau 1 si l'objet est commun, ou de niveau 2 s'il est peu commun ou rare. Une fois ce pouvoir utilisé, vous ne pouvez plus l'utiliser avant d'avoir terminé un repos long . Tout emplacement de sort créé grâce à ce pouvoir disparaît après un repos long .

entries.name: Transmutation d'objet magique
entries: Par une action magique , vous pouvez toucher un objet magique situé à moins de 1,5 mètre de vous, créé grâce au sort Réplication d'objet magique, et le transformer en un autre objet magique. L'objet résultant doit être basé sur un plan d'objet magique que vous connaissez. Une fois ce pouvoir utilisé, vous ne pouvez plus l'utiliser avant d'avoir terminé un repos long .

classFeatures.name: Éclair de génie
entries: Lorsqu'un ennemi (vous ou une créature visible à moins de 9 mètres) rate un test de caractéristique ou un jet de sauvegarde, vous pouvez utiliser une réaction pour ajouter un bonus au jet, ce qui peut potentiellement le faire réussir. Ce bonus est égal à votre modificateur d'Intelligence (minimum +1).
Vous pouvez utiliser cette réaction un nombre de fois égal à votre modificateur d'Intelligence (minimum une fois). Vous récupérez toutes vos utilisations après un repos long .

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Fonctionnalité de sous-classe
entries: Vous obtenez une capacité de votre sous-classe d'Artificier.

classFeatures.name: Expert en objets magiques
entries: Vous pouvez désormais vous connecter à un maximum de quatre objets magiques simultanément.

classFeatures.name: Objet de stockage de sorts
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un repos long , vous pouvez toucher une arme simple ou martiale ou un objet que vous pouvez utiliser comme focalisateur de sorts , et vous y stockez un sort, en choisissant un sort d'artificier de niveau 1, 2 ou 3 dont le temps d'incantation est d'une action et qui ne nécessite pas de composante matérielle consommée par le sort (vous n'avez pas besoin d'avoir préparé le sort).

En tenant l'objet, une créature peut utiliser une action magique pour produire l'effet du sort, en utilisant son modificateur de caractéristique d'incantation. Si le sort requiert de la concentration , la créature doit se concentrer. Une fois l'objet utilisé pour produire l'effet du sort, la créature ne peut plus l'utiliser de cette manière jusqu'au début de son prochain tour.

Le sort reste dans l'objet jusqu'à ce qu'il ait été utilisé un nombre de fois égal à deux fois votre modificateur d'Intelligence (minimum de deux fois) ou jusqu'à ce que vous utilisiez à nouveau cette capacité pour stocker un sort dans un objet.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Artifice avancé
entries: Vous bénéficiez des avantages suivants.
Vous pouvez désormais vous harmoniser avec jusqu'à cinq objets magiques simultanément.
entries.name: Expert en objets magiques
Génie renouvelé
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un court repos , vous récupérez une utilisation dépensée de votre capacité Éclair de génie .

classFeatures.name: Fonctionnalité de sous-classe
entries: Vous obtenez une capacité de votre sous-classe d'Artificier.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Maître des objets magiques
entries: Vous pouvez désormais vous connecter à six objets magiques simultanément.

classFeatures.name: Bénédiction épique
entries: Vous obtenez un don de {@filter Don épique feat|feats|category=EB} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html}de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises. Le {@feat Don de résistance à l'énergie|XPHB} est recommandé.

classFeatures.name: Âme de l'Artifice
entries: Vous avez développé un lien mystique avec vos objets magiques, auquel vous pouvez faire appel pour obtenir de l'aide. Vous bénéficiez des avantages suivants.

Si vos points de vie tombent à 0mais que vous ne mourez pas sur le coup, vous pouvez désintégrer autant d'objets magiques peu communs ou rares que vous le souhaitez, créés grâce à votre capacité Réplique d'objet magique. Dans ce cas, vos points de vie sont remplacés par un nombre égal à 20 fois le nombre d'objets magiques désintégrés.
entries.name: Trompez la mort
Guidance magique
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un court repos , vous récupérez toutes les utilisations dépensées de votre Éclair de génie si vous avez l'Affinité avec au moins un objet magique.

subclassFeatures.name: Alchemist
entries: {@i Craft Magic Elixirs and Potions}
An Alchemist is an expert at combining reagents to produce magical effects. Alchemists use their creations to give life and to leech it away.

subclassFeatures.name: Alchemist Spells
entries: When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Alchemist Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeatures.name: Experimental Elixir
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while holding {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, you can use that tool to magically produce two elixirs. For each elixir, roll on the Experimental Elixir table for the elixir's effect, which is triggered when someone drinks the elixir. The elixir appears in a vial, and the vial vanishes when the elixir is drunk or poured out. If any elixir remains when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, the elixir and its vial vanish.

entries.name: Drinking an Elixir
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, a creature can drink the elixir or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of itself.

entries.name: Creating Additional Elixirs
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while holding {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, you can expend one spell slot to create another elixir. When you do so, you choose its effect from the Experimental Elixir table rather than rolling.
When you reach certain Artificer levels, you can make an additional elixir at the end of each {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}: a total of three at level 5, four at level 9, and five at level 15.

entries.caption: Experimental Elixir
rows: {@b Healing.} The drinker regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Intelligence modifier. The number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach Artificer levels 9 ({@dice 3d8}) and 15 ({@dice 4d8}).
{@b Swiftness.} The drinker's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet for 1 hour. This bonus increases when you reach Artificer levels 9 (15 feet) and 15 (20 feet).
{@b Resilience.} The drinker gains a +1 bonus to AC for 10 minutes. The duration increases when you reach Artificer levels 9 (1 hour) and 15 (8 hours).

{@b Boldness.} The drinker can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to every attack roll and saving throw they make for the next minute. The duration increases when you reach Artificer levels 9 (10 minutes) and 15 (1 hour).
{@b Flight.} The drinker gains a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 10 feet for 10 minutes. The {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} increases when you reach Artificer levels 9 (20 feet) and 15 (30 feet).
You determine the elixir's effect by choosing one of the other rows in this table.

subclassFeatures.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB} and the {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}. If you already have one of these proficiencies, you gain proficiency with one other type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice (or with two other types if you have both).

entries.name: Potion Crafting
entries: When you brew a potion using the crafting rules in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG|6|Crafting Magic Items}, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.

subclassFeatures.name: Alchemical Savant
entries: Whenever you cast a spell using your {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB} as the {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you gain a bonus to one roll of the spell. That roll must restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or be a damage roll that deals Acid, Fire, or Poison damage. The bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

subclassFeatures.name: Restorative Reagents
entries: You can cast {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} without expending a spell slot and without preparing the spell, provided you use {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB} as the {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}. You can do so a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Chemical Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Alchemical Eruption
entries: When you cast an Artificer spell that deals Acid, Fire, or Poison damage to a target, you can also deal {@damage 2d8} Force damage to that target. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

entries.name: Chemical Resistance
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid damage and Poison damage. You also gain {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Conjured Cauldron
entries: You can cast {@spell Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron|XPHB} without expending a spell slot, without preparing the spell, and without Material components, provided you use {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB} as the {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Armor
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while you have {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} in hand, you can turn a suit of armor you are wearing into Arcane Armor. The armor continues to be Arcane Armor until you don another suit of armor or you die.
You gain the following benefits while wearing your Arcane Armor.

entries.name: No Strength Requirement
entries: If the armor normally has a Strength requirement, the Arcane Armor lacks this requirement for you.

entries.name: Quick Don and Doff
entries: You can don or doff the armor as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. The armor can't be removed against your will.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use the Arcane Armor as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Artificer spells.

subclassFeatures.name: Armor Model
entries: You can customize your Arcane Armor. When you do so, choose one of the following armor models: {@subclassFeature Dreadnaught|Artificer|EFA|Armorer|EFA|3|EFA}, {@subclassFeature Guardian|Artificer|EFA|Armorer|EFA|3|EFA}, or {@subclassFeature Infiltrator|Artificer|EFA|Armorer|EFA|3|EFA}. The model you choose gives you special benefits while you wear it.
Each model includes a special weapon. When you attack with that weapon, you can add your Intelligence modifier, instead of your Strength or Dexterity modifier, to the attack and damage rolls.
You can change the armor's model whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} if you have {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} in hand.

subclassFeatures.name: Armorer
entries: {@i Craft Magic Armor to Enhance Your Abilities}
An Armorer modifies armor to function almost like a second skin. The armor is enhanced to hone the Armorer's magic, unleash potent attacks, and generate a formidable defense.

subclassFeatures.name: Armorer Spells
entries: When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Armorer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeatures.name: Dreadnaught
entries: You design your armor to become a towering juggernaut in battle. It has the following features:

items.name: Force Demolisher
entries: An arcane wrecking ball or sledgehammer projects from your armor. The demolisher counts as a Simple Melee weapon with the {@itemProperty R|XPHB|Reach} property, and it deals {@damage 1d10} Force damage on a hit. If you hit a creature that is at least one size smaller than you with the demolisher, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself or pull the creature up to 10 feet toward yourself.

items.name: Giant Stature
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you transform and enlarge your armor for 1 minute. For the duration, your reach increases by 5 feet, and if you are smaller than Large, you become Large, along with anything you are wearing. If there isn't enough room for you to increase your size, your size doesn't change. You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Guardian
entries: You design your armor to be in the front line of conflict. It has the following features:

entries.name: Thunder Pulse
entries: You can discharge concussive blasts with strikes from your armor. The pulse counts as a Simple Melee weapon and deals {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage on a hit. A creature hit by the pulse has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against targets other than you until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Defensive Field
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Artificer level. You lose these {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} if you doff the armor.

subclassFeatures.name: Infiltrator
entries: You customize your armor for subtler undertakings. It has the following features:

items.name: Lightning Launcher
entries: A gemlike node appears on your armor, from which you can shoot bolts of lightning. The launcher counts as a Simple Ranged weapon with a normal range of 90 feet and a long range of 300 feet, and it deals {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with the launcher, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage to that target.

items.name: Powered Steps
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet.

items.name: Dampening Field
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks. If the armor imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on such checks, the {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} cancel each other, as normal.

subclassFeatures.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armor Training
entries: You gain training with Heavy armor.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}. If you already have this tool proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice.

entries.name: Armor Crafting
entries: When you craft nonmagical or magic armor, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.

subclassFeatures.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Improved Armorer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armor Replication
entries: You learn an additional plan for your Replicate Magic Item feature, and it must be in the Armor category. If you replace that plan, you must replace it with another Armor plan.
In addition, you can create an additional item with that feature, and the item must also be in the Armor category.

entries.name: Improved Arsenal
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the special weapon of your Arcane Armor model.

subclassFeatures.name: Perfected Armor
entries: Your Arcane Armor gains additional benefits based on its model, as detailed below.

entries.name: Dreadnaught
entries: The damage die of your Force Demolisher increases to {@damage 2d6} Force damage.

In addition, when you use your Giant Stature, your reach increases by 10 feet, your size can increase to Large or Huge (your choice), and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws for the duration.

entries.name: Guardian
entries: The damage die of your Thunder Pulse increases to {@damage 1d10} Thunder damage.

In addition, when a Huge or smaller creature you can see ends its turn within 30 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to magically force that creature to make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, you pull the creature up to 25 feet directly toward you to an unoccupied space. If you pull the target to a space within 5 feet of yourself, you can make a melee weapon attack against it as part of this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

You can take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Infiltrator
entries: The damage die of your Lightning Launcher increases to {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage. Any creature that takes Lightning damage from your Lightning Launcher glimmers with magical light until the start of your next turn. The glimmering creature sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you, as the light jolts it if it attacks you.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to twice your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} until the end of the current turn. You can take this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Artillerist
entries: {@i Wield Destructive Power from Afar}
An Artillerist specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions on a battlefield.

subclassFeatures.name: Artillerist Spells
entries: When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Artillerist Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Artillerist Spells
rows: {@spell Cone of Cold|XPHB}, {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}

subclassFeatures.name: Eldritch Cannon
entries: Using {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} or {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB}, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a Small or Tiny {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA} in an unoccupied space on a horizontal surface within 5 feet of yourself. You determine its appearance, including whether you carry it or not (and your choice of legs or wheels, for the latter). It disappears if it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or after 1 hour. You can dismiss it early as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

Once you create a cannon, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or expend a spell slot to create one. You can have only one cannon at a time and can't create one while you already have one.

subclassFeatures.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ranged Weaponry
entries: You gain proficiency with {@filter Martial Ranged weapons|items|type=martial weapon;ranged weapon=sand}.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB}. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice.

entries.name: Wand Crafting
entries: When you craft a magic {@item Wand|XPHB}, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Firearm
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can use {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB} to carve special sigils into a {@item Rod|XPHB}, {@item Staff|XPHB}, {@item Wand|XPHB}, or {@filter Martial Ranged weapon|items|type=martial weapon;ranged weapon=sand} and thereby turn it into your Arcane Firearm. The sigils disappear from the object if you later carve them on a different item. The sigils otherwise last indefinitely.

You can use your Arcane Firearm as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Artificer spells. When you cast an Artificer spell through the firearm, roll {@damage 1d8}, and you gain a bonus to one of the spell's damage rolls equal to the number rolled.

subclassFeatures.name: Explosive Cannon
entries: Every {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA} you create is now more destructive. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Detonate
entries: When your cannon takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to command the cannon to detonate if you are within 60 feet of it. Doing so destroys the cannon and forces each creature within 20 feet of it to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 3d10} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Firepower
entries: The cannon's damage rolls and the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by Protector increase by {@dice 1d8}.

subclassFeatures.name: Fortified Position
entries: You're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using your {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Double Firepower
entries: You can now have two cannons at the same time, and you can create two with the same {@action Magic|XPHB} action. (If you expend a spell slot to create the first cannon, you must expend another spell slot to create the second.) You can activate both of them with the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, ordering them to use the same activation option or different ones. You can't create a third cannon while you have two.

entries.name: Shimmering Field Projection
entries: You and your allies have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} while within 10 feet of your {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA}.

subclassFeatures.name: Battle Ready
entries: Your combat training and your experiments with magic have paid off in two ways.

entries.name: Arcane Empowerment
entries: When you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of your Strength or Dexterity modifier, for the attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: Weapon Knowledge
entries: You gain proficiency with {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon}. You can use a weapon with which you have proficiency as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Artificer spells.

subclassFeatures.name: Battle Smith
entries: {@i Command a Construct Guardian}

A Battle Smith is a combination of protector and medic, an expert at defending others and repairing both materiel and personnel. To aid in their work, Battle Smiths are accompanied by a {@creature Steel Defender|EFA}, a protective companion of their own creation.

subclassFeatures.name: Battle Smith Spells
entries: When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Battle Smith Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeatures.name: Steel Defender
entries: Your tinkering has borne you a companion, a {@creature Steel Defender|EFA}. You determine the defender's appearance and whether it has two legs or four; your choices don't affect the defender's game statistics.
The {@creature Steel Defender|EFA|defender} is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies and obeys you. It vanishes if you die.

entries.name: The Defender in Combat
entries: In combat, the defender acts during your turn. It can move and take its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action unless you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command it to take an action. If you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the defender acts on its own and isn't limited to the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Restoring or Replacing the Defender
entries: If the defender has died within the last hour, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to touch it and expend a spell slot. The defender returns to life after 1 minute with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored.

Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can create a new {@creature Steel Defender|EFA|defender} if you have {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} in hand. If you already have a defender from this feature, the first one vanishes.

subclassFeatures.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice.

entries.name: Weapon Crafting
entries: When you craft a nonmagical or magic weapon, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.

subclassFeatures.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn. You can forgo one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to command your {@creature Steel Defender|EFA} to take the Force-Empowered Rend action.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Jolt
entries: When either you hit a target with an attack roll using a magic weapon or your {@creature Steel Defender|EFA} hits a target, you can channel magical energy through the strike to create one of the following effects:

items.name: Destructive Energy
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Force damage.

items.name: Restorative Energy
entries: Choose one creature or object you can see within 30 feet of the target. Healing energy flows into the chosen recipient, restoring {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to it.

You can use this energy a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), but you can do so no more than once per turn. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Improved Defender
entries: Your {@subclassFeature Arcane Jolt|Artificer|EFA|Battle Smith|EFA|9|EFA} and {@creature Steel Defender|EFA} have become more powerful, granting these benefits.

entries.name: Improved Jolt
entries: The extra damage and healing of your Arcane Jolt both increase to {@dice 4d6}.

entries.name: Improved Deflection
entries: Whenever your {@creature Steel Defender|EFA} uses its Deflect Attack, the attacker takes Force damage equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Adventurer's Atlas
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while holding {@item Cartographer's Tools|XPHB}, you can use that tool to create a set of magical maps by touching at least two creatures (one of whom can be yourself), up to a maximum number of creatures equal to 1 plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of two creatures). Each target receives a magical map, which constantly updates to show the relative position of all the map holders but is illegible to all others. The maps last until you die or until you use this feature again, at which point any existing maps created by this feature immediately vanish.
While carrying the map, a target gains the following benefits.

entries.name: Awareness
entries: The target adds {@dice 1d4} to its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

entries.name: Positioning
entries: The target knows the location of all other map holders that are on the same plane of existence as itself. When casting a spell or creating another effect that requires being able to see the effect's target, a map holder can target another map holder regardless of sight or cover, so long as the other map holder is still within the effect's range.

subclassFeatures.name: Cartographer
entries: {@i Chart Advantageous Courses through Turmoil}
Cartographers are the premier navigators and reconnaissance agents. Using their creations, Cartographers can highlight threats, safeguard allies, and carve portals to distant locations.

subclassFeatures.name: Cartographer Spells
entries: When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Cartographer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Cartographer Spells
rows: {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB}, {@spell Healing Word|XPHB}

subclassFeatures.name: Mapping Magic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Illuminated Cartography
entries: You can cast {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} without expending a spell slot, outlining the affected creatures as if in ink. You can do so a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Portal Jump
entries: On your turn, you can spend an amount of movement equal to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} (round down) to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of yourself or within 5 feet of a creature that is within 30 feet of you and holding one of your Adventurer's Atlas maps. You can't use this benefit if your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0.

subclassFeatures.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB} and {@item Cartographer's Tools|XPHB}. If you already have one of these proficiencies, you gain proficiency with one other type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice (or with two other types if you have both).

entries.name: Scroll Crafting
entries: When you scribe a {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} using the crafting rules in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.

subclassFeatures.name: Guided Precision
entries: Once per turn, whenever you cast a spell from your Cartographer Spells list or hit a creature affected by your {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} with an attack roll, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of the spell or attack.
In addition, taking damage can't cause you to lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Ingenious Movement
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Flash of Genius|Artificer|EFA|7|EFA}, you or a willing creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of yourself can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see as part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

subclassFeatures.name: Superior Atlas
entries: Your Adventurer's Atlas improves, gaining the following benefits.

entries.name: Safe Haven
entries: When a map holder would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright, that creature can destroy its map. The creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to a number equal to twice your Artificer level, and the creature is teleported to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you or another map holder of its choice.

entries.name: Unerring Path
entries: If you are one of the map holders for your Adventurer's Atlas, you can cast {@spell Find the Path|XPHB} without expending a spell slot, without preparing the spell, and without needing spell components. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

weapon: martial weapons that have the {@filter finesse or light|items|type=martial weapon|property=finesse;light} property

subclasses.name: Scion of the Three
subclassFeatures: Scion of the Three|Roublard|PHB24|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|3
Aura of Malevolence|Roublard|PHB24|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|13
Scion of the Three|Roublard|PHB24|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|3
Aura of Malevolence|Roublard|PHB24|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|13

classFeatures.name: Expertise
entries: Vous gagnez en expertise dans deux compétences de votre choix. Escamotage et Discrétion sont recommandés si vous les maîtrisez déjà.
Au niveau 6 de Voleur, vous gagnez l'Expertise dans deux autres compétences de votre choix.

classFeatures.name: Attaque sournoise
entries: Vous savez frapper avec subtilité et exploiter la distraction de votre adversaire. Une fois par tour, vous pouvez infliger 1d6 dégâts supplémentaires à une créature touchée par un jet d'attaque si vous avez l'avantage et que l'attaque est effectuée avec une arme de finesse ou à distance. Le type de ces dégâts supplémentaires est identique à celui de l'arme.

Vous n'avez pas besoin d'avantage au jet d'attaque si au moins un de vos alliés se trouve à moins de 1,5 mètre de la cible, si cet allié n'est pas incapable d' agir et si vous n'avez pas de désavantage au jet d'attaque.
Les dégâts supplémentaires augmentent à mesure que vous gagnez des niveaux de Voleur, comme indiqué dans la colonne Attaque sournoise du tableau des caractéristiques du Voleur.

classFeatures.name: Argot des voleurs
entries: Vous avez appris diverses langues dans les communautés où vous avez exercé vos talents de brigand. Vous connaissez le jargon des voleurs et une autre langue de votre choix, que vous sélectionnez dans les tableaux de langues du chapitre 2.

classFeatures.name: Maîtrise des armes
entries: Votre entraînement aux armes vous permet d'utiliser les propriétés de maîtrise de deux types d' armes de votre choix avec lesquels vous avez une certaine compétence, comme les dagues et les arcs courts.
Après chaque repos long, vous pouvez changer de type d'armes. Par exemple, vous pouvez opter pour la maîtrise des cimeterres et des épées courtes.

classFeatures.name: Action rusée
entries: Votre vivacité d'esprit et votre agilité vous permettent de vous déplacer et d'agir rapidement. À votre tour, vous pouvez effectuer l'une des actions suivantes en tant qu'action bonus : Foncer, Se désengager ou Se cacher.

classFeatures.name: Sous-classe de voleur
entries: Vous obtenez une sous-classe de Roublard de votre choix. Une sous-classe est une spécialisation qui vous octroie des capacités à certains niveaux de Roublard. Pour le reste de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de toutes les capacités de votre sous-classe correspondant à votre niveau de Roublard ou à un niveau inférieur.

classFeatures.name: Visée stable
entries: Par une action bonus, vous bénéficiez d'un avantage à votre prochain jet d'attaque durant ce tour. Vous ne pouvez utiliser cette capacité que si vous n'avez pas effectué de mouvement durant ce tour. Après utilisation, votre vitesse est réduite à 0 jusqu'à la fin du tour.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition. Vous recevez de nouveau cette aptitude aux niveau de Rogue 8, 10, 12, et 16.

classFeatures.name: Frappe rusée
entries: Vous avez développé des techniques ingénieuses pour utiliser votre Attaque sournoise. Lorsque vous infligez des dégâts d'Attaque sournoise, vous pouvez ajouter l'un des effets de Frappe sournoise suivants. Chaque effet a un coût en dés, qui correspond au nombre de dés de dégâts d'Attaque sournoise que vous devez sacrifier pour l'appliquer. Vous retirez le dé avant de lancer le dé, et l'effet s'applique immédiatement après que les dégâts de l'attaque ont été infligés. Par exemple, si vous ajoutez l'effet Poison, retirez 1d6 des dégâts de l'Attaque sournoise avant de lancer le dé.
Si un effet de Frappe Astucieuse nécessite un jet de sauvegarde, le DD est égal à 8 plus votre modificateur de Dextérité et votre bonus de maîtrise.

Vous ajoutez une toxine à votre attaque, obligeant la cible à effectuer un jet de sauvegarde de Constitution. En cas d’échec, la cible est empoisonnée pendant 1 minute. À la fin de chacun de ses tours, la cible empoisonnée retente le jet de sauvegarde ; en cas de réussite, l’effet prend fin.
Pour utiliser cet effet, vous devez avoir un kit d'empoisonneur sur vous.
entries.name: Poison (Coût : 1d6)
Croche-pied (Coût : 1d6)
entries: Si la cible est de taille Grande ou inférieure, elle doit réussir un jet de sauvegarde de Dextérité ou être à terre.

entries.name: Retraite (Coût : 1d6).
entries: Immédiatement après l’attaque, vous vous déplacez jusqu’à la moitié de votre vitesse sans provoquer d’attaques d’opportunité.

classFeatures.name: Esquive instinctive
entries: Lorsqu'un attaquant que vous pouvez voir vous touche avec un jet d'attaque, vous pouvez effectuer une réaction pour réduire de moitié les dégâts de l'attaque contre vous (arrondir à l'inférieur).

classFeatures.name: Expertise
entries: Vous acquérez une expertise dans deux compétences de votre choix.

classFeatures.name: Évasion
entries: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

classFeatures.name: Talent fiable
entries: Lorsque vous effectuez un test de capacité qui utilise l'une de vos compétences ou maîtrises d'outil, vous pouvez considérer un jet de d20 de 9 ou moins comme un 10.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Rogue.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Frappe rusée améliorée
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser jusqu'à deux effets de Frappe sournoise lorsque vous infligez des dégâts d'Attaque sournoise, en payant le coût du dé pour chaque effet.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Rogue.

classFeatures.name: Attaques sournoises
entries: Vous avez appris de nouvelles façons d'utiliser votre Attaque sournoise de manière sournoise. Les effets suivants font désormais partie de vos options de Frappe rusée.

La cible doit réussir un jet de sauvegarde de Constitution, ou, à son prochain tour, elle ne peut effectuer qu’une seule des actions suivantes : se déplacer ou entreprendre une action ou une action bonus.
entries.name: Étourdissement (Coût : 2d6)
K.O. (Coût : 6d6)
entries: La cible doit réussir un jet de sauvegarde de Constitution, sous peine d’être inconsciente pendant 1 minute ou jusqu’à ce qu’elle subisse des dégâts. La cible inconsciente renouvelle le jet de sauvegarde à la fin de chacun de ses tours ; en cas de réussite, l’effet prend fin.

entries.name: Obscurité (Coût : 3d6)
entries: La cible doit réussir un jet de sauvegarde de Dextérité, sous peine d’être aveuglée jusqu’à la fin de son prochain tour.

classFeatures.name: Esprit insaisissable
entries: Votre esprit rusé est exceptionnellement difficile à maîtriser. Vous gagnez la maîtrise des jets de sauvegarde de Sagesse et de Charisme.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Rogue.

classFeatures.name: Insaisissable
entries: Vous êtes si insaisissable que vos adversaires prennent rarement l'avantage. Aucun jet d'attaque ne peut vous être favorable, sauf si vous êtes incapable d'agir.

classFeatures.name: Bénédiction épique
entries: Vous obtenez un don de  {@filter Don épique feat|feats|category=EB} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html}de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises. Le {@feat Don de l'Esprit de la Nuit|PHB24} de sorts est recommandé.

classFeatures.name: Coup de chance
entries: Vous avez un don remarquable pour réussir quand il le faut. Si vous ratez un jet de D20, vous pouvez transformer le résultat en un 20.
Une fois cette fonctionnalité utilisée, vous ne pourrez plus l'utiliser avant d'avoir terminé un repos court ou long.

subclassFeatures.name: Inquisitive
entries: As an archetypal Inquisitive, you excel at rooting out secrets et unraveling mysteries. You rely on your sharp eye for detail, but also on your finely honed ability to read the words et deeds of other creatures to determine their true intent. You excel at defeating creatures that hide among et prey upon ordinary folk, et your mastery of lore et your keen deductions make you well equipped to expose et end hidden evils.

subclassFeatures.name: Ear for Deceit
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you develop a talent for picking out lies. Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the {@dice d20} as an 8.

subclassFeatures.name: Eye for Detail
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot a hidden creature or object or to make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to uncover or decipher clues.

subclassFeatures.name: Insightful Fighting
entries: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to decipher an opponent's tactics et develop a counter to them. As a bonus action, you can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against a creature you can see that isn't {@condition incapacitated}, contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If you succeed, you can use your Attaque Sournoise against that target even if you don't have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage on it.
This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you successfully use this feature against a different target.

subclassFeatures.name: Steady Eye
entries: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Unerring Eye
entries: Beginning at 13th level, your senses are almost impossible to foil. As an action, you sense the presence of illusions, shapechangers not in their original form, et other magic designed to deceive the senses within 30 feet of you, provided you aren't {@condition blinded} or {@condition deafened}. You sense that an effect is attempting to trick you, but you gain no insight into what is hidden or into its true nature.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Eye for Weakness
entries: At 17th level, you learn to exploit a creature's weaknesses by carefully studying its tactics et movement. While your Insightful Fighting feature applies to a creature, your Attaque Sournoise damage against that creature increases by {@damage 3d6}.

subclassFeatures.name: Mastermind
entries: Your focus is on people et on the influence et secrets they have. Many spies, courtiers, et schemers follow this archetype, leading lives of intrigue. Words are your weapons as often as knives or poison, et secrets et favors are some of your favorite treasures.

subclassFeatures.name: Master of Intrigue
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with the {@item disguise kit|phb}, the {@item forgery kit|phb}, et one {@item gaming set|PHB} of your choice. You also learn two languages of your choice.

Additionally, you can unerringly mimic the speech patterns et accent of a creature that you hear speak for at least 1 minute, enabling you to pass yourself off as a native speaker of a particular let, provided that you know the language.

subclassFeatures.name: Master of Tactics
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the {@action Help} action as a bonus action. Additionally, when you use the {@action Help} action to aid an ally in attacking a creature, the target of that attack can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet of you, if the target can see or hear you.

subclassFeatures.name: Insightful Manipulator
entries: Starting at 9th level, if you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice:

items: Intelligence score
Wisdom score
Charisma score
Class levels (if any)

entries: At the DM's option, you might also realize you know a piece of the creature's history or one of its personality traits, if it has any.

subclassFeatures.name: Misdirection
entries: Beginning at 13th level, you can sometimes cause another creature to suffer an attack meant for you. When you are targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet of you is granting you cover against that attack, you can use your reaction to have the attack target that creature instead of you.

subclassFeatures.name: Soul of Deceit
entries: Starting at 17th level, your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means, unless you allow it. You can present false thoughts by succeeding on a Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check contested by the mind reader's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.
Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates you are being truthful if you so choose, et you can't be compelled to tell the truth by magic.

subclassFeatures.name: Scout
entries: You are skilled in stealth et surviving far from the streets of a city, allowing you to scout ahead of your companions during expeditions. Rogues who embrace this archetype are at home in the wilderness et among barbarians et rangers, et many Scouts serve as the eyes et ears of war bets. Ambusher, spy, bounty hunter—these are just a few of the roles that Scouts assume as they range the world.

subclassFeatures.name: Skirmisher
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you are difficult to pin down during a fight. You can move up to half your speed as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

subclassFeatures.name: Survivalist
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature} et {@skill Survival} skills if you don't already have it. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.

subclassFeatures.name: Superior Mobility
entries: At 9th level, your walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, this increase applies to that speed as well.

subclassFeatures.name: Ambush Master
entries: Starting at 13th level, you excel at leading ambushes et acting first in a fight.

You have advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, the first creature you hit during the first round of a combat becomes easier for you et others to strike; attack rolls against that target have advantage until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Sudden Strike
entries: Starting at 17th level, you can strike with deadly speed. If you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as a bonus action. This attack can benefit from your Attaque Sournoise even if you have already used it this turn, but you can't use your Attaque Sournoise against the same target more than once in a turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Swashbuckler
entries: You focus your training on the art of the blade, relying on speed, elegance, et charm in equal parts. While some warriors are brutes clad in heavy armor, your method of fighting looks almost like a performance. Duelists et pirates typically belong to this archetype.
A Swashbuckler excels in single combat, et can fight with two weapons while safely darting away from an opponent.

subclassFeatures.name: Fancy Footwork
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn how to let a strike et then slip away without reprisal. During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Rakish Audacity
entries: Starting at 3rd level, your confidence propels you into battle. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier.

You also gain an additional way to use your Attaque Sournoise; you don't need advantage on your attack roll to use Attaque Sournoise against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creatures are within 5 feet of you, et you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll. All the other rules for Attaque Sournoise still apply to you.

subclassFeatures.name: Panache
entries: At 9th level, your charm becomes extraordinarily beguiling. As an action, you can make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check contested by a creature's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. The creature must be able to hear you, et the two of you must share a language.

If you succeed on the check et the creature is hostile to you, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you et can't make opportunity attacks against targets other than you. This effect lasts for 1 minute, until one of your companions attacks the target or affects it with a spell, or until you et the target are more than 60 feet apart.

If you succeed on the check et the creature isn't hostile to you, it is {@condition charmed} by you for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed}, it regards you as a friendly acquaintance. This effect ends immediately if you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

subclassFeatures.name: Elegant Maneuver
entries: Starting at 13th level, you can use a bonus action on your turn to gain advantage on the next Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) or Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check you make during the same turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Master Duelist
entries: Beginning at 17th level, your mastery of the blade lets you turn failure into success in combat. If you miss with an attack roll, you can roll it again with advantage. Once you do so, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Phantom
entries: Many rogues walk a fine line between life et death, risking their own lives et taking the lives of others. While adventuring on that line, some rogues discover a mystical connection to death itself. These rogues take knowledge from the dead et become immersed in negative energy, eventually becoming like ghosts. Thieves' guilds value them as highly effective information gatherers et spies.

Many shadar-kai of the Shadowfell are masters of these macabre techniques, et some are willing to teach this path. In places like Thay in the Forgotten Realms et Karrnath in Eberron, where many necromancers practice their craft, a Phantom can become a wizard's confidant et right het. In temples of gods of death, the Phantom might work as an agent to track down those who try to cheat death et to recover knowledge that might otherwise be lost to the grave.
How did you discover this grim power? Did you sleep in a graveyard et awaken to your new abilities? Or did you cultivate them in a temple or thieves' guild dedicated to a deity of death?

subclassFeatures.name: Wails from the Grave
entries: {@i 3rd-level Phantom feature}

As you nudge someone closer to the grave, you can channel the power of death to harm someone else as well. Immediately after you deal your Attaque Sournoise damage to a creature on your turn, you can target a second creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature. Roll half the number of Attaque Sournoise dice for your level (round up), et the second creature takes necrotic damage equal to the roll's total, as wails of the dead sound around them for a moment.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Whispers of the Dead
entries: {@i 3rd-level Phantom feature}

Echoes of those who have died cling to you. Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can choose one skill or tool proficiency that you lack et gain it, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this feature to choose a different proficiency that you lack.

subclassFeatures.name: Tokens of the Departed
entries: {@i 9th-level Phantom feature}

When a life ends in your presence, you're able to snatch a token from the departing soul, a sliver of its life essence that takes physical form: as a reaction when a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can open your free het et cause a Tiny trinket to appear there, a soul trinket. The DM determines the trinket's form or has you roll on the {@item Trinket|phb|Trinkets} table in the {@i Player's Hetbook} to generate it. You can have a maximum number of soul trinkets equal to your proficiency bonus, et you can't create one while at your maximum.
You can use soul trinkets in the following ways:

items: While a soul trinket is on your person, you have advantage on death saving throws et Constitution saving throws, for your vitality is enhanced by the life essence within the object.

When you deal Attaque Sournoise damage on your turn, you can destroy one of your soul trinkets that's on your person et then immediately use Wails from the Grave, without expending a use of that feature.

As an action, you can destroy one of your soul trinkets, no matter where it's located. When you do so, you can ask the spirit associated with the trinket one question. The spirit appears to you et answers in a language it knew in life. It's under no obligation to be truthful, et it answers as concisely as possible, eager to be free. The spirit knows only what it knew in life, as determined by the DM.

subclassFeatures.name: Ghost Walk
entries: {@i 13th-level Phantom feature}

You can phase partially into the realm of the dead, becoming like a ghost. As a bonus action, you assume a spectral form. While in this form, you have a flying speed of 10 feet, you can hover, et attack rolls have disadvantage against you. You can also move through creatures et objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, but you take {@damage 1d10} force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object.

You stay in this form for 10 minutes or until you end it as a bonus action. To use this feature again, you must finish a long rest or destroy one of your soul trinkets as part of the bonus action you use to activate Ghost Walk.

subclassFeatures.name: Death's Friend
entries: {@i 17th-level Phantom feature}
Your association with death has become so close that you gain the following benefits:

items: When you use your Wails from the Grave, you can deal the necrotic damage to both the first et the second creature.
At the end of a long rest, a soul trinket appears in your het if you don't have any soul trinkets, as the spirits of the dead are drawn to you.

subclassFeatures.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
entries: When your non-psionic training fails you, your psionic power can help: if you fail an ability check using a skill or tool with which you have proficiency, you can roll one Psionic Energy die et add the number rolled to the check, potentially turning failure into success. You expend the die only if the roll succeeds.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Whispers
entries: You can establish telepathic communication between yourself et others-perfect for quiet infiltration. As an action, choose one or more creatures you can see, up to a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus, et then roll one Psionic Energy die. For a number of hours equal to the number rolled, the chosen creatures can speak telepathically with you, et you can speak telepathically with them. To send or receive a message (no action required), you et the other creature must be within 1 mile of each other. A creature can't use this telepathy if it can't speak any languages, et a creature can end the telepathic connection at any time (no action required). You et the creature don't need to speak a common language to understet each other.
The first time you use this power after each long rest, you don't expend the Psionic Energy die. All other times you use the power, you expend the die.

subclassFeatures.name: Soulknife
entries: Most assassins strike with physical weapons, et many burglars et spies use {@item thieves' tools|PHB} to infiltrate secure locations. In contrast, a Soulknife strikes et infiltrates with the mind, cutting through barriers both physical et psychic. These rogues discover psionic power within themselves et channel it to do their roguish work. They find easy employment as members of thieves' guilds, though they are often mistrusted by rogues who are leery of anyone using strange mind powers to conduct their business. Most governments would also be happy to employ a Soulknife as a spy.

Amid the trees of ancient forests on the Material Plane et in the Feywild, some wood elves walk the path of the Soulknife, serving as silent, lethal guardians of their woods. In the endless war among the gith, a githzerai is encouraged to become a Soulknife when stealth is required against the githyanki foe.

As a Soulknife, your psionic abilities might have haunted you since you were a child, only revealing their full potential as you experienced the stress of adventure. Or you might have sought out a reclusive order of psychic adepts et spent years learning how to manifest your power.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Power
entries: {@i 3rd-level Soulknife feature}

You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. This energy is represented by your Psionic Energy dice, which are each a {@dice d6}. You have a number of these dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus, et they fuel various psionic powers you have, which are detailed below.

Some of your powers expend the Psionic Energy die they use, as specified in a power's description, et you can't use a power if it requires you to use a die when your dice are all expended. You regain all your expended Psionic Energy dice when you finish a long rest. In addition, as a bonus action, you can regain one expended Psionic Energy die, but you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
When you reach certain levels in this class, the size of your Psionic Energy dice increases: at 5th level ({@dice d8}), 11th level ({@dice d10}), et 17th level ({@dice d12}).
The powers below use your Psionic Energy dice.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Blades
entries: {@i 3rd-level Soulknife feature}

You can manifest your psionic power as shimmering blades of psychic energy. Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action, you can manifest a psychic blade from your free het et make the attack with that blade. This magic blade is a simple melee weapon with the finesse et thrown properties. It has a normal range of 60 feet et no long range, et on a hit, it deals psychic damage equal to {@damage 1d6} plus the ability modifier you used for the attack roll. The blade vanishes immediately after it hits or misses its target, et it leaves no mark on its target if it deals damage.

After you attack with the blade, you can make a melee or ranged weapon attack with a second psychic blade as a bonus action on the same turn, provided your other het is free to create it. The damage die of this bonus attack is {@damage 1d4}, instead of {@damage 1d6}.

subclassFeatures.name: Homing Strikes
entries: If you make an attack roll with your Psychic Blades et miss the target, you can roll one Psionic Energy die et add the number rolled to the attack roll. If this causes the attack to hit, you expend the Psionic Energy die.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Teleportation
entries: As a bonus action, you manifest one of your Psychic Blades, expend one Psionic Energy die et roll it, et throw the blade at an unoccupied space you can see, up to a number of feet away equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport to that space, et the blade vanishes.

subclassFeatures.name: Soul Blades
entries: {@i 9th-level Soulknife feature}
Your Psychic Blades are now an expression of your psi-suffused soul, giving you these powers that use your Psionic Energy dice:

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Veil
entries: {@i 13th-level Soulknife feature}

You can weave a veil of psychic static to mask yourself. As an action, you can magically become {@condition invisible}, along with anything you are wearing or carrying, for 1 hour or until you dismiss this effect (no action required). This invisibility ends early immediately after you deal damage to a creature or you force a creature to make a saving throw.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to use this feature again.

subclassFeatures.name: Rend Mind
entries: {@i 17th-level Soulknife feature}

You can sweep your Psychic Blades directly through a creature's mind. When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Attaque Sournoise damage to a creature, you can force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier). If the save fails, the target is {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. The {@condition stunned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend three Psionic Energy dice to use it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Trickster
entries: {@i Enhance Stealth with Arcane Spells}

Some Rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth et agility with spells, learning magical tricks to aid them in their trade. Some Arcane Tricksters use their talents as pickpockets et burglars, while others are pranksters.

subclassFeatures.name: Mage Het Legerdemain
entries: When you cast {@spell Mage Het|PHB24}, you can cast it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, et you can make the spectral het {@condition Invisible|PHB24}. You can control the het as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, et through it, you can make Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Het|PHB24}) checks.

subclassFeatures.name: Spellcasting
entries: You have learned to cast spells. See {@book chapter 7|PHB24|7} for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules as an Arcane Trickster.

entries.name: Sorts Mineur
entries: You know three cantrips: {@spell Mage Het|PHB24} et two other cantrips of your choice from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard} (see that class's section for its list). {@spell Mind Sliver|PHB24} et {@spell Minor Illusion|PHB24} are recommended.
Whenever you gain a Rogue level, you can replace one of your cantrips, except {@spell Mage Het|PHB24}, with another Wizard cantrip of your choice.
When you reach Rogue level 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

entries.name: Sorts Préparé of 1st+ Level
entries: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose three level 1 Wizard spells. {@spell Charm Person|PHB24}, {@spell Disguise Self|PHB24}, et {@spell Fog Cloud|PHB24} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Rogue levels, as shown in the Sorts Préparé column of the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Wizard spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 7 Rogue, your list of prepared spells can include five Wizard spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.

entries.name: Changing Your Sorts Préparé
entries: Whenever you gain a Rogue level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Wizard spell for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use an {@item Arcane Focus|PHB24} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|PHB24} for your Wizard spells.

subclassFeatures.name: Magical Ambush
entries: If you have the {@condition Invisible|PHB24} condition when you cast a spell on a creature, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} on any saving throw it makes against the spell on the same turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Versatile Trickster
entries: You gain the ability to distract targets with your {@spell Mage Het|PHB24}. When you use the Trip option of your Cunning Strike on a creature, you can also use that option on another creature within 5 feet of the spectral het.

subclassFeatures.name: Spell Thief
entries: You gain the ability to magically steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from another spellcaster.

Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to force the creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. The DC equals your spell save DC. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you, et you steal the knowledge of the spell if it is at least level 1 et of a level you can cast (it doesn't need to be a Wizard spell). For the next 8 hours, you have the spell prepared. The creature can't cast it until the 8 hours have passed.
Once you steal a spell with this feature, you can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Assassin
entries: {@i Practice the Grim Art of Death}

An Assassin's training focuses on using stealth, poison, et disguise to eliminate foes with deadly efficiency. While some Rogues who follow this path are hired killers, spies, or bounty hunters, the capabilities of this subclass are equally useful for adventurers facing a variety of monstrous enemies.

subclassFeatures.name: Assassin's Tools
entries: You gain a {@item Disguise Kit|PHB24} et a {@item Poisoner's Kit|PHB24}, et you have proficiency with them.

subclassFeatures.name: Assassinate
entries: You're adept at ambushing a target, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Initiative
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24} rolls.

entries.name: Surprising Strikes
entries: During the first round of each combat, you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. If your Attaque Sournoise hits any target during that round, the target takes extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your Rogue level.

subclassFeatures.name: Infiltration Expertise
entries: You are expert at the following techniques that aid your infiltrations.

entries.name: Masterful Mimicry
entries: You can unerringly mimic another person's speech, hetwriting, or both if you have spent at least 1 hour studying them.

entries.name: Roving Aim
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} isn't reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.

subclassFeatures.name: Envenom Weapons
entries: When you use the Poison option of your Cunning Strike, the target also takes {@damage 2d6} Poison damage whenever it fails the saving throw. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to Poison damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Death Strike
entries: When you hit with your Attaque Sournoise on the first round of a combat, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Dexterity modifier et {@variantrule Proficiency|PHB24|Proficiency Bonus}), or the attack's damage is doubled against the target.

subclassFeatures.name: Soulknife
entries: {@i Strike Foes with Psionic Blades}

A Soulknife strikes with the mind, cutting through barriers both physical et psychic. These Rogues discover psionic power within themselves et channel it to do their roguish work. As a Soulknife, your psionic abilities might have haunted you since childhood, revealing their full potential only as you experienced the stress of adventure. Or you might have sought out an order of psychic adepts et spent years learning how to manifest your power.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Power
entries: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. It is represented by your Psionic Energy Dice, which fuel certain powers you have from this subclass.
