The Soulknife Energy Dice table shows the number of these dice you have when you reach certain Rogue levels, et the table shows the die size.

Any features in this subclass that use a Psionic Energy Die use only the dice from this subclass. Some of your powers expend a Psionic Energy Die, as specified in a power's description, et you can't use a power if it requires you to use a die when your Psionic Energy Dice are all expended.
You regain one of your expended Psionic Energy Dice when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24}, et you regain all of them when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.
The first time you use this power after each {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you don't expend the Psionic Energy Die. All other times you use the power, you expend the die.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Blades
entries: You can manifest shimmering blades of psychic energy. Whenever you take the {@action Attack|PHB24} action or make an {@action Opportunity Attack|PHB24}, you can manifest a {@item Psychic Blade|PHB24} in your free het et make the attack with that blade. The magic blade has the following traits:
The blade vanishes immediately after it hits or misses its target, et it leaves no mark if it deals damage.

After you attack with the blade on your turn, you can make a melee or ranged attack with a second psychic blade as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} on the same turn if your other het is free to create it. The damage die of this bonus attack is {@damage 1d4} instead of {@damage 1d6}.

subclassFeatures.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
entries: If you fail an ability check using a skill or tool with which you have proficiency, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die et add the number rolled to the check, potentially turning failure into success. The die is expended only if the roll then succeeds.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Whispers
entries: You can establish telepathic communication between yourself et others. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, choose one or more creatures you can see, up to a number of creatures equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|PHB24|Proficiency Bonus}, et then roll one Psionic Energy Die. For a number of hours equal to the number rolled, the chosen creatures can speak telepathically with you, et you can speak telepathically with them. To send or receive a message (no action required), you et the other creature must be within 1 mile of each other. A creature can end the telepathic connection at any time (no action required).

subclassFeatures.name: Homing Strikes
entries: If you make an attack roll with your {@item Psychic Blade|PHB24} et miss the target, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die et add the number rolled to the attack roll. If this causes the attack to hit, the die is expended.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Teleportation
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you manifest a {@item Psychic Blade|PHB24}, expend one Psionic Energy Die et roll it, et throw the blade at an unoccupied space you can see up to a number of feet away equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport to that space, et the blade vanishes.

subclassFeatures.name: Soul Blades
entries: You can now use the following powers with your Psychic Blades.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Veil
entries: You can weave a veil of psychic static to mask yourself. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, you gain the {@condition Invisible|PHB24} condition for 1 hour or until you dismiss this effect (no action required). This invisibility ends early immediately after you deal damage to a creature or you force a creature to make a saving throw.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Rend Mind
entries: You can sweep your Psychic Blades through a creature's mind. When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Attaque Sournoise damage to a creature, you can force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Dexterity modifier et {@variantrule Proficiency|PHB24|Proficiency Bonus}). If the save fails, the target has the {@condition Stunned|PHB24} condition for 1 minute. The {@condition Stunned|PHB24} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend three Psionic Energy Dice (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Fast Hets
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can do one of the following.

entries.name: Sleight of Het
entries: Make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Het|PHB24}) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB24} or to pick a pocket.

entries.name: Use an Object
entries: Take the {@action Utilize|PHB24} action, or take the {@action Magic|PHB24} action to use a magic item that requires that action.

subclassFeatures.name: Second-Story Work
entries: You've trained to get into especially hard-to-reach places, granting you these benefits.

entries.name: Climber
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|PHB24} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24}.

entries.name: Jumper
entries: You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.

subclassFeatures.name: Thief
entries: {@i Hunt for Treasure as a Classic Adventurer}

A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, et explorer, you are the epitome of an adventurer. In addition to improving your agility et stealth, you gain abilities useful for delving into ruins et getting maximum benefit from the magic items you find there.

subclassFeatures.name: Supreme Sneak
entries: You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

entries.name: Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6)
entries: If you have the {@action Hide|PHB24} action's {@condition Invisible|PHB24} condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind {@variantrule Cover|PHB24|Three-Quarters Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|PHB24|Total Cover}.

subclassFeatures.name: Use Magic Device
entries: You've learned how to maximize use of magic items, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.

entries.name: Charges
entries: Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a roll of 6, you use the property without expending the charges.

entries.name: Scrolls
entries: You can use any {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG}, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for the spell. If the spell is a cantrip or a level 1 spell, you can cast it reliably. If the scroll contains a higher-level spell, you must first succeed on an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|PHB24}) check ({@dc 10} plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell from the scroll. On a failed check, the scroll disintegrates.

subclassFeatures.name: Thief's Reflexes
entries: You are adept at laying ambushes et quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24} et your second turn at your {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24} minus 10.

subclassFeatures.name: Bloodthirst
entries: When an enemy you can see within 30 feet of yourself takes damage et is {@status Bloodied|PHB24} after taking that damage but not killed outright, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} et {@variantrule Teleportation|PHB24|teleport} to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of that enemy. You can then make one melee attack. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Dread Allegiance
entries: Choose one of the Dead Three: {@deity Bane|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, {@deity Bhaal|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, or {@deity Myrkul|Faerûnian|FRHoF}. You gain {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to one type of damage et the ability to cast a cantrip, as detailed in the table below; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you can change your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Scion of the Three
entries: {@i Become a Gruesome Agent of Malice}

A Scion of the Three draws power from a group of malevolent gods known as the Dead Three: {@deity Bane|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, deity of tyranny; {@deity Bhaal|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, deity of violence et murder; et {@deity Myrkul|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, deity of death. While some Rogues of this subclass pledge themselves ardently to those three macabre gods, others find themselves thrust on this path by a curse. Either way, a scion's power manifests as various occult gifts, as well as an uncanny talent for striking et terrifying foes.

Scions of the Three are most common in Baldur's Gate, where the Dead Three have long competed for influence over mortal hearts. Underground cults to {@deity Bane|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, {@deity Bhaal|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, et {@deity Myrkul|Faerûnian|FRHoF} often count Scions of the Three among their most useful agents. Outside Baldur's Gate, secular thieves' guilds such as the Shadow Thieves of Amn or Xanathar's guild in Waterdeep might cautiously call on a Scion of the Three to undertake an especially violent contract.

subclassFeatures.name: Strike Fear
entries: You gain the following {@classFeature Cunning Strike|Rogue|PHB24|5|PHB24} option.

entries.name: Terrify (Cost: 1d6)
entries: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it has the {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition for 1 minute. While the target is Frightened in this way, you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on attack rolls against the target.
The {@condition Frightened|PHB24} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

subclassFeatures.name: Aura of Malevolence
entries: You radiate malignant power associated with one of the Dead Three. When you use {@subclassFeature Bloodthirst|Rogue|PHB24|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} et teleport, each creature of your choice within 10 feet of either the space you left or your destination space (your choice) takes damage equal to your Intelligence modifier; the damage type is the same as the damage {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} granted by your choice in the Dread Allegiance feature. Damage dealt by this feature ignores {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Dread Incarnate
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cutthroat
entries: You regain one expended use of {@subclassFeature Bloodthirst|Rogue|PHB24|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24}.

entries.name: Murderous Intent
entries: When you roll for your {@classFeature Attaque Sournoise|Rogue|PHB24|1|PHB24} damage, you can treat a roll of a 1 or 2 on the die as a 3.

subclassFeatures.name: Phantom
entries: {@i Embrace Death et Wield Ghostly Power}

Some Rogues traverse the veil between life et death, shepherding opponents to the grave et slipping through the world as undetectable as a spirit. In these pursuits, a Rogue might discover a mystical connection to death itself. Such an individual becomes immersed in negative energy, infusing their strikes with deathly energy et stealing knowledge from souls who have passed on. Thieves' guilds value Rogues of this persuasion as highly effective information gatherers et spies.

subclassFeatures.name: Wails from the Grave
entries: Immediately after you deal Attaque Sournoise damage to a creature on your turn, you can target a second creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature. Roll half the number of Attaque Sournoise damage dice for your level (round up), et the second creature takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll's total as wails of the dead sound around it.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Whispers of the Dead
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you can choose one skill or tool proficiency that you lack et gain it, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this benefit again to choose a different proficiency.

subclassFeatures.name: Tokens of the Departed
entries: The spirits of the dead are drawn to you, et echoes of their past lives magically manifest as strange curios with resonant power.

You gain two soul trinkets. A soul trinket is a Tiny object (the DM determines the trinket's form or has you roll on the {@item Trinket|PHB24|Trinkets table} in the {@book Player's Hetbook|PHB24} to generate it). If you move more than 30 feet from a trinket, the trinket immediately teleports to you, appearing somewhere on your person.

entries.name: Using Soul Trinkets
entries: You can use soul trinkets in the following ways:

items.name: Death's Knell
items.entry: When you deal Attaque Sournoise damage on your turn, you can destroy one soul trinket et immediately use Wails from the Grave without expending a use of that feature.

items.name: Life Essence
items.entry: While you have at least one soul trinket, you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|PHB24|Death Saving Throws} et Constitution saving throws.

items.name: Spirit Query
items.entry: You can take a {@action Magic|PHB24} action to destroy one soul trinket et immediately cast the {@spell Augury|PHB24} spell, requiring no spell components et using Constitution as the spellcasting modifier. If you know the creature with which the trinket is associated, you can ask the creature's spirit one question instead of casting the spell. In this case, the spirit appears to you et answers as concisely as possible in a language it knew in life.

entries.name: Gaining Additional Soul Trinkets
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you dies, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to gain another soul trinket, claiming a sliver of that creature's departing spirit. The new trinket appears somewhere on your person.

You can have a maximum of two soul trinkets at a time. If you try to gain a soul trinket while at your maximum, one of your existing trinkets is immediately destroyed et replaced by the new trinket. The maximum number of soul trinkets you can have increases when you reach Rogue levels 13 (three trinkets) et 17 (four trinkets).
Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} with fewer than two soul trinkets, you gain soul trinkets until you have two.

subclassFeatures.name: Voice of Death
entries: You can cast {@spell Speak with Dead|PHB24} once without a spell slot, requiring no spell components et using Dexterity as the spellcasting modifier. You regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
When you cast the spell, you can target one of your soul trinkets from Tokens of the Departed instead of a corpse, allowing the spirit of the creature associated with the trinket to answer.

subclassFeatures.name: Ghost Walk
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you assume a spectral form, gaining the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you destroy one of your soul trinkets from Tokens of the Departed (no action required) to restore your use of it.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|PHB24} of 10 feet et can hover.

entries.name: Hazy Form
entries: Attack rolls have {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} against you.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: You can move through creatures et objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|PHB24}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object.

subclassFeatures.name: Death's Friend
entries: Your association with death has become so close that you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Death's Lament
entries: When you use Wails from the Grave, you can deal the feature's Necrotic damage to both the first et the second creature.

entries.name: Draw of Death
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24}, you gain one soul trinket for your Tokens of the Departed if you have none remaining.

classFeatures.name: Incantation
entries: Vous avez appris à canaliser l'essence magique de la nature pour lancer des sorts. Consultez le chapitre 7 pour les règles relatives à la magie. Les informations ci-dessous détaillent comment appliquer ces règles aux sorts de rôdeur, qui figurent dans la liste des sorts de rôdeur plus loin dans la description de la classe.

entries.name: Emplacements de sorts
entries: Le tableau des aptitudes du rôdeur indique le nombre d'emplacements de sorts dont vous disposez pour lancer vos sorts de niveau 1 et plus. Vous récupérez tous vos emplacements dépensés après un repos long.

entries.name: Sorts préparés de niveau 1 et plus
entries: Vous préparez la liste des sorts de niveau 1 et plus que vous pouvez lancer grâce à cette capacité. Pour commencer, choisissez deux sorts de rôdeur de niveau 1. {@spell Soins} et {@spell Frappe envoûtante} sont recommandés.

Le nombre de sorts de votre liste augmente à mesure que vous gagnez des niveaux de rôdeur, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Sorts préparés » du tableau des aptitudes de rôdeur. À chaque augmentation de ce nombre, choisissez des sorts de rôdeur supplémentaires jusqu'à ce que votre liste contienne le nombre indiqué dans le tableau des aptitudes de rôdeur. Les sorts choisis doivent être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts. Par exemple, si vous êtes un rôdeur de niveau 5, votre liste de sorts préparés peut inclure six sorts de rôdeur de niveau 1 ou 2, dans n'importe quelle combinaison.

Si une autre capacité de rôdeur vous donne des sorts que vous avez toujours préparés, ces sorts ne sont pas comptabilisés dans le nombre de sorts que vous pouvez préparer avec cette capacité, mais ils sont par ailleurs considérés comme des sorts de rôdeur.

entries.name: Modification de vos sorts préparés
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un repos long, vous pouvez remplacer un sort de votre liste par un autre sort de rôdeur pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts.

entries.name: Capacité d'incantation
entries: La Sagesse est votre caractéristique d'incantation pour vos sorts de rôdeur.

entries.name: Focalisation de sorts
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser une focalisation druidique comme focalisation de sorts pour vos sorts de rôdeur.

classFeatures.name: Ennemi favori
entries: Vous avez toujours le sort Marque du chasseur prêt. Vous pouvez le lancer deux fois sans dépenser d'emplacement de sort, et vous récupérez toutes les utilisations dépensées de cette capacité lorsque vous terminez un repos long.

Le nombre de fois où vous pouvez lancer le sort sans utiliser d'emplacement de sort augmente lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux de rôdeur, comme indiqué dans la colonne Ennemi favori du tableau des caractéristiques du rôdeur.

classFeatures.name: Maîtrise des armes
entries: Votre entraînement aux armes vous permet d'utiliser les propriétés de maîtrise de deux types d' armes de votre choix avec lesquels vous avez une certaine compétence, comme les arcs longs et les épées courtes.
Après chaque repos long, vous pouvez changer de type d'armes. Par exemple, vous pouvez opter pour la maîtrise des cimeterres et des épées longues.

classFeatures.name: Explorateur habile
entries: Grâce à vos voyages, vous bénéficiez des avantages suivants.

entries.name: Expertise
entries: Choisissez une compétence dans laquelle vous manquez d'expertise. Vous gagnez alors de l' expertise.

entries.name: Langues
entries: Vous connaissez deux langues de votre choix parmi les tableaux de langues du chapitre 2.

classFeatures.name: Style de combat
entries: Vous obtenez un don de style de combat de votre choix. Au lieu de choisir l'un de ces dons, vous pouvez choisir l'option ci-dessous.

Vous apprenez deux sorts mineurs de druide de votre choix. {@spell Guidance} et {@spell Feu follet} étoilé sont recommandés. Ces sorts mineurs comptent comme des sorts de rôdeur, et votre Sagesse est votre caractéristique d'incantation pour les lancer. À chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau de rôdeur, vous pouvez remplacer l'un de ces sorts mineurs par un autre sort mineur de druide.
entries.name: Guerrier druidique

classFeatures.name: Sous-classe de rôdeur
entries: Vous obtenez une sous-classe de rôdeur de votre choix. Une sous-classe est une spécialisation qui vous octroie des capacités à certains niveaux de rôdeur. Pour le reste de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de toutes les capacités de votre sous-classe correspondant à votre niveau de rôdeur ou à un niveau inférieur.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition. Vous recevez de nouveau cette aptitude aux niveau de Ranger 8, 12, et 16.

classFeatures.name: Attaque supplémentaire
entries: Vous pouvez attaquer deux fois au lieu d'une seule fois chaque fois que vous effectuez l' action Attaquer pendant votre tour.

classFeatures.name: Itinérant
entries: Votre vitesse augmente de 3 mètres lorsque vous ne portez pas d'armure lourde. Vous disposez également d'une vitesse d'escalade et d'une vitesse de nage égales à votre vitesse.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Ranger.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Expertise
entries: Choisissez deux compétences pour lesquelles vous manquez d'expertise. Vous gagnez alors de l'expertise dans ces compétences.

classFeatures.name: Infatigable
entries: Les forces primordiales vous aident désormais à alimenter vos voyages, vous octroyant les avantages suivants.

Par une action magique, vous pouvez vous octroyer un nombre de points de vie temporaires égal à 1d8 plus votre modificateur de Sagesse (minimum 1). Vous pouvez utiliser cette action un nombre de fois égal à votre modificateur de Sagesse (minimum une fois), et vous récupérez toutes vos utilisations après un repos long.
entries.name: Points de vie temporaires
Réduction de la fatigue
entries: Chaque fois que vous terminez un court repos, votre niveau de fatigue, le cas échéant, diminue de 1.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Ranger.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Chasseur implacable
entries: Les dégâts subis ne peuvent pas interrompre votre concentration sur la Marque du chasseur.

classFeatures.name: Le voile de la nature
entries: Vous invoquez les esprits de la nature pour vous dissimuler par magie. Par une action bonus, vous pouvez vous conférer l' état Invisible jusqu'à la fin de votre prochain tour.
Vous pouvez utiliser cette capacité un nombre de fois égal à votre modificateur de Sagesse (minimum une fois), et vous récupérez toutes les utilisations dépensées lorsque vous terminez un repos long.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Ranger.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Chasseur précis
entries: Vous bénéficiez d'un avantage aux jets d'attaque contre la créature actuellement marquée par votre Marque du Chasseur.

classFeatures.name: Sens sauvages
entries: Votre lien avec les forces de la nature vous confère la vision aveugle d'une portée de 9 mètres.

classFeatures.name: Bénédiction épique
entries: Vous obtenez un don de  {@filter Don épique feat|feats|category=EB} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html}de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises. Le {@feat Don de Voyage Dimensionnel|PHB24} de sorts est recommandé.

classFeatures.name: Tueur d’ennemis
entries: Le dé de dégâts de votre Marque du Chasseur est un d10 plutôt qu'un d6.

subclassFeatures.name: Beast Master
entries: The Beast Master archetype embodies a friendship between the civilized races et the beasts of the world. United in focus, beast et ranger work as one to fight the monstrous foes that threaten civilization et the wilderness alike. Emulating the Beast Master archetype means committing yourself to this ideal, working in partnership with an animal as its companion et friend.

subclassFeatures.name: Primal Companion
entries: {@i 3rd-level Beast Master variant feature, which replaces the Ranger's Companion feature}

You magically summon a primal beast, which draws strength from your bond with nature. The beast is friendly to you et your companions et obeys your commets. Choose its stat block—{@creature Beast of the Let|TCE}, {@creature Beast of the Sea|TCE}, or {@creature Beast of the Sky|TCE}—which uses your proficiency bonus (PB) in several places. You also determine the kind of animal the beast is, choosing a kind appropriate for the stat block. Whatever kind you choose, the beast bears primal markings, indicating its mystical origin.

In combat, the beast acts during your turn. It can move et use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge} action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to commet it to take another action. That action can be one in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack} action to commet the beast to take the {@action Attack} action. If you are {@condition incapacitated}, the beast can take any action of its choice, not just {@action Dodge}.

If the beast has died within the last hour, you can use your action to touch it et expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher. The beast returns to life after 1 minute with all its hit points restored.

When you finish a long rest, you can summon a different primal beast. The new beast appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, et you choose its stat block et appearance. If you already have a beast from this feature, it vanishes when the new beast appears. The beast also vanishes if you die.

subclassFeatures.name: Ranger's Companion
entries: You gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures et is trained to fight alongside you. Choose a {@filter beast that is no larger than Medium et that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/4]|type=beast|size=f;d;t;s;m|miscellaneous=!swarm}. Add your proficiency bonus to the beast's AC, attack rolls, et damage rolls, as well as to any saving throws et skills it is proficient in. Its hit point maximum equals its normal maximum or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher. Like any creature, the beast can spend Hit Dice during a short rest.

The beast obeys your commets as best as it can. It takes its turn on your initiative. On your turn, you can verbally commet the beast where to move (no action required by you). You can use your action to verbally commet it to take the {@action Attack}, {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Help} action. If you don't issue a commet, the beast takes the {@action Dodge} action. Once you have the Extra Attack feature, you can make one weapon attack yourself when you commet the beast to take the {@action Attack} action.

If you are {@condition incapacitated} or absent, your beast companion acts on its own, focusing on protecting you et itself. It never requires your commet to use its reaction, such as when making an opportunity attack.
While traveling through your favored terrain with only the beast, you can move stealthily at a normal pace.
If the beast dies, you can obtain a new companion by spending 8 hours magically bonding with a beast that isn't hostile to you et that meets the requirements.

subclassFeatures.name: Exceptional Training
entries: Beginning at 7th level, on any of your turns when your beast companion doesn't attack, you can use a bonus action to commet the beast to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Help} action on its turn. In addition, the beast's attacks now count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance et immunity to nonmagical attacks et damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Bestial Fury
entries: Starting at 11th level, when you commet your beast companion to take the {@action Attack} action, the beast can make two attacks, or it can take the Multiattack action if it has that action.

subclassFeatures.name: Share Spells
entries: Beginning at 15th level, when you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter
entries: Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization et the terrors of the wilderness. As you walk the Hunter's path, you learn specialized techniques for fighting the threats you face, from rampaging ogres et hordes of orcs to towering giants et terrifying dragons.

subclassFeatures.name: Horde Breaker
entries: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target et within range of your weapon.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter's Prey
entries: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Colossus Slayer
entries: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra {@damage 1d8} damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Giant Killer
entries: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

subclassFeatures.name: Defensive Tactics
entries: At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Escape the Horde
entries: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

subclassFeatures.name: Multiattack Defense
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Steel Will
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

subclassFeatures.name: Multiattack
entries: At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Volley
entries: You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, et you make a separate attack roll for each target.

subclassFeatures.name: Whirlwind Attack
entries: You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

subclassFeatures.name: Evasion
entries: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a {@spell lightning bolt} spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, et only half damage if you fail.

subclassFeatures.name: Stet Against the Tide
entries: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
entries: At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

subclassFeatures.name: Gloom Stalker
entries: Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places: deep under the earth, in gloomy alleyways, in primeval forests, et wherever else the light dims. Most folk enter such places with trepidation, but a Gloom Stalker ventures boldly into the darkness, seeking to ambush threats before they can reach the broader world. Such rangers are often found in the Underdark, but they will go any place where evil lurks in the shadows.

subclassFeatures.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier.

At the start of your first turn of each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, which lasts until the end of that turn. If you take the {@action Attack} action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} damage of the weapon's damage type.

subclassFeatures.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Gloom Stalker Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeatures.name: Umbral Sight
entries: At 3rd level, you gain {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision} from your race, its range increases by 30 feet.

You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on {@sense darkvision}. While in darkness, you are {@condition invisible} to any creature that relies on {@sense darkvision} to see you in that darkness.

subclassFeatures.name: Iron Mind
entries: By 7th level, you have honed your ability to resist the mind-altering powers of your prey. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

subclassFeatures.name: Stalker's Flurry
entries: At 11th level, you learn to attack with such unexpected speed that you can turn a miss into another strike. Once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadowy Dodge
entries: Starting at 15th level, you can dodge in unforeseen ways, with wisps of supernatural shadow around you. Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you et doesn't have advantage on the roll, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on it. You must use this feature before you know the outcome of the attack roll.

subclassFeatures.name: Horizon Walker
entries: Horizon Walkers guard the world against threats that originate from other planes or that seek to ravage the mortal realm with otherworldly magic. They seek out planar portals et keep watch over them, venturing to the Inner Planes et the Outer Planes as needed to pursue their foes. These rangers are also friends to any forces in the multiverse—especially benevolent dragons, fey, et elementals—that work to preserve life et the order of the planes.

subclassFeatures.name: Detect Portal
entries: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to magically sense the presence of a planar portal. As an action, you detect the distance et direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile of you.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
See the "Planar Travel" section in chapter 2 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for examples of planar portals.

subclassFeatures.name: Horizon Walker Magic
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Horizon Walker Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeatures.name: Planar Warrior
entries: At 3rd level, you learn to draw on the energy of the multiverse to augment your attacks.

As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The next time you hit that creature on this turn with a weapon attack, all damage dealt by the attack becomes force damage, et the creature takes an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage from the attack. When you reach 11th level in this class, the extra damage increases to {@damage 2d8}.

subclassFeatures.name: Ethereal Step
entries: At 7th level, you learn to step through the Ethereal Plane. As a bonus action, you can cast the {@spell etherealness} spell with this feature, without expending a spell slot, but the spell ends at the end of the current turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Distant Strike
entries: At 11th level, you gain the ability to pass between the planes in the blink of an eye. When you take the {@action Attack} action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see.
If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make one additional attack with it against a third creature.

subclassFeatures.name: Spectral Defense
entries: At 15th level, your ability to move between planes enables you to slip through the planar boundaries to lessen the harm done to you during battle. When you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage on this turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Monster Slayer
entries: You have dedicated yourself to hunting down creatures of the night et wielders of grim magic. A Monster Slayer seeks out vampires, dragons, evil fey, fiends, et other magical threats. Trained in supernatural techniques to overcome such monsters, slayers are experts at unearthing et defeating mighty, mystical foes.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter's Sense
entries: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to peer at a creature et magically discern how best to hurt it. As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You immediately learn whether the creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities et what they are. If the creature is hidden from divination magic, you sense that it has no damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Monster Slayer Magic
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Monster Slayer Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeatures.name: Slayer's Prey
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can focus your ire on one foe, increasing the harm you inflict on it. As a bonus action, you designate one creature you can see within 60 feet of you as the target of this feature. The first time each turn that you hit that target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage from the weapon.
This benefit lasts until you finish a short or long rest. It ends early if you designate a different creature.

subclassFeatures.name: Supernatural Defense
entries: At 7th level, you gain extra resilience against your prey's assaults on your mind et body. Whenever the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw et whenever you make an ability check to escape that target's grapple, add {@dice 1d6} to your roll.

subclassFeatures.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
entries: At 11th level, you gain the ability to thwart someone else's magic. When you see a creature casting a spell or teleporting within 60 feet of you, you can use your reaction to try to magically foil it. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, or its spell or teleport fails et is wasted.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Slayer's Counter
entries: At 15th level, you gain the ability to counterattack when your prey tries to sabotage you. If the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the quarry. You make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. If your attack hits, your save automatically succeeds, in addition to the attack's normal effects.

subclassFeatures.name: Fey Weterer
entries: A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey, the shining fruit you ate from a talking tree, the magic spring you swam in, or some other auspicious event. However you acquired your fey magic, you are now a Fey Weterer, a ranger who represents both the mortal et the fey realms. As you weter the multiverse, your joyful laughter brightens the hearts of the downtrodden, et your martial prowess strikes terror in your foes, for great is the mirth of the fey et dreadful is their fury.

subclassFeatures.name: Dreadful Strikes
entries: {@i 3rd-level Fey Weterer feature}

You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic, drawn from the gloomy hollows of the Feywild. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} psychic damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn.
The extra damage increases to {@damage 1d6} when you reach 11th level in this class.

subclassFeatures.name: Fey Weterer Magic
entries: {@i 3rd-level Fey Weterer feature}

You learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Fey Weterer Spells table. Each spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.
You also possess a preternatural blessing from a fey ally or a place of fey power. Choose your blessing from the Feywild Gifts table or determine it retomly.

entries.caption: Feywild Gifts
rows: Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a short or long rest.
Fresh, seasonal flowers sprout from your hair each dawn.
You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice.
Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it.
Horns or antlers sprout from your head.
Your skin et hair change color to match the season at each dawn.

subclassFeatures.name: Otherworldly Glamour
entries: {@i 3rd-level Fey Weterer feature}
Your fey qualities give you a supernatural charm. As a result, whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
In addition, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

subclassFeatures.name: Beguiling Twist
entries: {@i 7th-level Fey Weterer feature}
The magic of the Feywild guards your mind. You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, you can use your reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. If the save fails, the target is {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} by you (your choice) for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

subclassFeatures.name: Fey Reinforcements
entries: {@i 11th-level Fey Weterer feature}

The royal courts of the Feywild have blessed you with the assistance of fey beings: you know {@spell summon fey|tce}. It doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know, et you can cast it without a material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, et you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.
Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status concentration}. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

subclassFeatures.name: Misty Weterer
entries: {@i 15th-level Fey Weterer feature}

You can slip in et out of the Feywild to move in a blink of an eye: you can cast {@spell misty step} without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

In addition, whenever you cast {@i misty step}, you can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you. That creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination space.

subclassFeatures.name: Swarmkeeper
entries: Feeling a deep connection to the environment around them, some rangers reach out through their magical connection to the world et bond with a swarm of nature spirits. The swarm becomes a potent force in battle, as well as helpful company for the ranger. Some Swarmkeepers are outcasts or hermits, keeping to themselves et their attendant swarms rather than dealing with the discomfort of others. Other Swarmkeepers enjoy building vibrant communities that work for the mutual benefit of all those they consider part of their swarm.

subclassFeatures.name: Gathered Swarm
entries: {@i 3rd-level Swarmkeeper feature}

A swarm of intangible nature spirits has bonded itself to you et can assist you in battle. While you're alive, the swarm remains in your space, crawling on you or flying et skittering around you within your space. You determine its appearance, or you generate its appearance by rolling on the Swarm Appearance table.
Once on each of your turns, you can cause the swarm to assist you in one of the following ways, immediately after you hit a creature with an attack:

items: The attack's target takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage from the swarm.
The attack's target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be moved by the swarm up to 15 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.
You are moved by the swarm 5 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.

entries.name: It's Your Swarm
entries: A Swarmkeeper's swarm et spells are reflections of the character's bond with nature spirits. Take the opportunity to describe the swarm et the ranger's magic in play. For example, when your ranger casts gaseous form, they might appear to melt into the swarm, instead of a cloud of mist, or the {@spell arcane eye} spell could create an extension of your swarm that spies for you. Such descriptions don't change the effects of spells, but they are an exciting opportunity to explore your character's narrative through their class abilities. For more guidance on customizing spells, see the "Personalizing Spells" section in chapter 3.

Also, remember that the swarm's appearance is yours to customize, et don't feel confined to a single appearance. Perhaps the spirits' look changes with the ranger's mood or with the seasons. You decide!

subclassFeatures.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
entries: {@i 3rd-level Swarmkeeper feature}
You learn the {@spell mage het} cantrip if you don't already know it. When you cast it, the het takes the form of your swarming nature spirits.

You also learn an additional spell of 1st level or higher when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Swarmkeeper Spells table. Each spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeatures.name: Writhing Tide
entries: {@i 7th-level Swarmkeeper feature}

You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet et can hover. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are {@condition incapacitated}.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Mighty Swarm
entries: {@i 11th-level Swarmkeeper feature}
Your Gathered Swarm grows mightier in the following ways:

items: The damage of Gathered Swarm increases to {@damage 1d8}.
If a creature fails its saving throw against being moved by Gathered Swarm, you can also cause the swarm to knock the creature {@condition prone}.
When you are moved by Gathered Swarm, it gives you {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Swarming Dispersal
entries: {@i 15th-level Swarmkeeper feature}

You can discorporate into your swarm, avoiding danger. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that damage. You vanish into your swarm et then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you, where you reappear with the swarm.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Drakewarden
entries: Your connection to the natural world takes the form of a draconic spirit, which can manifest in physical form as a drake. As your powers grow, your drake grows as well, blossoming from a small four-legged companion to a majestic winged creature large et strong enough for you to ride. Along the way, you gain an increasing share of the awe-inspiring power of dragons.
Consider the source of the draconic spirit you have bonded with. The Drakewarden Origin table offers examples.

entries.caption: Drakewarden Origin
rows: You studied a dragon's scale or claw, or a trinket from a dragon's hoard, creating your bond through that token's lingering draconic magic.
A secret order of rangers who collect et guard draconic lore taught you their ways.
A dragon gave you a geode or gemstone to care for. To your surprise, the drake hatched from that stone.
You ingested a few drops of dragon blood, forever infusing your nature magic with draconic power.
An ancient Draconic inscription on a steting stone empowered you when you read it aloud.
You had a vivid dream of a mysterious figure accompanied by seven yellow canaries, who warned you of impending doom. When you awoke, your drake was there, watching you.

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Gift
entries: {@i 3rd-level Drakewarden feature}
The bond you share with your drake creates a connection to dragonkind, granting you understeting et empowering your presence. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Thaumaturgy
items.entry: You learn the {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip, which is a ranger spell for you.

items.name: Tongue of Dragons
items.entry: You learn to speak, read, et write Draconic or one other language of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Drake Companion
entries: {@i 3rd-level Drakewarden feature}
As an action, you can magically summon the drake that is bound to you. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of you.

The drake is friendly to you et your companions, et it obeys your commets. See its game statistics in the accompanying {@creature Drake Companion|FTD} stat block, which uses your proficiency bonus (PB) in several places. Whenever you summon the drake, choose a damage type listed in its Draconic Essence trait. You can determine the cosmetic characteristics of the drake, such as its color, its scale texture, or any visible effect of its Draconic Essence; your choice has no effect on its game statistics.

In combat, the drake shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move et use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the {@action Dodge} action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to commet it to take another action. That action can be one in its stat block or some other action. If you are {@condition incapacitated}, the drake can take any action of its choice, not just {@action Dodge}.

The drake remains until it is reduced to 0 hit points, until you use this feature to summon the drake again, or until you die. Anything the drake was wearing or carrying is left behind when the drake vanishes.
Once you summon the drake, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to summon it.

subclassFeatures.name: Bond of Fang et Scale
entries: {@i 7th-level Drakewarden feature}
The bond you share with your drake intensifies, protecting you et stoking the drake's fury. When you summon your drake, it grows wings on its back et gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed.
In addition, while your drake is summoned, you et the drake gain the following benefits:

items.name: Drake Mount
entries: The drake grows to Medium size. Reflecting your special bond, you can use the drake as a mount if your size is Medium or smaller. While you are riding your drake, it can't use the flying speed of this feature.

items.name: Magic Fang
entries: The drake's Bite attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence.

items.name: Resistance
entries: You gain resistance to the damage type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence.

subclassFeatures.name: Drake's Breath
entries: {@i 11th-level Drakewarden feature}

As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of damaging breath or cause your drake to exhale it. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice doesn't have to match your drake's Draconic Essence). Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 8d6} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
This damage increases to {@damage 10d6} when you reach 15th level in this class.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher to use it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Perfected Bond
entries: {@i 15th-level Drakewarden feature}
Your bond to your drake reaches the pinnacle of its power. While your drake is summoned, you et the drake gain the following benefits:

items.name: Empowered Bite
entries: The drake's Bite attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the type chosen for its Draconic Essence (for a total of {@damage 2d6} extra damage).

items.name: Large Drake
entries: The drake grows to Large size. When you ride your drake, it is no longer prohibited from using the flying speed of Bond of Fang et Scale.

items.name: Reflexive Resistance
entries: When either you or the drake takes damage while you're within 30 feet of each other, you can use your reaction to give yourself or the drake resistance to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Beast Master
entries: {@i Bond with a Primal Beast}
A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic et a deep connection to the natural world.

subclassFeatures.name: Primal Companion
entries: You magically summon a primal beast, which draws strength from your bond with nature. Choose its stat block: {@creature Beast of the Let|PHB24}, {@creature Beast of the Sea|PHB24}, or {@creature Beast of the Sky|PHB24}. You also determine the kind of animal it is, choosing a kind appropriate for the stat block. Whatever beast you choose, it bears primal markings indicating its supernatural origin.
The beast is Friendly to you et your allies et obeys your commets. It vanishes if you die.

entries.name: The Beast in Combat
entries: In combat, the beast acts during your turn. It can move et use its {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge|PHB24} action unless you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} to commet it to take an action in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack|PHB24} action to commet the beast to take the Beast's Strike action. If you have the {@condition Incapacitated|PHB24} condition, the beast acts on its own et isn't limited to the {@action Dodge|PHB24} action.

entries.name: Restoring or Replacing the Beast
entries: If the beast has died within the last hour, you can take a {@action Magic|PHB24} action to touch it et expend a spell slot. The beast returns to life after 1 minute with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} restored.

Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you can summon a different primal beast, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You choose its stat block et appearance. If you already have a beast from this feature, the old one vanishes when the new one appears.

subclassFeatures.name: Exceptional Training
entries: When you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} to commet your Primal Companion beast to take an action, you can also commet it to take the {@action Dash|PHB24}, {@action Disengage|PHB24}, {@action Dodge|PHB24}, or {@action Help|PHB24} action using its {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}.
In addition, whenever it hits with an attack roll et deals damage, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

subclassFeatures.name: Bestial Fury
entries: When you commet your Primal Companion beast to take the Beast's Strike action, the beast can use it twice.
In addition, the first time each turn it hits a creature under the effect of your {@spell Hunter's Mark|PHB24} spell, the beast deals extra Force damage equal to the bonus damage of that spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Share Spells
entries: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your Primal Companion beast with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

subclassFeatures.name: Fey Weterer
entries: {@i Wield Fey Mirth et Fury}

A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey or a location in the Feywild that transformed you. However you gained fey magic, you are now a Fey Weterer. Your joyful laughter brightens the hearts of the downtrodden, et your martial prowess strikes terror in your foes, for great is the mirth of the fey et dreadful is their fury.

subclassFeatures.name: Dreadful Strikes
entries: You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic drawn from the murky hollows of the Feywild. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn. The extra damage increases to {@damage 1d6} when you reach Ranger level 11.

subclassFeatures.name: Fey Weterer Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Fey Weterer Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
You also possess a fey blessing. Choose it from the Feywild Gifts table or determine it retomly.

entries.caption: Feywild Gifts
rows: Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.
Flowers bloom from your hair each dawn.
You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice.
Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it.
Horns or antlers sprout from your head.
Your skin et hair change color each dawn.

subclassFeatures.name: Otherworldly Glamour
entries: Whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
You also gain proficiency in one of these skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|PHB24}, {@skill Performance|PHB24}, or {@skill Persuasion|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Beguiling Twist
entries: The magic of the Feywild guards your mind. You have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|PHB24} or {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition.

In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|PHB24} or {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself to make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Charmed|PHB24} or {@condition Frightened|PHB24} (your choice) for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

subclassFeatures.name: Fey Reinforcements
entries: You can cast {@spell Summon Fey|PHB24} without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, et you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.
Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|PHB24}. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

subclassFeatures.name: Misty Weterer
entries: You can cast {@spell Misty Step|PHB24} without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

In addition, whenever you cast {@spell Misty Step|PHB24}, you can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself. That creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination space.

subclassFeatures.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: You have mastered the art of creating fearsome ambushes, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Ambusher's Leap
entries: At the start of your first turn of each combat, your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

entries.name: Dreadful Strike
entries: When you attack a creature et hit it with a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage. You can use this benefit only once per turn, you can use it a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

entries.name: Initiative Bonus
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24}, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the roll.

subclassFeatures.name: Gloom Stalker
entries: {@i Draw on Shadow Magic to Fight Your Foes}
Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places, wielding magic drawn from the Shadowfell to combat enemies that lurk in darkness.

subclassFeatures.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Gloom Stalker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeatures.name: Umbral Sight
entries: You gain {@sense Darkvision|PHB24} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|PHB24} when you gain this feature, its range increases by 60 feet.

You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on {@sense Darkvision|PHB24}. While entirely in {@variantrule Darkness|PHB24}, you have the {@condition Invisible|PHB24} condition to any creature that relies on {@sense Darkvision|PHB24} to see you in that {@variantrule Darkness|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Iron Mind
entries: You have honed your ability to resist mind-altering powers. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

subclassFeatures.name: Stalker's Flurry
entries: The Psychic damage of your Dreadful Strike becomes {@damage 2d8}. In addition, when you use the Dreadful Strike effect of your Dread Ambusher feature, you can cause one of the following additional effects.

entries.name: Sudden Strike
entries: You can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target et that is within the weapon's range.

entries.name: Mass Fear
entries: The target et each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadowy Dodge
entries: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} on that roll. Whether the attack hits or misses, you can then teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter
entries: {@i Protect Nature et People from Destruction}
You stalk prey in the wilds et elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature et people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter's Lore
entries: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal certain strengths et weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, et if the creature has any, you know what they are.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter's Prey
entries: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

entries.name: Colossus Slayer
entries: Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage to the target if it's missing any of its {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24}. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

entries.name: Horde Breaker
entries: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, et that you haven't attacked this turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Defensive Tactics
entries: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

entries.name: Escape the Horde
entries: {@action Opportunity Attack|PHB24|Opportunity Attacks} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} against you.

entries.name: Multiattack Defense
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
entries: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

subclassFeatures.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
entries: When you take damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to give yourself {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to that damage et any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Frigid Explorer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Biting Cold
entries: Damage from your weapon attacks, Ranger spells, et Ranger features ignores {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Frost Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Polar Strikes
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Cold damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn. When you reach Ranger level 11, this extra damage increases to {@dice 1d6}.

subclassFeatures.name: Hunter's Rime
entries: Ice rimes you et your prey, protecting you et slowing them. When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|PHB24}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|PHB24} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your {@class Ranger|PHB24} level.
Additionally, while a creature is marked by your {@spell Hunter's Mark|PHB24}, it can't take the {@action Disengage|PHB24} action.

subclassFeatures.name: Winter Walker
entries: {@i Withstet the Horrors of Frigid Wastelets}

Winter Walkers hone their craft in the bleak et frozen wilds of places like Icewind Dale. These ruthless, rimed Rangers hunt monsters that haunt arctic wastelets, eventually becoming frigid terrors themselves. Winter Walkers are well versed in the phenomena of Icewind Dale, including the latent magic of fallen Netherese cities, endemic monsters like {@creature yeti|XMM|yetis} et {@creature crag cat|SKT|crag cats}, et the rising threat of Underdark invaders. Due to their cold pragmatism, terrifying magic, et mastery of the region, Winter Walkers are regarded with equal parts respect et fear. Ten-Towns citizens say that Winter Walkers' frequent exposure to malignant entities gives them their fearsome powers. Many Reghed nomads, on the other het, believe that nature spirits bestow on Winter Walkers a unique curse.

subclassFeatures.name: Winter Walker Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Winter Walker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeatures.name: Fortifying Soul
entries: Your experience surviving harrowing environments allows you to bolster your allies in addition to yourself. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). Each chosen creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Ranger level et has {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition for 1 hour.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Chilling Retribution
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Stunned|PHB24} condition until the end of your next turn. While the target is {@condition Stunned|PHB24}, its {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} is reduced to 0 feet.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Frozen Haunt
entries: When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|PHB24}, you can adopt a ghostly, snowy form. This form lasts until the spell ends, et while you are in this form, you gain the following benefits. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Frozen Soul
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|PHB24} to Cold damage. When you first adopt this form et at the start of each of your subsequent turns, each creature of your choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} originating from you takes {@damage 2d4} Cold damage.

entries.name: Partially Incorporeal
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|PHB24} to the {@condition Grappled|PHB24}, {@condition Prone|PHB24}, et {@condition Restrained|PHB24} conditions. You can move through creatures et objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|PHB24}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object. If the form ends while you are inside a creature or an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

subclassFeatures.name: Hollow Warden
entries: {@i Draw on the Might of Ancient Wild Terrors}

Legends tell that the most ancient et bloodthirsty terrors lurk deep within the old places of the earth. Hollow Wardens venerate et draw power from such beings, transforming themselves into merciless et monstrous guardians that stalk jagged coastlines, steep mountain crags, et other dark et wild places.

subclassFeatures.name: Hollow Warden Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Hollow Warden Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spell prepared.

subclassFeatures.name: Wrath of the Wild
entries: You draw power from the strange et ancient horrors of the let, causing you to sprout unnatural growths, such as bloody antlers or putrid fangs, or causing your shadow to lengthen or twist around you. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can expend a use of {@classFeature Favored Enemy|Ranger|PHB24|1} to transform into a ghastly form, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|PHB24} condition, die, or end the transformation (no action required).

entries.name: Ancient Armor
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC, as your body is wreathed in rotten bark et beastly bristles. This bonus increases to +2 when you reach Ranger level 11.

entries.name: Prowling Retribution
entries: Immediately after a creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself deals damage to you or one of your allies, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack|PHB24} against that creature.

entries.name: Unnerving Aura
entries: When you transform et at the start of each of your subsequent turns, each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} originating from you makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Hungering Might
entries: You gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

In addition, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll while you are transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Wisdom modifier, provided you are {@status Bloodied|PHB24} when you hit.

subclassFeatures.name: Rot et Violence
entries: Your dedication to wild eldritch beings alters you further. When transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you gain the following additional benefits.

entries.name: Menacing Aura
entries: When a creature fails its saving throw against your Unnerving Aura, it also can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} or take {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24|Reactions} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Strangling Roots
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can activate the {@itemMastery Sap} or {@itemMastery Slow} mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with that weapon.

subclassFeatures.name: Ancient Might
entries: You become wholly suffused with the wild's ancient et terrible power, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Ominous Strikes
entries: When you hit a creature that has the {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition with an attack roll, that attack deals extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Persistent Wrath
entries: If you're reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} but not killed outright while transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you can surge with wild power. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} instead change to a number equal to twice your Ranger level. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}. You can also expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of this feature.

entries.name: Timeless
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|PHB24} to the {@condition Exhaustion|PHB24} condition.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Noble Genies
subclassFeatures: Oath of the Noble Genies|Paladin|PHB24|Noble Genies|FRHoF|3
Oath of the Noble Genies|Paladin|PHB24|Noble Genies|FRHoF|3

classFeatures.name: Imposition des mains
entries: Votre toucher béni peut guérir les blessures. Vous disposez d'une réserve de pouvoir de guérison qui se reconstitue après un repos long. Grâce à cette réserve, vous pouvez restaurer un nombre total de points de vie égal à cinq fois votre niveau de paladin.

En tant qu'action bonus, vous pouvez toucher une créature (qui pourrait être vous-même) et puiser de l'énergie dans la réserve de guérison pour restaurer un certain nombre de points de vie à cette créature, jusqu'à concurrence du montant maximum restant dans la réserve.

Vous pouvez également dépenser 5 points de vie de votre réserve de pouvoir de guérison pour supprimer l' état Empoisonné de la créature ; ces points ne restaurent pas non plus les points de vie de la créature.

classFeatures.name: Incantation
entries: Vous avez appris à lancer des sorts par la prière et la méditation. Consultez le chapitre 7 pour connaître les règles relatives aux sorts. Les informations ci-dessous détaillent comment appliquer ces règles aux sorts de paladin, qui figurent dans la liste des sorts de paladin plus loin dans la description de la classe.

entries.name: Emplacements de sorts
entries: Le tableau des capacités du paladin indique le nombre d'emplacements de sorts dont vous disposez pour lancer vos sorts de niveau 1 et plus. Vous récupérez tous vos emplacements dépensés après un repos long.

entries.name: Sorts préparés de niveau 1 et plus
entries: Vous préparez la liste des sorts de niveau 1 et plus que vous pouvez lancer grâce à cette capacité. Pour commencer, choisissez deux sorts de paladin de niveau 1. {@spell Héroïsme} et {@spell Châtiment brûlant} sont recommandés.

Le nombre de sorts de votre liste augmente à mesure que vous gagnez des niveaux de paladin, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Sorts préparés » du tableau des aptitudes du paladin. À chaque augmentation de ce nombre, choisissez des sorts de paladin supplémentaires jusqu'à ce que votre liste contienne autant de sorts que celle du tableau. Les sorts choisis doivent être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts. Par exemple, si vous êtes un paladin de niveau 5, votre liste de sorts préparés peut inclure six sorts de paladin de niveau 1 ou 2, dans n'importe quelle combinaison.

Si une autre capacité de paladin vous donne des sorts que vous avez toujours préparés, ces sorts ne sont pas comptabilisés dans le nombre de sorts que vous pouvez préparer avec cette capacité, mais ils sont par ailleurs considérés comme des sorts de paladin.

entries.name: Modification de vos sorts préparés
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un repos long, vous pouvez remplacer un sort de votre liste par un autre sort de paladin pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts.

entries.name: Capacité d'incantation
entries: Le Charisme est votre caractéristique d'incantation pour vos sorts de paladin.

entries.name: Focalisation de sorts
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser un symbole sacré comme focalisateur de sorts pour vos sorts de paladin.

classFeatures.name: Maîtrise des armes
entries: Votre entraînement aux armes vous permet d'utiliser les propriétés de maîtrise de deux types d' armes de votre choix avec lesquels vous avez une certaine compétence, comme les épées longues et les javelots.
