entries: Starting at 18th level, you can choose two allies within 60 feet of you, rather than one.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Archer
entries: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects. Arcane Archers are some of the most elite warriors among the elves. They stet watch over the fringes of elven domains, keeping a keen eye out for trespassers et using magic-infused arrows to defeat monsters et invaders before they can reach elven settlements. Over the centuries, the methods of these elf archers have been learned by members of other races who can also balance arcane aptitude with archery.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Archer Lore
entries: At 3rd level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature—typical for practitioners of this elven martial tradition. You choose to gain proficiency in either the {@skill Arcana} or the {@skill Nature} skill, et you choose to learn either the {@spell prestidigitation} or the {@spell druidcraft} cantrip.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Shot
entries: At 3rd level, you learn to unleash special magical effects with some of your shots. When you gain this feature, you learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice (see "Arcane Shot Options" below).

Once per turn when you fire an arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the {@action Attack} action, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to that arrow. You decide to use the option when the arrow hits a creature, unless the option doesn't involve an attack roll. You have two uses of this ability, et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a short or long rest.
You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach certain levels in this class: 7th, 10th, 15th, et 18th level. Each option also improves when you become an 18th-level fighter.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Shot Options
entries: The Arcane Shot feature lets you choose options for it at certain levels. The options are presented here in alphabetical order. They are all magical effects, et each one is associated with one of the schools of magic.
If an option requires a saving throw, your Arcane Shot save DC is calculated as follows:

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 7th level.

subclassFeatures.name: Curving Shot
entries: At 7th level, you learn how to direct an errant arrow toward a new target. When you make an attack roll with a magic arrow et miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack roll against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.

subclassFeatures.name: Magic Arrow
entries: At 7th level, you gain the ability to infuse arrows with magic. Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance et immunity to nonmagical attacks et damage. The magic fades from the arrow immediately after it hits or misses its target.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 10th level.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 15th level.

subclassFeatures.name: Ever-Ready Shot
entries: Starting at 15th level, your magical archery is available whenever battle starts. If you roll initiative et have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Arcane Shot Option
entries: You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach 18th level. Each option also improves when you become an 18th-level fighter.

subclassFeatures.name: Cavalier
entries: The archetypal Cavalier excels at mounted combat. Usually born among the nobility et raised at court, a Cavalier is equally at home leading a cavalry charge or exchanging repartee at a state dinner. Cavaliers also learn how to guard those in their charge from harm, often serving as the protectors of their superiors et of the weak. Compelled to right wrongs or earn prestige, many of these fighters leave their lives of comfort to embark on glorious adventure.

subclassFeatures.name: Bonus Proficiency
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Hetling}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Born to the Saddle
entries: Starting at 3rd level, your mastery as a rider becomes apparent. You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off your mount et descend no more than 10 feet, you can let on your feet if you're not {@condition incapacitated}.
Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your speed.

subclassFeatures.name: Unwavering Mark
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can menace your foes, foiling their attacks et punishing them for harming others. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark the creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends early if you are {@condition incapacitated} or you die, or if someone else marks the creature.
While it is within 5 feet of you, a creature marked by you has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target you.

In addition, if a creature marked by you deals damage to anyone other than you, you can make a special melee weapon attack against the marked creature as a bonus action on your next turn. You have advantage on the attack roll, et if it hits, the attack's weapon deals extra damage to the target equal to half your fighter level.

Regardless of the number of creatures you mark, you can make this special attack a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Warding Maneuver
entries: At 7th level, you learn to fend off strikes directed at you, your mount, or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can roll {@dice 1d8} as a reaction if you're wielding a melee weapon or a shield. Roll the die, et add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Hold the Line
entries: At 10th level, you become a master of locking down your enemies. Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach, et if you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Ferocious Charger
entries: Starting at 15th level, you can run down your foes, whether you're mounted or not. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature et you hit it with the attack, that target must succeed on a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked {@condition prone}. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

subclassFeatures.name: Vigilant Defender
entries: Starting at 18th level, you respond to danger with extraordinary vigilance. In combat, you get a special reaction that you can take once on every creature's turn, except your turn. You can use this special reaction only to make an opportunity attack, et you can't use it on the same turn that you take your normal reaction.

subclassFeatures.name: Samurai
entries: The Samurai is a fighter who draws on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies. A Samurai's resolve is nearly unbreakable, et the enemies in a Samurai's path have two choices: yield or die fighting.

subclassFeatures.name: Bonus Proficiency
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Fighting Spirit
entries: Starting at 3rd level, your intensity in battle can shield you et help you strike true. As a bonus action on your turn, you can give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the current turn. When you do so, you also gain 5 temporary hit points. The number of temporary hit points increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 10 at 10th level et 15 at 15th level.
You can use this feature three times, et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Elegant Courtier
entries: Starting at 7th level, your discipline et attention to detail allow you to excel in social situations. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Your self-control also causes you to gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

subclassFeatures.name: Tireless Spirit
entries: Starting at 10th level, when you roll initiative et have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.

subclassFeatures.name: Rapid Strike
entries: Starting at 15th level, you learn to trade accuracy for swift strikes. If you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn et have advantage on an attack roll against one of the targets, you can forgo the advantage for that roll to make an additional weapon attack against that target, as part of the same action. You can do so no more than once per turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Strength before Death
entries: Starting at 18th level, your fighting spirit can delay the grasp of death. If you take damage that reduces you to 0 hit points et doesn't kill you outright, you can use your reaction to delay falling {@condition unconscious}, et you can immediately take an extra turn, interrupting the current turn. While you have 0 hit points during that extra turn, taking damage causes death saving throw failures as normal, et three death saving throw failures can still kill you. When the extra turn ends, you fall {@condition unconscious} if you still have 0 hit points.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Echo Knight
entries: A mysterious et feared frontline warrior of the Kryn Dynasty, the Echo Knight has mastered the art of using dunamis to summon the fading shades of unrealized timelines to aid them in battle. Surrounded by echoes of their own might, they charge into the fray as a cycling swarm of shadows et strikes.

subclassFeatures.name: Manifest Echo
entries: {@i 3rd-level Echo Knight feature}

You can use a bonus action to magically manifest an echo of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you. This echo is a magical, translucent, gray image of you that lasts until it is destroyed, until you dismiss it as a bonus action, until you manifest another echo, or until you're {@condition incapacitated}.

Your echo has AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 hit point, et immunity to all conditions. If it has to make a saving throw, it uses your saving throw bonus for the roll. It is the same size as you, et it occupies its space. On your turn, you can mentally commet the echo to move up to 30 feet in any direction (no action required). If your echo is ever more than 30 feet from you at the end of your turn, it is destroyed.
You can use the echo in the following ways:

items: As a bonus action, you can teleport, magically swapping places with your echo at a cost of 15 feet of your movement, regardless of the distance between the two of you.
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, any attack you make with that action can originate from your space or the echo's space. You make this choice for each attack.

When a creature that you can see within 5 feet of your echo moves at least 5 feet away from it, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against that creature as if you were in the echo's space.

subclassFeatures.name: Unleash Incarnation
entries: {@i 3rd-level Echo Knight feature}
You can heighten your echo's fury. Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action, you can make one additional melee attack from the echo's position.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Echo Avatar
entries: {@i 7th-level Echo Knight feature}

You can temporarily transfer your consciousness to your echo. As an action, you can see through your echo's eyes et hear through its ears. During this time, you are {@condition deafened} et {@condition blinded}. You can sustain this effect for up to 10 minutes, et you can end it at any time (requires no action). While your echo is being used in this way, it can be up to 1,000 feet away from you without being destroyed.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadow Martyr
entries: {@i 10th-level Echo Knight feature}

You can make your echo throw itself in front of an attack directed at another creature that you can see. Before the attack roll is made, you can use your reaction to teleport the echo to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the targeted creature. The attack roll that triggered the reaction is instead made against your echo.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Reclaim Potential
entries: {@i 15th-level Echo Knight feature}

You've learned to absorb the fleeting magic of your echo. When an echo of yours is destroyed by taking damage, you can gain a number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice 2d6} + your Constitution modifier, provided you don't already have temporary hit points.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Legion of One
entries: {@i 18th-level Echo Knight feature}

You can use a bonus action to create two echoes with your Manifest Echo feature, et these echoes can coexist. If you try to create a third echo, the previous two echoes are destroyed. Anything you can do from one echo's position can be done from the other's instead.
In addition, when you roll initiative et have no uses of your Unleash Incarnation feature left, you regain one use of that feature.

subclassFeatures.name: Protective Field
entries: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to expend one Psionic Energy die, roll the die, et reduce the damage taken by the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum reduction of 1), as you create a momentary shield of telekinetic force.

subclassFeatures.name: Psi Warrior
entries: Awake to the psionic power within, a Psi Warrior is a fighter who augments their physical might with psi-infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, et barriers of mental force. Many githyanki train to become such warriors, as do some of the most disciplined high elves. In the world of Eberron, many young kalashtar dream of becoming Psi Warriors.

As a Psi Warrior, you might have honed your psionic abilities through solo discipline, unlocked it under the tutelage of a master, or refined it at an academy dedicated to wielding the mind's power as both weapon et shield.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Strike
entries: You can propel your weapons with psionic force. Once on each of your turns, immediately after you hit a target within 30 feet of you with an attack et deal damage to it with a weapon, you can expend one Psionic Energy die, rolling it et dealing force damage to the target equal to the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Movement
entries: You can move an object or a creature with your mind. As an action, you target one loose object that is Large or smaller or one willing creature, other than yourself. If you can see the target et it is within 30 feet of you, you can move it up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, if it is a Tiny object, you can move it to or from your het. Either way, you can move the target horizontally, vertically, or both. Once you take this action, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to take it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Power
entries: {@i 3rd-level Psi Warrior feature}

You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. This energy is represented by your Psionic Energy dice, which are each a {@dice d6}. You have a number of these dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus, et they fuel various psionic powers you have, which are detailed below.

Some of your powers expend the Psionic Energy die they use, as specified in a power's description, et you can't use a power if it requires you to use a die when your dice are all expended. You regain all your expended Psionic Energy dice when you finish a long rest. In addition, as a bonus action, you can regain one expended Psionic Energy die, but you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
When you reach certain levels in this class, the size of your Psionic Energy dice increases: at 5th level ({@dice d8}), 11th level ({@dice d10}), et 17th level ({@dice d12}).
The powers below use your Psionic Energy dice.

subclassFeatures.name: Psi-Powered Leap
entries: As a bonus action, you can propel your body with your mind. You gain a flying speed equal to twice your walking speed until the end of the current turn. Once you take this bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to take it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Thrust
entries: When you deal damage to a target with your Psionic Strike, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier. If the save fails, you can knock the target {@condition prone} or move it up to 10 feet in any direction horizontally.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Adept
entries: {@i 7th-level Psi Warrior feature}
You have mastered new ways to use your telekinetic abilities, detailed below.

subclassFeatures.name: Guarded Mind
entries: {@i 10th-level Psi Warrior feature}

The psionic energy flowing through you has bolstered your mind. You have resistance to psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, you can expend a Psionic Energy die et end every effect on yourself subjecting you to those conditions.

subclassFeatures.name: Bulwark of Force
entries: {@i 15th-level Psi Warrior feature}

You can shield yourself et others with telekinetic force. As a bonus action, you can choose creatures, which can include you, that you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures is protected by {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} for 1 minute or until you're {@condition incapacitated}.
Once you take this bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to take it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Master
entries: {@i 18th-level Psi Warrior feature}

Your ability to move creatures et objects with your mind is matched by few. You can cast the {@spell telekinesis} spell, requiring no components, et your spellcasting ability for the spell is Intelligence. On each of your turns while you concentrate on the spell, including the turn when you cast it, you can make one attack with a weapon as a bonus action.
Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to cast it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Rune Knight
entries: Rune Knights enhance their martial prowess using the supernatural power of runes, an ancient practice that originated with giants. Rune cutters can be found among any family of giants, et you likely learned your methods first or second het from such a mystical artisan. Whether you found the giant's work carved into a hill or cave, learned of the runes from a sage, or met the giant in person, you studied the giant's craft et learned how to apply magic runes to empower your equipment.

subclassFeatures.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: {@i 3rd-level Rune Knight feature}
You gain proficiency with {@item smith's tools|PHB}, et you learn to speak, read, et write {@language Giant}.

subclassFeatures.name: Giant's Might
entries: {@i 3rd-level Rune Knight feature}
You have learned how to imbue yourself with the might of giants. As a bonus action, you magically gain the following benefits, which last for 1 minute:

items: If you are smaller than Large, you become Large, along with anything you are wearing. If you lack the room to become Large, your size doesn't change.
You have advantage on Strength checks et Strength saving throws.
Once on each of your turns, one of your attacks with a weapon or an unarmed strike can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage to a target on a hit.

entries: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Rune Carver
entries: {@i 3rd-level Rune Knight feature}

You can use magic runes to enhance your gear. You learn two runes of your choice, from among the runes described below, et each time you gain a level in this class, you can replace one rune you know with a different one from this feature. When you reach certain levels in this class, you learn additional runes, as shown in the Runes Known table.

Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch a number of objects equal to the number of runes you know, et you inscribe a different rune onto each of the objects. To be eligible, an object must be a weapon, a suit of armor, a shield, a piece of jewelry, or something else you can wear or hold in a het. Your rune remains on an object until you finish a long rest, et an object can bear only one of your runes at a time.

The following runes are available to you when you learn a rune. If a rune has a level requirement, you must be at least that level in this class to learn the rune. If a rune requires a saving throw, your Rune Magic save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Rune Known
entries: {@i 7th-level Rune Knight feature}
You learn an additional Rune.

subclassFeatures.name: Runic Shield
entries: {@i 7th-level Rune Knight feature}

You learn to invoke your rune magic to protect your allies. When another creature you can see within 60 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll the {@dice d20} et use the new roll.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Rune Known
entries: {@i 10th-level Rune Knight feature}
You learn an additional Rune.

subclassFeatures.name: Great Stature
entries: {@i 10th-level Rune Knight feature}
The magic of your runes permanently alters you. When you gain this feature, roll {@dice 3d4}. You grow a number of inches in height equal to the roll.
Moreover, the extra damage you deal with your Giant's Might feature increases to {@dice 1d8}.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Rune Known
entries: {@i 15th-level Rune Knight feature}
You learn an additional Rune.

subclassFeatures.name: Master of Runes
entries: {@i 15th-level Rune Knight feature}
You can invoke each rune you know from your Rune Carver feature twice, rather than once, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Runic Juggernaut
entries: {@i 18th-level Rune Knight feature}

You learn how to amplify your rune-powered transformation. As a result, the extra damage you deal with the Giant's Might feature increases to {@dice 1d10}. Moreover, when you use that feature, your size can increase to Huge, et while you are that size, your reach increases by 5 feet.

subclassFeatures.name: Battle Master
entries: {@i Master Sophisticated Battle Maneuvers}

Battle Masters are students of the art of battle, learning martial techniques passed down through generations. The most accomplished Battle Masters are well-rounded figures who combine their carefully honed combat skills with academic study in the fields of history, theory, et the arts.

subclassFeatures.name: Combat Superiority
entries: Your experience on the battlefield has refined your fighting techniques. You learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called Superiority Dice.

entries.name: Maneuvers
entries: You learn three maneuvers of your choice from the "{@filter Maneuvers Options|optionalfeatures|feature type=MV:B|source=PHB24}" section later in this subclass's description. Many maneuvers enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one maneuver per attack.
You learn two additional maneuvers of your choice when you reach Fighter levels 7, 10, et 15. Each time you learn new maneuvers, you can also replace one maneuver you know with a different one.

entries.name: Superiority Dice
entries: You have four Superiority Dice, which are {@dice d8|d8s}. A Superiority Die is expended when you use it. You regain all expended Superiority Dice when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.
You gain an additional Superiority Die when you reach Fighter levels 7 (five dice total) et 15 (six dice total).

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: If a maneuver requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) et {@variantrule Proficiency|PHB24|Proficiency Bonus}.

subclassFeatures.name: Maneuver Options
entries: The maneuvers are presented here in alphabetical order.

subclassFeatures.name: Student of War
entries: You gain proficiency with one type of {@item Artisan's Tools|PHB24} of your choice, et you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the skills available to Fighters at level 1.

subclassFeatures.name: Know Your Enemy
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can discern certain strengths et weaknesses of a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself; you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, et if the creature has any, you know what they are.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}. You can also restore a use of the feature by expending one Superiority Die (no action required).

subclassFeatures.name: Improved Combat Superiority
entries: Your Superiority Die becomes a {@dice d10}.

subclassFeatures.name: Relentless
entries: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, you can roll {@dice 1d8} et use the number rolled instead of expending a Superiority Die.

subclassFeatures.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
entries: Your Superiority Die becomes a {@dice d12}.

subclassFeatures.name: Champion
entries: {@i Pursue Physical Excellence in Combat}

A Champion focuses on the development of martial prowess in a relentless pursuit of victory. Champions combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows, withstet peril, et garner glory. Whether in athletic contests or bloody battle, Champions strive for the crown of the victor.

subclassFeatures.name: Improved Critical
entries: Your attack rolls with weapons et Unarmed Strikes can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|PHB24} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

subclassFeatures.name: Remarkable Athlete
entries: Thanks to your athleticism, you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24} rolls et Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB24}) checks.

In addition, immediately after you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|PHB24}, you can move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|PHB24|Opportunity Attacks}.

subclassFeatures.name: Additional Fighting Style
entries: You gain another {@filter Fighting Style feat|feats|category=FS} of your choice.

subclassFeatures.name: Heroic Warrior
entries: The thrill of battle drives you toward victory. During combat, you can give yourself {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|PHB24} whenever you start your turn without it.

subclassFeatures.name: Superior Critical
entries: Your attack rolls with weapons et Unarmed Strikes can now score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|PHB24} on a roll of 18–20 on the {@dice d20}.

subclassFeatures.name: Survivor
entries: You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle, giving you these benefits.

entries.name: Defy Death
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|PHB24|Death Saving Throws}. Moreover, when you roll 18–20 on a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|PHB24}, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.

entries.name: Heroic Rally
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are {@status Bloodied|PHB24} et have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24|Hit Point}.

subclassFeatures.name: Eldritch Knight
entries: {@i Support Combat Skills with Arcane Magic}

Eldritch Knights combine the martial mastery common to all Fighters with a careful study of magic. Their spells both complement et extend their combat skills, providing additional protection to shore up their armor et also allowing them to engage many foes at once with explosive magic.

subclassFeatures.name: Spellcasting
entries: You have learned to cast spells. See {@book chapter 7|PHB24|7} for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules as an Eldritch Knight.

entries.name: Sorts Mineur
entries: You know two cantrips of your choice from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard} (see that class's section for its list). {@spell Ray of Frost|PHB24} et {@spell Shocking Grasp|PHB24} are recommended. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard}.
When you reach Fighter level 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

entries.name: Sorts Préparé of Level 1+
entries: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose three level 1 spells from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard}. {@spell Burning Hets|PHB24}, {@spell Jump|PHB24}, et {@spell Shield|PHB24} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Fighter levels, as shown in the Sorts Préparé column of the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard} until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 7 Fighter, your list of prepared spells can include five Wizard spells of levels 1 et 2 in any combination.

entries.name: Changing your Sorts Préparé
entries: Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Wizard spell for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use an {@item Arcane Focus|PHB24} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|PHB24} for your Wizard spells.

subclassFeatures.name: War Bond
entries: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself et one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24}. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon et forge the bond. The bond fails if another Fighter is bonded to the weapon or if the weapon is a magic item to which someone else is attuned.

Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you have the {@condition Incapacitated|PHB24} condition. If it is on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, causing it to teleport instantly to your het.

You can have up to two bonded weapons, but you can summon only one at a time with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.

subclassFeatures.name: War Magic
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|PHB24} action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a casting of one of your Wizard cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

subclassFeatures.name: Eldritch Strike
entries: You learn how to make your weapon strikes undercut a creature's ability to withstet your spells. When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Charge
entries: When you use your Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can teleport before or after the additional action.

subclassFeatures.name: Improved War Magic
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|PHB24} action on your turn, you can replace two of the attacks with a casting of one of your level 1 or level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.

subclassFeatures.name: Psi Warrior
entries: {@i Augment Physical Might with Psionic Power}

Psi Warriors awaken the power of their minds to augment their physical might. They harness this psionic power to infuse their weapon strikes, lash out with telekinetic energy, et create barriers of mental force.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Power
entries: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. It is represented by your Psionic Energy Dice, which fuel powers you have from this subclass. The Psi Warrior Energy Dice table shows the die size et number of these dice you have when you reach certain Fighter levels.

Any features in this subclass that use a Psionic Energy Die use only the dice from this subclass. Some of your powers expend the Psionic Energy Die, as specified in a power's description, et you can't use a power if it requires you to use a die when all your Psionic Energy Dice are expended.
You regain one of your expended Psionic Energy Dice when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24}, et you regain all of them when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Protective Field
entries: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to expend one Psionic Energy Die, roll the die, et reduce the damage taken by the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum reduction of 1), as you create a momentary shield of telekinetic force.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Strike
entries: You can propel your weapons with psionic force. Once on each of your turns, immediately after you hit a target within 30 feet of yourself with an attack et deal damage to it with a weapon, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die, rolling it et dealing Force damage to the target equal to the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Movement
entries: You can move an object or a creature with your mind. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, choose one target you can see within 30 feet of yourself; the target must be a loose object that is Large or smaller or one willing creature other than you. You transport the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, if the target is a Tiny object, you can transport it to or from your het.

Once you take this action, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Psi-Powered Leap
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|PHB24} equal to twice your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} until the end of the current turn. Once you take this {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Adept
entries: You have mastered new ways to use your telekinetic abilities, detailed below.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Thrust
entries: When you deal damage to a target with your Psionic Strike, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Intelligence modifier et {@variantrule Proficiency|PHB24|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, you can give the target the {@condition Prone|PHB24} condition or transport it up to 10 feet horizontally.

subclassFeatures.name: Guarded Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to Psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn with the {@condition Charmed|PHB24} or {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition, you can expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) et end every effect on yourself giving you those conditions.

subclassFeatures.name: Bulwark of Force
entries: You can shield yourself et others with telekinetic force. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can choose creatures, including yourself, within 30 feet of yourself, up to a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures has {@variantrule Cover|PHB24|Half Cover} for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|PHB24} condition.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Telekinetic Master
entries: You always have the {@spell Telekinesis|PHB24} spell prepared. With this feature, you can cast it without a spell slot or components, et your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence. On each of your turns while you maintain {@status Concentration|PHB24} on it, including the turn when you cast it, you can make one attack with a weapon as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}.

Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Banneret
entries: {@i Rally Fellow Heroes with Inspiring Leadership}

Bannerets are paragons of valor et leadership who protect the innocent et rally fellow adventurers to the causes of justice et freedom. Many are knights serving in Cormyr, the Silver Marches, Damara, Chessenta, or other lets across Faerûn. They weter the realms as knights errant, taking the fight against evil beyond their kingdom's borders.

A Banneret relies on judgment, bravery, et fidelity to the code of chivalry to guide them in defeating evildoers. A lone Banneret is a skilled warrior, but when leading a bet of allies one of these warriors can transform even a poorly equipped militia into a ferocious war bet.

subclassFeatures.name: Group Recovery
entries: When you use your Second Wind to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24}, you can choose a number of allies within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} originating from yourself, up to a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of those allies regains {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Fighter level. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Knightly Envoy
entries: You know how to conduct yourself with grace as a noble ambassador. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Comprehension
entries: You can cast the {@spell Comprehend Languages|PHB24} spell but only as a {@variantrule Ritual|PHB24}. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

entries.name: Polyglot
entries: You learn one language from the language tables in the Player's Hetbook or chapter 2 of this book. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you can replace a language learned from this benefit with another language you have heard, seen signed, or read in the past 24 hours.

entries.name: Well Spoken
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Insight|PHB24}, {@skill Intimidation|PHB24}, {@skill Persuasion|PHB24}, or {@skill Performance|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Team Tactics
entries: When you use Group Recovery, each chosen ally has {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on {@variantrule D20 Test|PHB24|D20 Tests} until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Rallying Surge
entries: When you use your Action Surge, you can choose allies within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} originating from yourself, up to a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of those allies can immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to use one of the following options.

entries.name: Attack
entries: The ally makes one attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|PHB24}.

entries.name: Move
entries: The ally moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} without provoking an {@action Opportunity Attack|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Shared Resilience
entries: When an ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself fails a saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to expend a use of your Indomitable feature. The ally can immediately reroll the saving throw with a bonus equal to your Fighter level; the ally must use the new roll.

subclassFeatures.name: Inspiring Commeter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bolstered Rally
entries: The area of effect for both Group Recovery et Rallying Surge is now a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation}.

entries.name: Unshakable Bravery
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|PHB24} to the {@condition Charmed|PHB24} et {@condition Frightened|PHB24} conditions.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Archer
entries: {@i Deploy Magical Effects Through Enchanted Ammunition}

An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects. Over the centuries, other folk have learned this technique et broadened it so it applies to ranged weapons of many kinds et to aspects of adventuring life outside of combat.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Archer Lore
entries: You learn magical theory et secrets of nature, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You know either the {@spell Druidcraft|PHB24} or the {@spell Prestidigitation|PHB24} cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

entries.name: Skills
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|PHB24} et {@skill Nature|PHB24} skills. If you already have one of these proficiencies, you instead gain proficiency in a different skill of your choice from the skills available to Fighters at level 1 (or in two skills available to Fighters at level 1 if you have both).

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Shot
entries: You learn to unleash special magical effects with your shots.

You learn two {@filter Arcane Shot options|optionalfeatures|feature type=AS|source=AU} of your choice. You learn an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach Fighter levels 7, 10, 15, et 18. Each time you learn a new Arcane Shot option, you can also replace one option you know with a different one.

entries.name: Using Arcane Shot
entries: Once per turn when you make a ranged attack using a weapon with the {@itemProperty AF|XDMG|Ammunition} property, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to that attack. You decide to use the option when you hit a creature et deal damage to it unless the option doesn't involve an attack roll.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

entries.name: Arcane Shot Die
entries: Arcane Shot options refer to your Arcane Shot Die. Your Arcane Shot Die is a {@dice d6}.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: If an Arcane Shot option requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Intelligence modifier et {@variantrule Proficiency|PHB24|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: Your Arcane Shot Die changes when you reach certain Fighter levels. The die becomes a {@dice d8} at level 10, a {@dice d10} at level 15, et a {@dice d12} at level 18.

subclassFeatures.name: Arcane Shot Options
entries: The Arcane Shot feature lets you choose options for it at certain levels. The options are presented here in alphabetical order.

subclassFeatures.name: Curving Shot
entries: You learn how to direct an errant shot toward a new target. If you make a ranged attack roll with a weapon with the {@itemProperty AF|XDMG|Ammunition} property et miss, you can cause the shot to ricochet toward a new target as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} immediately after the attack misses. The new target must be a creature you can see within the weapon's range et within 60 feet of the attack's original target. Make an attack roll against the new target.

subclassFeatures.name: Magical Ammunition
entries: You learn to imbue your ammunition with magical properties. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, you can imbue a piece of nonmagical ammunition with one of the following magical properties et fire it at a solid surface you can see within the weapon's range. When the ammunition hits the surface, the ammunition's effect activates, et the ammunition attaches to the surface it hit for the duration of the effect; you can remove an attached piece of ammunition as a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, ending the effect early. When the effect ends, the ammunition is destroyed.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|PHB24|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}. You can also restore your use of this feature by expending a use of your Second Wind (no action required).

entries.name: Darkening Ammunition
entries: Magical shadows fill a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} originating from the ammunition for 1 minute. Nonmagical flames in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} are extinguished, et creatures in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} have a −5 penalty to Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB24}) checks et {@variantrule Passive Perception|PHB24}.

entries.name: Unlocking Ammunition
entries: A burst of magic fills a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} originating from the ammunition. The ammunition also emits a loud knocking sound, audible up to 300 feet away. Any object in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Emanation} that is held shut by a nonmagical lock or that is stuck or barred becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If such an object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked.

entries.name: Vine Ammunition
entries: A 120-foot-long vine grows from the ammunition. You et other creatures can then climb it. The vine withers away after 10 minutes.

subclassFeatures.name: Ever-Ready Shot
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|PHB24}, you can regain one expended use of Arcane Shot.

subclassFeatures.name: Indomitable Teleport
entries: Your magical mastery lets you escape dire situations. When you use your Indomitable feature et succeed on the saving throw, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

subclassFeatures.name: Masterful Shots
entries: You employ agility in your sharpshooting. When a creature you can see misses you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24} away from the attacker without provoking {@action opportunity attack|PHB24|Opportunity Attacks}. You can then make a ranged attack roll against the attacker as part of this {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} if the attacker is within the weapon's range.

classFeatures.name: Incantation
entries: Puisant dans votre magie innée, vous pouvez lancer des sorts. Consultez le chapitre 7 pour connaître les règles relatives aux sorts. Les informations ci-dessous détaillent comment appliquer ces règles aux sorts de Ensorceleur, qui figurent dans la liste des sorts d'Ensorceleur plus loin dans la description de la classe.

entries.name: Sorts mineurs
entries: Vous connaissez quatre sorts mineurs d'Ensorceleur de votre choix. {@spell Lumière}, {@spell Prestidigitation}, {@spell Emprise électrique} et {@spell Explosion magique} sont recommandés. À chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau d'Ensorceleur, vous pouvez remplacer l'un de vos sorts mineurs de cette capacité par un autre sort mineur d'Ensorceleur de votre choix.

Lorsque vous atteignez les niveaux 4 et 10 d'Ensorceleur, vous apprenez un autre sort mineur d'Ensorceleur de votre choix, comme indiqué dans la colonne Sorts mineurs du tableau des caractéristiques de l'Ensorceleur.

entries.name: Emplacements de sorts
entries: Le tableau des aptitudes de l'Ensorceleur indique le nombre d'emplacements de sorts dont vous disposez pour lancer vos sorts de niveau 1 et plus. Vous récupérez tous vos emplacements dépensés après un repos long.

entries.name: Sorts préparés de niveau 1 et plus
entries: Vous préparez la liste des sorts de niveau 1 et plus que vous pouvez lancer grâce à cette capacité. Pour commencer, choisissez deux sorts d'Ensorceleur de niveau 1. {@spell Mains brûlantes} et {@spell Détection de la magie} sont recommandés.

Le nombre de sorts sur votre liste augmente à mesure que vous gagnez des niveaux d'Ensorceleur, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Sorts préparés » du tableau des aptitudes d'Ensorceleur. À chaque augmentation de ce nombre, choisissez des sorts d'Ensorceleur supplémentaires jusqu'à ce que votre liste contienne autant de sorts que celle du tableau. Les sorts choisis doivent être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts. Par exemple, si vous êtes un Ensorceleur de niveau 3, votre liste de sorts préparés peut inclure six sorts d'Ensorceleur de niveau 1 ou 2, dans n'importe quelle combinaison.

Si une autre capacité d'Ensorceleur vous donne des sorts que vous avez toujours préparés, ces sorts ne sont pas comptabilisés dans le nombre de sorts que vous pouvez préparer avec cette capacité, mais ils sont par ailleurs considérés comme des sorts d'Ensorceleur.

entries.name: Modification de vos sorts préparés
entries: À chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau d'Ensorceleur, vous pouvez remplacer un sort de votre liste par un autre sort d'Ensorceleur pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts.

entries.name: Capacité d'incantation
entries: Le Charisme est votre caractéristique d'incantation pour vos sorts d'Ensorceleur.

entries.name: Focalisation de sorts
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser une focalisation arcanique comme focalisation de sorts pour vos sorts d'Ensorceleur.

classFeatures.name: Sorcellerie innée
entries: Un événement de votre passé vous a profondément marqué, vous imprégnant d'une magie latente. En tant qu'action bonus, vous pouvez libérer cette magie pendant 1 minute, durant laquelle vous bénéficiez des avantages suivants :

items: The spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.
entries: Le DD du jet de sauvegarde de vos sorts d'Ensorceleur augmente de 1.
Vous bénéficiez d'un avantage aux jets d'attaque des sorts d'Ensorceleur que vous lancez.
Vous pouvez utiliser cette fonctionnalité deux fois, et vous récupérez toutes les utilisations dépensées lorsque vous terminez un repos long.

classFeatures.name: Source de magie
entries: Vous pouvez puiser dans la source de magie qui réside en vous. Cette source est représentée par les Points de Sorcellerie, qui vous permettent de créer divers effets magiques.

Vous disposez de 2 points de sorcellerie et vous en gagnez davantage en progressant, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Points de sorcellerie » du tableau des aptitudes d'Ensorceleur. Vous ne pouvez pas avoir plus de points de sorcellerie que le nombre indiqué dans le tableau pour votre niveau. Vous récupérez tous vos points de sorcellerie dépensés après un repos long.
Vous pouvez utiliser vos points de sorcellerie pour alimenter les options ci-dessous, ainsi que d'autres fonctionnalités, telles que la métamagie, qui utilisent ces points.

entries.name: Conversion des emplacements de sorts en points de sorcellerie
entries: Vous pouvez dépenser un emplacement de sort pour gagner un nombre de points de sorcellerie égal au niveau de l'emplacement (aucune action requise).

entries.name: Création d'emplacements de sorts
entries: Par une action bonus, vous pouvez convertir des points de sorcellerie non dépensés en un emplacement de sort. Le tableau « Création d'emplacements de sorts » indique le coût de création d'un emplacement de sort d'un niveau donné, ainsi que le niveau d'Ensorceleur minimum requis. Vous ne pouvez pas créer d'emplacement de sort de niveau supérieur à 5.

classFeatures.name: Metamagic
entries: Puisque votre magie émane de l'intérieur, vous pouvez adapter vos sorts à vos besoins ; vous obtenez deux {@optfeature optionalfeatures||Options de métamagie} à choisir parmi celles décrites dans la section  plus loin dans la description de cette classe. Vous utilisez ces options pour modifier temporairement les sorts que vous lancez. Pour utiliser une option, vous devez dépenser le nombre de points de sorcellerie correspondant à son coût.
Vous ne pouvez utiliser qu'une seule option de métamagie sur un sort lorsque vous le lancez, sauf indication contraire dans l'une de ces options.

À chaque niveau d'Ensorceleur gagné, vous pouvez remplacer l'une de vos options de métamagie par une que vous ne connaissez pas. Vous obtenez deux options supplémentaires au niveau 10 et deux autres au niveau 17.

classFeatures.name: Options de métamagie
entries: The following options are available to your Metamagic feature. The options are presented in alphabetical order.

classFeatures.name: Sous-classe d'Ensorceleur
entries: Vous obtenez une sous-classe d'Ensorceleur de votre choix. Une sous-classe est une spécialisation qui vous octroie des capacités à certains niveaux d'Ensorceleur. Pour le reste de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de toutes les capacités de votre sous-classe correspondant à votre niveau d'Ensorceleur ou à un niveau inférieur.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition. Vous recevez de nouveau cette aptitude aux niveau de Sorcerer 8, 12, et 16.

classFeatures.name: Restauration magique
entries: Après un repos court, vous pouvez récupérer vos points de sorcellerie dépensés, mais pas plus de la moitié de votre niveau d'Ensorceleur (arrondi à l'inférieur). Une fois cette capacité utilisée, vous ne pourrez plus y recourir avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Sorcerer.

classFeatures.name: Sorcellerie incarnée
entries: S'il ne vous reste plus d'utilisations de Sorcellerie Innée, vous pouvez l'utiliser en dépensant 2 Points de Sorcellerie lorsque vous effectuez l' Action Bonus pour l'activer.
De plus, tant que votre capacité de Sorcellerie Innée est active, vous pouvez utiliser jusqu'à deux de vos options de Métamagie sur chaque sort que vous lancez.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Métamagie
entries: Puisque votre magie émane de vous-même, vous pouvez modifier vos sorts en fonction de vos besoins ; vous obtenez deux options de métamagie de votre choix dans la section « Options de métamagie » plus loin dans la description de cette classe.
Vous ne pouvez utiliser qu'une seule option de métamagie sur un sort lorsque vous le lancez, sauf indication contraire dans l'une de ces options.
À chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau d'Ensorceleur, vous pouvez remplacer l'une de vos options de Métamagie par une que vous ne connaissez pas.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Sorcerer.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Métamagie
entries: Puisque votre magie émane de vous-même, vous pouvez modifier vos sorts en fonction de vos besoins ; vous obtenez deux options de métamagie de votre choix dans la section « Options de métamagie » plus loin dans la description de cette classe.
Vous ne pouvez utiliser qu'une seule option de métamagie sur un sort lorsque vous le lancez, sauf indication contraire dans l'une de ces options.
À chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau d'Ensorceleur, vous pouvez remplacer l'une de vos options de Métamagie par une que vous ne connaissez pas.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Sorcerer.

classFeatures.name: Bénédiction épique
entries: Vous obtenez un don de  {@filter Don épique feat|feats|category=EB} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html}de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises. Le {@feat Don de Voyage Dimensionnel|PHB24} de sorts est recommandé.

classFeatures.name: Apothéose arcanique
entries: Tant que votre capacité de Sorcellerie Innée est active, vous pouvez utiliser une option de Métamagie à chacun de vos tours sans dépenser de Points de Sorcellerie.

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Bloodline
entries: Your innate magic comes from draconic magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors. Most often, sorcerers with this origin trace their descent back to a mighty sorcerer of ancient times who made a bargain with a dragon or who might even have claimed a dragon parent. Some of these bloodlines are well established in the world, but most are obscure. Any given sorcerer could be the first of a new bloodline, as a result of a pact or some other exceptional circumstance.

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Resilience
entries: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 et increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.
Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Dragon Ancestor
entries: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.
You can speak, read, et write {@language Draconic}. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

subclassFeatures.name: Elemental Affinity
entries: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell. At the same time, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

subclassFeatures.name: Dragon Wings
entries: At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn.
You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, et clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Presence
entries: Beginning at 18th level, you can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or {@condition frightened}. As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to draw on this power et exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your {@status concentration} (as if you were casting a {@status concentration} spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} (if you chose awe) or {@condition frightened} (if you chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.

subclassFeatures.name: Wild Magic
entries: Your innate magic comes from the wild forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You might have endured exposure to some form of raw magic, perhaps through a planar portal leading to Limbo, the Elemental Planes, or the mysterious Far Realm. Perhaps you were blessed by a powerful fey creature or marked by a demon. Or your magic could be a fluke of your birth, with no apparent cause or reason. However it came to be, this chaotic magic churns within you, waiting for any outlet.

subclassFeatures.name: Tides of Chaos
entries: Starting at 1st level, you can manipulate the forces of chance et chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

Any time before you regain the use of this feature, the DM can have you roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher. You then regain the use of this feature.

subclassFeatures.name: Wild Magic Surge
entries: Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a {@dice d20}. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a retom magical effect. A Wild Magic Surge can happen once per turn.

If a Wild Magic effect is a spell, it's too wild to be affected by Metamagic. If it normally requires {@status concentration}, it doesn't require {@status concentration} in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.

entries.caption: Wild Magic Surge
rows: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.
For the next minute, you can see any {@condition invisible} creature if you have line of sight to it.
A {@filter modron|bestiary|source=mm|search=modron} chosen et controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
You cast {@spell fireball} as a 3rd-level spell centered on yourself.
You cast {@spell magic missile} as a 5th-level spell.
Roll a {@dice d10}. Your height changes by a number of inches equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you shrink. If the roll is even, you grow.
You cast {@spell confusion} centered on yourself.
For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
You grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze, at which point the feathers explode out from your face.
You cast {@spell grease} centered on yourself.
Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.
Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. A {@spell remove curse} spell can end this effect.
An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute. During that time, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 bonus action.
You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see.
You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, after which time you return to the space you previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute.
Roll a {@dice d10}. Your age changes by a number of years equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you get younger (minimum 1 year old). If the roll is even, you get older.
{@dice 1d6} {@creature flumph||flumphs} controlled by the DM appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you et are {@condition frightened} of you. They vanish after 1 minute.

You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While a plant, you are {@condition incapacitated} et have vulnerability to all damage. If you drop to 0 hit points, your pot breaks, et your form reverts.
For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
A {@creature unicorn} controlled by the DM appears in a space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC et immunity to {@spell magic missile}.
You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next {@dice 5d6} days.
Your hair falls out but grows back within 24 hours.
For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame.
You regain your lowest-level expended spell slot.
For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.
You cast {@spell fog cloud} centered on yourself.
Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take {@damage 4d10} lightning damage.
You are {@condition frightened} by the nearest creature until the end of your next turn.
Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes {@condition invisible} for the next minute. The invisibility ends on a creature when it attacks or casts a spell.
You gain resistance to all damage for the next minute.
A retom creature within 60 feet of you becomes {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 1d4} hours.
You glow with bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.
You cast {@spell polymorph} on yourself. If you fail the saving throw, you turn into a sheep for the spell's duration.
Illusory butterflies et flower petals flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.
You can take one additional action immediately.
Each creature within 30 feet of you takes {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to the sum of the necrotic damage dealt.
You cast {@spell fly} on a retom creature within 60 feet of you.
You become {@condition invisible} for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.
If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the {@spell reincarnate} spell.
Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.
You et all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to piercing damage for the next minute.
You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.
You regain all expended sorcery points.

subclassFeatures.name: Bend Luck
entries: Starting at 6th level, you have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction et spend 2 sorcery points to roll {@dice 1d4} et apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

subclassFeatures.name: Controlled Chaos
entries: At 14th level, you gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table, you can roll twice et use either number.

subclassFeatures.name: Spell Bombardment
entries: Beginning at 18th level, the harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell et roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, choose one of those dice, roll it again et add that roll to the damage. You can use the feature only once per turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Pyromancer (PSK)
entries: Your innate magic manifests in fire. You are your fire, et your fire is you.

subclassFeatures.name: Heart of Fire
entries: At 1st level, whenever you start casting a spell of 1st level or higher that deals fire damage, fiery magic erupts from you. This eruption causes creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you to take fire damage equal to half your sorcerer level (minimum of 1).

subclassFeatures.name: Fire in the Veins
entries: At 6th level, you gain resistance to fire damage. In addition, spells you cast ignore resistance to fire damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Pyromancer's Fury
entries: Starting at 14th level, when you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal fire damage to the attacker. The damage equals your sorcerer level, et ignores resistance to fire damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Fiery Soul
entries: At 18th level, you gain immunity to fire damage. In addition, any spell or effect you create ignores resistance to fire damage et treats immunity to fire damage as resistance to fire damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Divine Soul
entries: Sometimes the spark of magic that fuels a sorcerer comes from a divine source that glimmers within the soul. Having such a blessed soul is a sign that your innate magic might come from a distant but powerful familial connection to a divine being. Perhaps your ancestor was an angel, transformed into a mortal et sent to fight in a god's name.
Or your birth might align with an ancient prophecy, marking you as a servant of the gods or a chosen vessel of divine magic.

A Divine Soul, with a natural magnetism, is seen as a threat by some religious hierarchies. As an outsider who commets sacred power, a Divine Soul can undermine an existing order by claiming a direct tie to the divine.

In some cultures, only those who can claim the power of a Divine Soul may commet religious power. In these lets, ecclesiastical positions are dominated by a few bloodlines et preserved over generations.

subclassFeatures.name: Divine Magic
entries: Your link to the divine allows you to learn spells from the cleric class. When your Spellcasting feature lets you learn or replace a sorcerer cantrip or a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the cleric spell list or the sorcerer spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell, et it becomes a sorcerer spell for you.

In addition, choose an affinity for the source of your divine power: good, evil, law, chaos, or neutrality. You learn an additional spell based on that affinity, as shown below. It is a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against your number of sorcerer spells known. If you later replace this spell, you must replace it with a spell from the cleric spell list.

subclassFeatures.name: Favored by the Gods
entries: Starting at 1st level, divine power guards your destiny. If you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll {@dice 2d4} et add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Empowered Healing
entries: Starting at 6th level, the divine energy coursing through you can empower healing spells. Whenever you or an ally within 5 feet of you rolls dice to determine the number of hit points a spell restores, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice once, provided you aren't {@condition incapacitated}. You can use this feature only once per turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Otherworldly Wings
entries: Starting at 14th level, you can use a bonus action to manifest a pair of spectral wings from your back. While the wings are present, you have a flying speed of 30 feet. The wings last until you're {@condition incapacitated}, you die, or you dismiss them as a bonus action.
The affinity you chose for your Divine Magic feature determines the appearance of the spectral wings: eagle wings for good or law, bat wings for evil or chaos, et dragonfly wings for neutrality.

subclassFeatures.name: Unearthly Recovery
entries: At 18th level, you gain the ability to overcome grievous injuries. As a bonus action when you have fewer than half of your hit points remaining, you can regain a number of hit points equal to half your hit point maximum.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadow Magic
entries: You are a creature of shadow, for your innate magic comes from the Shadowfell itself. You might trace your lineage to an entity from that place, or perhaps you were exposed to its fell energy et transformed by it.

The power of shadow magic casts a strange pall over your physical presence. The spark of life that sustains you is muffled, as if it struggles to remain viable against the dark energy that imbues your soul. At your option, you can pick from or roll on the Shadow Sorcerer Quirks table to create a quirk for your character.

entries.caption: Shadow Sorcerer Quirks
rows: You are always icy cold to the touch.
When you are asleep, you don't appear to breathe (though you must still breathe to survive).
You barely bleed, even when badly injured.
Your heart beats once per minute. This event sometimes surprises you.
You have trouble remembering that living creatures et corpses should be treated differently.

subclassFeatures.name: Eyes of the Dark
entries: Starting at 1st level, you have {@sense darkvision} with a range of 120 feet.

When you reach 3rd level in this class, you learn the {@spell darkness} spell, which doesn't count against your number of sorcerer spells known. In addition, you can cast it by spending 2 sorcery points or by expending a spell slot. If you cast it with sorcery points, you can see through the {@spell darkness} created by the spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Strength of the Grave
entries: Starting at 1st level, your existence in a twilight state between life et death makes you difficult to defeat. When damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you can make a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 5} + the damage taken). On a success, you instead drop to 1 hit point. You can't use this feature if you are reduced to 0 hit points by radiant damage or by a critical hit.
After the saving throw succeeds, you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Hound of Ill Omen
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to call forth a howling creature of darkness to harass your foes. As a bonus action, you can spend 3 sorcery points to magically summon a {@creature hound of ill omen|XGE} to target one creature you can see within 120 feet of you. The hound uses the {@creature dire wolf}'s statistics (see the Monster Manual or appendix C in the Player's Hetbook), with the following changes:

items: The hound is size Medium, not Large, et it counts as a monstrosity, not a beast.
It appears with a number of temporary hit points equal to half your sorcerer level.
It can move through other creatures et objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The hound takes 5 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
At the start of its turn, the hound automatically knows its target's location. If the target was hidden, it is no longer hidden from the hound.

entries: The hound appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Roll initiative for the hound. On its turn, it can move only toward its target by the most direct route, et it can use its action only to attack its target. The hound can make opportunity attacks, but only against its target. Additionally, while the hound is within 5 feet of the target, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against any spell you cast. The hound disappears if it is reduced to 0 hit points, if its target is reduced to 0 hit points, or after 5 minutes.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadow Walk
entries: At 14th level, you gain the ability to step from one shadow into another. When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

subclassFeatures.name: Umbral Form
entries: Starting at 18th level, you can spend 6 sorcery points as a bonus action to magically transform yourself into a shadowy form. In this form, you have resistance to all damage except force et radiant damage, et you can move through other creatures et objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. You take 5 force damage if you end your turn inside an object.
You remain in this form for 1 minute. It ends early if you are {@condition incapacitated}, if you die, or if you dismiss it as a bonus action.

subclassFeatures.name: Storm Sorcery
entries: Your innate magic comes from the power of elemental air. Many with this power can trace their magic back to a near-death experience caused by the Great Rain, but perhaps you were born during a howling gale so powerful that folk still tell stories of it, or your lineage might include the influence of potent air creatures such as djinn. Whatever the case, the magic of the storm permeates your being.

Storm sorcerers are invaluable members of a ship's crew. Their magic allows them to exert control over wind et weather in their immediate area. Their abilities also prove useful in repelling attacks by sahuagin, pirates, et other waterborne threats.

subclassFeatures.name: Tempestuous Magic
