entries: Starting at 1st level, you can use a bonus action on your turn to cause whirling gusts of elemental air to briefly surround you, immediately before or after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher. Doing so allows you to fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

subclassFeatures.name: Wind Speaker
entries: The arcane magic you commet is infused with elemental air. You can speak, read, et write {@language Primordial}. Knowing this language allows you to understet et be understood by those who speak its dialects: {@language Primordial||Aquan}, {@language Primordial||Auran}, {@language Primordial||Ignan}, et {@language Primordial||Terran}.

subclassFeatures.name: Heart of the Storm
entries: At 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning et thunder damage. In addition, whenever you start casting a spell of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder damage, stormy magic erupts from you. This eruption causes creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you to take lightning or thunder damage (choose each time this ability activates) equal to half your sorcerer level.

subclassFeatures.name: Storm Guide
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to subtly control the weather around you.
If it is raining, you can use an action to cause the rain to stop falling in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You can end this effect as a bonus action.

If it is windy, you can use a bonus action each round to choose the direction that the wind blows in a 100-foot-radius sphere centered on you. The wind blows in that direction until the end of your next turn. This feature doesn't alter the speed of the wind.

subclassFeatures.name: Storm's Fury
entries: Starting at 14th level, when you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal lightning damage to the attacker. The damage equals your sorcerer level. The attacker must also make a Strength saving throw against your sorcerer spell save DC. On a failed save, the attacker is pushed in a straight line up to 20 feet away from you.

subclassFeatures.name: Wind Soul
entries: At 18th level, you gain immunity to lightning et thunder damage.

You also gain a magical flying speed of 60 feet. As an action, you can reduce your flying speed to 30 feet for 1 hour et choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. The chosen creatures gain a magical flying speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. Once you reduce your flying speed in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Aberrant Mind
entries: An alien influence has wrapped its tendrils around your mind, giving you psionic power. You can now touch other minds with that power et alter the world around you by using it to control the magical energy of the multiverse. Will this power shine from you as a hopeful beacon to others? Or will you be a source of terror to those who feel the stab of your mind et witness the strange manifestations of your might?

As an Aberrant Mind sorcerer, you decide how you acquired your powers. Were you born with them? Or did an event later in life leave you shining with psionic awareness? Consult the Aberrant Origins table for a possible origin of your power.

entries.caption: Aberrant Origins
rows: You were exposed to the Far Realm's warping influence. You are convinced that a tentacle is now growing on you, but no one else can see it.
A psychic wind from the Astral Plane carried psionic energy to you. When you use your powers, faint motes of light sparkle around you.
You once suffered the dominating powers of an aboleth, leaving a psychic splinter in your mind.
You were implanted with a mind flayer tadpole, but the ceremorphosis never completed. et now its psionic power is yours. When you use it, your flesh shines with a strange mucus.
As a child, you had an imaginary friend that looked like a flumph or a strange platypus-like creature. One day, it gifted you with psionic powers, which have ended up being not so imaginary.
Your nightmares whisper the truth to you: your psionic powers are not your own. You draw them from your parasitic twin!

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Spells
entries: {@i 1st-level Aberrant Mind feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Psionic Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

Whenever you gain a sorcerer level, you can replace one spell you gained from this feature with another spell of the same level. The new spell must be a {@filter divination or an enchantment spell from the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list|spells|class=sorcerer;warlock;wizard|school=D;E|level=1;2;3;4;5}.

entries.caption: Psionic Spells
rows: {@spell arms of Hadar}, {@spell dissonant whispers}, {@spell mind sliver|tce}

subclassFeatures.name: Telepathic Speech
entries: {@i 1st-level Aberrant Mind feature}

You can form a telepathic connection between your mind et the mind of another. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You et the chosen creature can speak telepathically with each other while the two of you are within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 mile). To understet each other, you each must speak mentally in a language the other knows.

The telepathic connection lasts for a number of minutes equal to your sorcerer level. It ends early if you are {@condition incapacitated} or die or if you use this ability to form a connection with a different creature.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Sorcery
entries: {@i 6th-level Aberrant Mind feature}

When you cast any spell of 1st level or higher from your Psionic Spells feature, you can cast it by expending a spell slot as normal or by spending a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level.
If you cast the spell using sorcery points, it requires no verbal or somatic components, et it requires no material components, unless they are consumed by the spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Defenses
entries: {@i 6th-level Aberrant Mind feature}
You gain resistance to psychic damage, et you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

subclassFeatures.name: Revelation in Flesh
entries: {@i 14th-level Aberrant Mind feature}

You can unleash the aberrant truth hidden within yourself. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 or more sorcery points to magically transform your body for 10 minutes. For each sorcery point you spend, you can gain one of the following benefits of your choice, the effects of which last until the transformation ends:

items: You can see any {@condition invisible} creature within 60 feet of you, provided it isn't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. Your eyes also turn black or become writhing sensory tendrils.
You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed, et you can hover. As you fly, your skin glistens with mucus or shines with an otherworldly light.

You gain a swimming speed equal to twice your walking speed, et you can breathe underwater. Moreover, gills grow from your neck or fan out from behind your ears, your fingers become webbed, or you grow writhing cilia that extend through your clothing.

Your body, along with any equipment you are wearing or carrying, becomes slimy et pliable. You can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing, et you can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being {@condition grappled}.

subclassFeatures.name: Warping Implosion
entries: {@i 18th-level Aberrant Mind feature}

You can unleash your aberrant power as a space-warping anomaly. As an action, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of you. Immediately after you disappear, each creature within 30 feet of the space you left must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 3d10} force damage et is pulled straight toward the space you left, ending in an unoccupied space as close to your former space as possible. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage et isn't pulled.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you spend 5 sorcery points to use it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Clockwork Soul
entries: The cosmic force of order has suffused you with magic. That power arises from Mechanus or a realm like it-a plane of existence shaped entirely by clockwork efficiency. You, or someone from your lineage, might have become entangled in the machinations of the modrons, the orderly beings who inhabit Mechanus. Perhaps your ancestor even took part in the Great Modron March. Whatever its origin within you, the power of order can seem strange to others, but for you, it is part of a vast et glorious system.

subclassFeatures.name: Clockwork Magic
entries: {@i 1st-level Clockwork Soul feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Clockwork Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

Whenever you gain a sorcerer level, you can replace one spell you gained from this feature with another spell of the same level. The new spell must be an {@filter abjuration or a transmutation spell from the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list|spells|class=sorcerer;warlock;wizard|school=A;T|level=1;2;3;4;5}.

entries.caption: Clockwork Spells
rows: {@spell alarm}, {@spell protection from evil et good}

entries: In addition, consult the Manifestations of Order table et choose or retomly determine a way your connection to order manifests while you are casting any of your sorcerer spells.

entries.caption: Manifestations of Order
rows: The hets of a clock spin in your eyes.
Your skin glows with a brassy sheen.
Floating equations et geometric objects overlay your body.
Your spellcasting focus temporarily takes the form of a Tiny clockwork mechanism.
The ticking of gears or ringing of a clock can be heard by you et those affected by your magic.

subclassFeatures.name: Restore Balance
entries: {@i 1st-level Clockwork Soul feature}

Your connection to the plane of absolute order allows you to equalize chaotic moments. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you is about to roll a {@dice d20} with advantage or disadvantage, you can use your reaction to prevent the roll from being affected by advantage et disadvantage.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Bastion of Law
entries: {@i 6th-level Clockwork Soul feature}

You can tap into the gret equation of existence to imbue a creature with a shimmering shield of order. As an action, you can expend 1 to 5 sorcery points to create a magical ward around yourself or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The ward lasts until you finish a long rest or until you use this feature again.

The ward is represented by a number of {@dice d8}s equal to the number of sorcery points spent to create it. When the warded creature takes damage, it can expend a number of those dice, roll them, et reduce the damage taken by the total rolled on those dice.

subclassFeatures.name: Trance of Order
entries: {@i 14th-level Clockwork Soul feature}

You gain the ability to align your consciousness to the endless calculations of Mechanus. As a bonus action, you can enter this state for 1 minute. For the duration, attack rolls against you can't benefit from advantage, et whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the {@dice d20} as a 10.
Once you use this bonus action, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest, unless you spend 5 sorcery points to use it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
entries: {@i 18th-level Clockwork Soul feature}

You summon spirits of order to expunge disorder around you. As an action, you summon the spirits in a 30-foot cube originating from you. The spirits look like modrons or other constructs of your choice. The spirits are intangible et invulnerable, et they create the following effects within the cube before vanishing:

items: The spirits restore up to 100 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures of your choice in the cube.
Any damaged objects entirely in the cube are repaired instantly.
Every spell of 6th level or lower ends on creatures et objects of your choice in the cube.

entries: Once you use this action, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest, unless you spend 7 sorcery points to use it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Lunar Sorcery
entries: On many worlds, the moon is a revered celestial body with magical properties. On Krynn, the gods of magic are associated with the world's three moons. On the world of Toril, the god Selûne uses the light of the moon to battle darkness. On Eberron, scholars of the Draconic Prophecy decipher ancient secrets from the waxing et waning of that world's twelve moons.

You or someone from your lineage has been exposed to the concentrated magic of the moon (or moons) of your world, imbuing you with lunar magic. Perhaps your ancestor was involved in a druidic ritual involving an eclipse, or maybe a mystical fragment of a moon crashed near you. However you came to have your magic, your connection to the moon is obvious when you cast sorcerer spells—perhaps making your pupils glow with the color of a moon from your world, causing spectral manifestations of lunar phases to orbit you, or some other effect.

subclassFeatures.name: Lunar Embodiment
entries: {@i 1st-Level Lunar Sorcery Feature}

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Lunar Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

Whenever you finish a long rest, you can choose what lunar phase manifests its power through your magic: Full Moon, New Moon, or Crescent Moon. While in the chosen phase, you can cast one 1st-level spell of the associated phase in the Lunar Spells table once without expending a spell slot. Once you cast a spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Moon Fire
entries: {@i 1st-Level Lunar Sorcery Feature}

You can call down the radiant light of the moon on commet. You learn the {@spell sacred flame} spell, which doesn't count against the number of sorcerer cantrips you know. When you cast the spell, you can target one creature as normal or target two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other.

subclassFeatures.name: Lunar Boons
entries: {@i 6th-Level Lunar Sorcery Feature}
The current phase of your Lunar Embodiment can affect your Metamagic feature. Each Lunar Embodiment phase is associated with certain schools of magic, as shown here:

items.name: Full Moon
entries: {@filter Abjuration et divination spells|spells|class=sorcerer|school=A;D}

items.name: New Moon
entries: {@filter Enchantment et necromancy spells|spells|class=sorcerer|school=E;N}

items.name: Crescent Moon
entries: {@filter Illusion et transmutation spells|spells|class=sorcerer|school=I;T}

Whenever you use Metamagic on a spell of a school of magic associated with your current Lunar Embodiment phase, you can reduce the sorcery points spent by 1 (minimum 0). You can reduce the sorcery points spent for your Metamagic a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Waxing et Waning
entries: {@i 6th-Level Lunar Sorcery Feature}
You gain greater control over the phases of your lunar magic. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 sorcery point to change your current Lunar Embodiment phase to a different one.

You can now cast one 1st-level spell from each lunar phase of the Lunar Spells table once without expending a spell slot, provided your current phase is the same as the lunar phase spell. Once you cast a lunar phase spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Lunar Empowerment
entries: {@i 14th-Level Lunar Sorcery Feature}
The power of a lunar phase saturates your being. While you are in a Lunar Embodiment phase, you also gain the following benefit associated with that phase:

items.name: Full Moon
entries: You can use a bonus action to shed bright light in a 10-foot radius et dim light for an additional 10 feet or to douse the light. In addition, you et creatures of your choice have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) et Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks while within the bright light you shed.

items.name: New Moon
entries: You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks. In addition, while you are entirely in darkness, attack rolls have disadvantage against you.

items.name: Crescent Moon
entries: You have resistance to necrotic et radiant damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Lunar Phenomenon
entries: {@i 18th-Level Lunar Sorcery feature}

As a bonus action, you can tap into a special power of your current Lunar Embodiment phase. Alternatively, as part of the bonus action you take to change your lunar phase using the Waxing et Waning feature, you can immediately use the power of the lunar phase you are entering:

items.name: Full Moon
entries: You radiate moonlight for a moment. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. In addition, one creature of your choice in that area regains {@dice 3d8} hit points.

items.name: New Moon
entries: You momentarily emanate gloom. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take {@damage 3d10} necrotic damage et have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. In addition, you become {@condition invisible} until the end of your next turn, or until immediately after you make an attack roll or cast a spell.

items.name: Crescent Moon
entries: You can magically teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of yourself. You can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself. That creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of your destination space. In addition, you et that creature gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
Once you use one of these bonus action benefits, you can't use that benefit again until you finish a long rest, unless you spend 5 sorcery points to use it again.

subclassFeatures.name: Aberrant Sorcery
entries: {@i Wield Unnatural Psionic Power}

An alien influence has wrapped its tendrils around your mind, giving you psionic power. You can now touch other minds with that power et alter the world around you. Will this power shine from you as a hopeful beacon to others? Or will you be a terror to those who feel the stab of your mind?

Perhaps a psychic wind from the Astral Plane carried psionic energy to you, or you were exposed to the Far Realm's warping influence. Alternatively, you were implanted with a mind flayer tadpole, but your transformation into a mind flayer never occurred; now the tadpole's psionic power is yours. However you acquired this power, your mind is aflame with it.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Spells
entries: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Psionic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Psionic Spells
rows: {@spell Arms of Hadar|PHB24}, {@spell Calm Emotions|PHB24}, {@spell Detect Thoughts|PHB24}, {@spell Dissonant Whispers|PHB24}, {@spell Mind Sliver|PHB24}

subclassFeatures.name: Telepathic Speech
entries: You can form a telepathic connection between your mind et the mind of another. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You et the chosen creature can communicate telepathically with each other while the two of you are within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 mile). To understet each other, you each must mentally use a language the other knows.
The telepathic connection lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level. It ends early if you use this ability to form a connection with a different creature.

subclassFeatures.name: Psionic Sorcery
entries: When you cast any level 1+ spell from your Psionic Spells feature, you can cast it by expending a spell slot as normal or by spending a number of Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level. If you cast the spell using Sorcery Points, it requires no Verbal or Somatic components, et it requires no Material components unless they are consumed by the spell or have a cost specified in it.

subclassFeatures.name: Psychic Defenses
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to Psychic damage, et you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|PHB24} or {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition.

subclassFeatures.name: Revelation in Flesh
entries: You can unleash the aberrant truth hidden within yourself. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point or more to magically alter your body for 10 minutes. For each Sorcery Point you spend, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice, the effects of which last until the alteration ends.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Swim Speed|PHB24} equal to twice your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24}, et you can breathe underwater. Gills grow from your neck or flare behind your ears, et your fingers become webbed or you grow wriggling cilia.

entries.name: Glistening Flight
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|PHB24} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|PHB24}, et you can hover. As you fly, your skin glistens with mucus or otherworldly light.

entries.name: See the Invisible
entries: You can see any {@condition Invisible|PHB24} creature within 60 feet of yourself that isn't behind {@variantrule Cover|PHB24|Total Cover}. Your eyes also turn black or become writhing sensory tendrils.

entries.name: Wormlike Movement
entries: Your body, along with any equipment you are wearing or carrying, becomes slimy et pliable. You can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch, et you can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or the {@condition Grappled|PHB24} condition.

subclassFeatures.name: Warping Implosion
entries: You can unleash a space-warping anomaly. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Immediately after you disappear, each creature within 30 feet of the space you left must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 3d10} Force damage et is pulled straight toward the space you left, ending in an unoccupied space as close to your former space as possible. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Clockwork Sorcery
entries: {@i Channel Cosmic Forces of Order}

The cosmic force of order has suffused you with magic. That power arises from Mechanus or a realm like it—a plane of existence shaped entirely by clockwork efficiency. You or someone from your lineage might have become entangled in the machinations of modrons, the orderly beings who inhabit Mechanus. Perhaps your ancestor even took part in the Great Modron March. Whatever its origin within you, the power of order can seem strange to others, but for you, it's part of a vast et glorious system.

subclassFeatures.name: Clockwork Spells
entries: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Clockwork Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Clockwork Spells
rows: {@spell Aid|PHB24}, {@spell Alarm|PHB24}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|PHB24}, {@spell Protection from Evil et Good|PHB24}

entries: In addition, consult the Manifestations of Order table et choose or retomly determine a way your connection to order manifests while you are casting any of your Sorcerer spells.

entries.caption: Manifestations of Order
rows: The hets of a clock spin in your eyes.
Your skin glows with a brassy sheen.
Floating equations et geometric objects overlay your body.
Your {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|PHB24} temporarily takes the form of a Tiny clockwork mechanism.
The ticking of gears or ringing of a clock can be heard by you et those affected by your magic.

subclassFeatures.name: Restore Balance
entries: Your connection to the plane of absolute order allows you to equalize chaotic moments. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself is about to roll a {@dice d20} with {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} to prevent the roll from being affected by {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} et {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24}.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Bastion of Law
entries: You can tap into the gret equation of existence to imbue a creature with a shimmering shield of order. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, you can expend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points to create a magical ward around yourself or another creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The ward is represented by a number of d8s equal to the number of Sorcery Points spent to create it. When the warded creature takes damage, it can expend a number of those dice, roll them, et reduce the damage taken by the total rolled on those dice.
The ward lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} or until you use this feature again.

subclassFeatures.name: Trance of Order
entries: You gain the ability to align your consciousness with the endless calculations of Mechanus. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can enter this state for 1 minute. For the duration, attack rolls against you can't benefit from {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24}, et whenever you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|PHB24}, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the {@dice d20} as a 10.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
entries: You momentarily summon spirits of order to expunge disorder around you. As a {@action Magic|PHB24} action, you summon the spirits in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Cube} originating from you. The spirits look like modrons or other Constructs of your choice. The spirits are intangible et invulnerable, et they create the effects below within the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Cube} before vanishing. Once you use this action, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you spend 7 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

entries.name: Heal
entries: The spirits restore up to 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24}, divided as you choose among any number of creatures of your choice in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Cube}.

entries.name: Repair
entries: Any damaged objects entirely in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Cube} are repaired instantly.

entries.name: Dispel
entries: Every spell of level 6 et lower ends on creatures et objects of your choice in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|PHB24|Cube}.

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Sorcery
entries: {@i Breathe the Magic of Dragons}

Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon. Perhaps an ancient dragon facing death bequeathed some of its magical power to you or your ancestor. You might have absorbed magic from a site infused with dragons' power. Or perhaps you hetled a treasure taken from a dragon's hoard that was steeped in draconic power. Or you might have a dragon for an ancestor.

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Spells
entries: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Draconic Spells
rows: {@spell Alter Self|PHB24}, {@spell Chromatic Orb|PHB24}, {@spell Commet|PHB24}, {@spell Dragon's Breath|PHB24}

subclassFeatures.name: Draconic Resilience
entries: The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24|Hit Point} maximum increases by 3, et it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.
Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|PHB24} equals 10 plus your Dexterity et Charisma modifiers.

subclassFeatures.name: Elemental Affinity
entries: Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type associated with dragons. Choose one of those types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
You have {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to that damage type, et when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Dragon Wings
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back. The wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|PHB24} of 60 feet.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassFeatures.name: Dragon Companion
entries: You can cast {@spell Summon Dragon|PHB24} without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, et you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.
Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|PHB24}. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

subclassFeatures.name: Wild Magic Sorcery
entries: {@i Unleash Chaotic Magic}

Your innate magic stems from the forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You or an ancestor might have endured exposure to raw magic, perhaps through a planar portal leading to Limbo or the Elemental Planes. Perhaps you were blessed by a fey being or marked by a demon. Or your magic could be a fluke with no apparent cause. Whatever its source, this magic churns within you, waiting for any outlet.

subclassFeatures.name: Tides of Chaos
entries: You can manipulate chaos itself to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on one {@variantrule D20 Test|PHB24} before you roll the {@dice d20}. Once you do so, you must cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot or finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} before you can use this feature again.
If you do cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot before you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}, you automatically roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB24} table.

subclassFeatures.name: Wild Magic Surge
entries: Your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Once per turn, you can roll {@dice 1d20} immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot. If you roll a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a magical effect.
If the magical effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic.

entries.caption: Wild Magic Surge
rows: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.

A creature that is Friendly toward you appears in a retom unoccupied space within 60 feet of you. The creature is under the DM's control et disappears 1 minute later. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the creature: on a 1, a Modron Duodrone appears; on a 2, a Flumph appears; on a 3, a Modron Monodrone appears; on a 4, a Unicorn appears. See the Monster Manual for the creature's stat block.
For the next minute, you regain 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} at the start of each of your turns.
Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.

You are subjected to an effect that lasts for 1 minute unless its description says otherwise. Roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the effect: on a 1, you're surrounded by faint, ethereal music only you et creatures within 5 feet of you can hear; on a 2, your size increases by one size category; on a 3, you grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze, at which point the feathers explode from your face et vanish; on a 4, you must shout when you speak; on a 5, illusory butterflies flutter in the air within 10 feet of you; on a 6, an eye appears on your forehead, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|PHB24} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB24}) checks; on a 7, pink bubbles float out of your mouth whenever you speak; on an 8, your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue for 24 hours or until the effect is ended by a {@spell Remove Curse|PHB24} spell.
For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of an action have a casting time of a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24}.
You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn. You then return to the space you previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
The next time you cast a spell that deals damage within the next minute, don't roll the spell's damage dice for the damage. Instead use the highest number possible for each damage die.
You have {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to all damage for the next minute.

You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While you're a plant, you have the {@condition Incapacitated|PHB24} condition et have {@variantrule Vulnerability|PHB24} to all damage. If you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24}, your pot breaks, et your form reverts.
For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} on each of your turns.

You et up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you have the {@condition Invisible|PHB24} condition for 1 minute. This invisibility ends on a creature immediately after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC et immunity to {@spell Magic Missile|PHB24}.
You can take one extra action on this turn.

You cast a retom spell. If the spell normally requires {@status Concentration|PHB24}, it doesn't require {@status Concentration|PHB24} in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration. Roll {@dice 1d10} to determine the spell: on a 1, {@spell Confusion|PHB24}; on a 2, {@spell Fireball|PHB24}; on a 3, {@spell Fog Cloud|PHB24}; on a 4, {@spell Fly|PHB24} (cast on a retom creature within 60 feet of you), on a 5, {@spell Grease|PHB24}; on a 6, {@spell Levitate|PHB24} (cast on yourself); on a 7, {@spell Magic Missile|PHB24} (cast as a level 5 spell); on an 8, {@spell Mirror Image|PHB24}; on a 9, {@spell Polymorph|PHB24} (cast on yourself), et if you fail the saving throw, you turn into a Goat (see appendix B); on a 10, {@spell See Invisibility|PHB24}.
For the next minute, any flammable, nonmagical object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame, takes {@damage 1d4} Fire damage, et is burning.
If you die within the next hour, you immediately revive as if by the {@spell Reincarnate|PHB24} spell.
You have the {@condition Frightened|PHB24} condition until the end of your next turn. The DM determines the source of your fear.
You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
A retom creature within 60 feet of you has the {@condition Poisoned|PHB24} condition for {@dice 1d4} hours.

You radiate {@variantrule Bright Light|PHB24} in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you has the {@condition Blinded|PHB24} condition until the end of its next turn.

Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you take {@damage 1d10} Necrotic damage. You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} equal to the sum of the Necrotic damage dealt.
Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you take {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage.
You et all creatures within 30 feet of you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|PHB24} to Piercing damage for the next minute.

Roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1, you regain {@dice 2d10} {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24}; on a 2, one ally of your choice within 300 feet of you regains {@dice 2d10} {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24}; on a 3, you regain your lowest-level expended spell slot; on a 4, one ally of your choice within 300 feet of you regains their lowest-level expended spell slot; on a 5, you regain all your expended Sorcery Points; on a 6, all the effects of row 17–20 affect you simultaneously.

subclassFeatures.name: Bend Luck
entries: You have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. Immediately after another creature you can see rolls the {@dice d20} for a {@variantrule D20 Test|PHB24}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|PHB24} et spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll {@dice 1d4} et apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the {@dice d20} roll.

subclassFeatures.name: Controlled Chaos
entries: You gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice et use either number.

subclassFeatures.name: Tamed Surge
entries: Immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can create an effect of your choice from the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB24} table instead of rolling on that table. You can choose any effect in the table except for the final row, et if the chosen effect involves a roll, you must make it.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Bolstering Flames
entries: You or one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|PHB24} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Charisma modifier.

subclassFeatures.name: Radiant Fire
entries: One creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself takes {@damage 1d4} Fire or Radiant damage (your choice).

subclassFeatures.name: Spellfire Burst
entries: When you spend at least 1 Sorcery Point as part of the {@action Magic|PHB24} action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} on your turn, you can unleash one of the following magical effects of your choice. You can do so only once per turn.

subclassFeatures.name: Spellfire Sorcery
entries: {@i Wield Raw Magic}

Your innate power stems from the source of magic itself: the Weave. This connection manifests as a rare ability known as spellfire, et you surge with radiant bursts of this raw magic. Your talent with spellfire allows you to heal allies, sear enemies, et absorb powerful spells.

Wielders of spellfire tend to have a penchant for wetering. Many travel between cosmopolitan settlements, such as those along the Sword Coast, et wield their magic in service of the common good. Others realize their own strange powers by roaming equally strange lets, from the magic-blasted wastes of the desert of Anauroch to the god-touched wilds of the Old Empires. Wherever they go in the Realms, spellfire Sorcerers are courted by factions with interests in the arcane arts, such as the Harpers, Cult of the Dragon, et Red Wizards.

subclassFeatures.name: Spellfire Spells
entries: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Spellfire Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

rows: {@spell Cure Wounds|PHB24}, {@spell Guiding Bolt|PHB24}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|PHB24}, {@spell Scorching Ray|PHB24}

subclassFeatures.name: Absorb Spells
entries: You always have {@spell Counterspell|PHB24} prepared.
Additionally, whenever a target fails the saving throw against a {@spell Counterspell|PHB24} you cast, you regain {@dice 1d4} Sorcery Points.

subclassFeatures.name: Honed Spellfire
entries: Your {@subclassFeature Spellfire Burst|Sorcerer|PHB24|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} improves. You add your {@class Sorcerer|PHB24} level to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|PHB24} gained from {@subclassFeature Bolstering Flames|Sorcerer|PHB24|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}, et the damage of {@subclassFeature Radiant Fire|Sorcerer|PHB24|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} increases to {@dice 1d8}.

subclassFeatures.name: Crown of Spellfire
entries: When you use {@classFeature Innate Sorcery|Sorcerer|PHB24|1}, you can alter it et infuse yourself with the essence of spellfire, gaining the following benefits while this use of Innate Sorcery is active. Once you use this feature to alter Innate Sorcery, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

entries.name: Burning Life Force
entries: Once per turn when you are hit by an attack roll, you can expend a number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|PHB24}, up to a maximum equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Roll the expended dice, et reduce the amount of damage from that attack equal to the total rolled.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|PHB24} of 60 feet et can hover.

entries.name: Spell Avoidance
entries: When you're subjected to a spell or magical effect that allows you to make a saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw et only half damage if you fail. You can't use this benefit if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|PHB24} condition.

subclassFeatures.name: Power of Shadow
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eyes of the Dark
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|PHB24} with a range of 120 feet et {@sense Blindsight|PHB24} with a range of 10 feet. In addition, if a spell you cast creates an area of {@variantrule Darkness|PHB24}, you can see normally through that spell's Darkness.

entries.name: Strength of the Grave
entries: If you would drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} et not die outright, you can make a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken). On a successful save, your {@variantrule Hit Points|PHB24} instead change to a number equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Sorcerer level. After you succeed on this save, you can't use this benefit again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadow Sorcery
entries: {@i Bend Doom et Darkness to Your Will}

Your innate magic comes from the most nebulous et inscrutable forces of the Shadowfell or from other regions of supernatural darkness. You might trace your lineage to an entity from such a place, or perhaps you were exposed to the sinister energy of a shadow dragon et were transformed by it. Your shadowy magic allows you to commet darkness, undeath, et woe.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadow Spells
entries: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Shadow Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Shadow Spells
rows: {@spell Bane|PHB24}, {@spell Darkness|PHB24}, {@spell Inflict Wounds|PHB24}, {@spell Pass Without Trace|PHB24}

subclassFeatures.name: Beasts of Ill Omen
entries: You can call forth a howling creature of shadow to hound your foes. You can spend 3 Sorcery Points to cast {@spell Summon Beast|PHB24} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} without expending a spell slot, without preparing the spell, et without Material components. The summoned creature appears as a beast made of shadow, et enemies within 5 feet of the summoned creature have {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB24} on saving throws against spells you cast.

Whenever you cast the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|PHB24}. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting, et the spell ends early if you cast the spell again.

subclassFeatures.name: Shadow Walk
entries: While you are in {@variantrule Dim Light|PHB24} or {@variantrule Darkness|PHB24}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB24} to teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in {@variantrule Dim Light|PHB24} or {@variantrule Darkness|PHB24}.

subclassFeatures.name: Umbral Form
entries: When you use Innate Sorcery, you can adopt a shadowy form, gaining the benefits below while your Innate Sorcery is active or until you end the form (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|PHB24} unless you spend 6 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: You can move through creatures et objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|PHB24}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object.

entries.name: Shadow Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|PHB24} to all damage except Force et Radiant damage.

classFeatures.name: Druidique
entries: Vous connaissez le druidique, la langue secrète des druides. En apprenant cette langue ancestrale, vous avez également découvert le pouvoir de communiquer avec les animaux ; vous avez toujours le sort {@spell Communication avec les animaux} prêt à l’emploi.

Vous pouvez utiliser la magie druidique pour laisser des messages cachés. Vous et ceux qui la connaissent la détectez automatiquement. Les autres peuvent déceler sa présence en réussissant un jet d'Intelligence ( Investigation ) DD 15, mais ne peuvent le déchiffrer sans magie.

classFeatures.name: Ordre Primal
entries: Vous vous êtes consacré à l'un des rôles sacrés suivants, de votre choix.

entries.name: Magicien
entries: Vous connaissez un sort mineur supplémentaire de la liste de sorts de druide. De plus, votre lien mystique avec la nature vous confère un bonus à vos tests d'Intelligence ( Arcanes ou Nature ). Ce bonus est égal à votre modificateur de Sagesse (bonus minimum de +1).

entries.name: Gardien
entries: Entraîné au combat, vous acquérez la maîtrise des armes martiales et la formation au maniement des armures intermédiaires.

classFeatures.name: Incantation
entries: Vous avez appris à lancer des sorts en étudiant les forces mystiques de la nature. Consultez le chapitre 7 pour connaître les règles de lancement de sorts. Les informations ci-dessous détaillent comment appliquer ces règles aux sorts de druide, qui figurent dans la liste des sorts de druide plus loin dans la description de la classe.

entries.name: Sorts mineurs
entries: Vous connaissez deux sorts mineurs de votre choix parmi la liste des sorts de druide. {@spell Artisanat druidique} et {@spell Production de flammes} sont recommandés.
Chaque fois que vous gagnez un niveau de druide, vous pouvez remplacer l'un de vos sorts mineurs par un autre sort mineur de votre choix dans la liste des sorts de druide.

Lorsque vous atteignez les niveaux 4 et 10 de druide, vous apprenez un autre sort mineur de votre choix dans la liste des sorts de druide, comme indiqué dans la colonne Sorts mineurs du tableau des caractéristiques du druide.

entries.name: Emplacements de sorts
entries: Le tableau des capacités du druide indique le nombre d'emplacements de sorts dont vous disposez pour lancer vos sorts de niveau 1 et plus. Vous récupérez tous vos emplacements dépensés après un repos long.

entries.name: Sorts préparés de niveau 1 et plus
entries: Vous préparez la liste des sorts de niveau 1 et plus que vous pouvez lancer grâce à cette capacité. Pour commencer, choisissez quatre sorts de niveau 1 dans la liste des sorts de druide. {@spell Amitié animale}, {@spell Soins des blessures}, {@spell Feu féerique} et {@spell Onde de choc} sont recommandés.

Le nombre de sorts de votre liste augmente à mesure que vous gagnez des niveaux de druide, comme indiqué dans la colonne « Sorts préparés » du tableau des aptitudes de druide. À chaque augmentation de ce nombre, choisissez des sorts supplémentaires dans la liste de sorts de druide jusqu'à ce que votre liste de sorts corresponde à celle du tableau. Les sorts choisis doivent être d'un niveau pour lequel vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts. Par exemple, si vous êtes un druide de niveau 3, votre liste de sorts préparés peut inclure six sorts de niveaux 1 et 2, dans n'importe quelle combinaison.

Si une autre capacité de druide vous donne des sorts que vous avez toujours préparés, ces sorts ne sont pas comptabilisés dans le nombre de sorts que vous pouvez préparer avec cette capacité, mais ils sont par ailleurs considérés comme des sorts de druide pour vous.

entries.name: Modification de vos sorts préparés
entries: Lorsque vous terminez un repos long, vous pouvez modifier votre liste de sorts préparés, en remplaçant n'importe quel sort par d'autres sorts de druide pour lesquels vous disposez d'emplacements de sorts.

entries.name: Capacité d'incantation
entries: La sagesse est votre caractéristique d'incantation pour vos sorts de druide.

entries.name: Focalisation pour les sorts
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser une focalisation druidique comme focalisation pour vos sorts de druide.

classFeatures.name: Compagnon sauvage
entries: Vous pouvez invoquer un esprit de la nature qui prend forme animale pour vous aider. Par une action magique, vous pouvez dépenser un emplacement de sort ou une utilisation de Forme sauvage pour lancer le sort {@spell find familiar} sans composantes matérielles.
Lorsque vous lancez le sort de cette manière, le familier est féerique et disparaît lorsque vous terminez un repos long.

classFeatures.name: Forme sauvage
entries: Le pouvoir de la nature vous permet de prendre la forme d'un animal. Par une action bonus, vous vous métamorphosez en une forme animale que vous avez apprise pour cette capacité (voir « Formes connues » ci-dessous). Vous conservez cette forme pendant un nombre d'heures égal à la moitié de votre niveau de druide, ou jusqu'à ce que vous utilisiez à nouveau Forme sauvage, que vous soyez incapable d'agir ou que vous mouriez. Vous pouvez également quitter cette forme prématurément par une action bonus.

entries.name: Nombre d'utilisations
entries: Vous pouvez utiliser Forme sauvage deux fois. Vous récupérez une utilisation dépensée après un repos court et toutes vos utilisations dépensées après un repos long.
Vous obtenez des utilisations supplémentaires lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux de druide, comme indiqué dans la colonne Forme sauvage du tableau des caractéristiques du druide.

entries.name: Formes connues
entries: Vous connaissez quatre formes de bête pour cette capacité, choisies parmi les profils de bêtes ayant un facteur puissance maximal de 1/4 et ne possédant pas la capacité de voler (voir l'annexe B pour les profils de bêtes disponibles). Le rat, le cheval, l'araignée et le loup sont recommandés. Après chaque repos long, vous pouvez remplacer l'une de vos formes connues par une autre forme admissible.

Lorsque vous atteignez certains niveaux de druide, le nombre de formes connues et le niveau de facteur puissance de ces formes augmentent, comme indiqué dans le tableau des formes animales. De plus, à partir du niveau 8, vous pouvez adopter une forme dotée d'une vitesse de vol.
Lors du choix des formes connues, vous pouvez consulter le Manuel des Monstres ou d'autres sources pour trouver des Bêtes éligibles, si le Maître du Donjon vous y autorise.

entries.name: Règles applicables sous forme métamorphe
entries: Sous une autre forme, vous conservez votre personnalité, vos souvenirs et votre capacité à parler, et les règles suivantes s'appliquent :

entries.name: Points de vie temporaires
entries: Lorsque vous prenez une forme animale, vous gagnez un nombre de points de vie temporaires égal à votre niveau de druide.

entries.name: Statistiques de jeu
entries: Vos statistiques de jeu sont remplacées par celles de la Bête, mais vous conservez votre type de créature ; vos points de vie ; vos dés de points de vie ; vos scores d’Intelligence, de Sagesse et de Charisme ; vos aptitudes de classe ; vos langues ; et vos dons. Vous conservez également vos maîtrises de compétences et de jets de sauvegarde et utilisez votre bonus de maîtrise pour celles-ci, en plus d’acquérir les maîtrises de la créature. Si un modificateur de compétence ou de jet de sauvegarde dans les statistiques de la Bête est supérieur au vôtre, utilisez celui des statistiques de la Bête.

entries.name: Impossible de lancer des sorts
entries: Vous ne pouvez pas lancer de sorts, mais la métamorphose ne rompt pas votre concentration et n'interfère pas avec un sort que vous avez déjà lancé.

entries.name: Objets
entries: Votre capacité à manipuler des objets est déterminée par les membres de votre nouvelle forme, et non par les vôtres. De plus, vous choisissez si votre équipement tombe dans votre espace, fusionne avec votre nouvelle forme ou est porté par elle. L'équipement porté fonctionne normalement, mais le MJ décide s'il est pratique pour la nouvelle forme de porter un objet, en fonction de sa taille et de sa morphologie. Votre équipement ne change ni de taille ni de forme pour s'adapter à la nouvelle forme, et tout équipement que celle-ci ne peut pas porter doit soit tomber au sol, soit fusionner avec elle. L'équipement qui fusionne avec la forme est sans effet lorsque vous êtes sous cette forme.

classFeatures.name: Sous-classe de Druide
entries: Vous obtenez une sous-classe de druide de votre choix. Une sous-classe est une spécialisation qui vous octroie des capacités à certains niveaux de druide. Pour le reste de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de toutes les capacités de votre sous-classe correspondant à votre niveau de druide ou à un niveau inférieur.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition. Vous recevez de nouveau cette aptitude aux niveau de Druide 8, 12, et 16.

classFeatures.name: Résurgence sauvage
entries: Une fois par tour, s'il ne vous reste plus d'utilisations de Forme Sauvage, vous pouvez vous en octroyer une en dépensant un emplacement de sort (aucune action requise).

De plus, vous pouvez dépenser une utilisation de Forme sauvage (aucune action requise) pour vous donner un emplacement de sort de niveau 1, mais vous ne pouvez pas le faire à nouveau avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Druide.

classFeatures.name: Fureur élémentaire
entries: La puissance des éléments vous traverse. Vous obtenez l'une des options suivantes, à votre choix.

entries.name: Incantation puissante
entries: Ajoutez votre modificateur de Sagesse aux dégâts infligés par n'importe quel sort mineur de druide.

entries.name: Frappe primordiale
entries: Une fois par tour, lorsque vous touchez une créature avec un jet d'attaque utilisant une arme ou une attaque de forme bestiale en Forme sauvage, vous pouvez infliger à la cible 1d8 dégâts supplémentaires de Froid, de Feu, de Foudre ou de Tonnerre (à choisir au moment de l'impact).

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Druide.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Capacité de sous-classe
entries: Vous gagnez une aptitude de votre sous-classe de Druide.

classFeatures.name: Fureur élémentaire améliorée
entries: The option you chose for Elemental Fury grows more powerful, as detailed below.

entries.name: Incantation puissante
entries: Lorsque vous lancez un sort mineur de druide d'une portée de 3 mètres ou plus, la portée du sort augmente de 90 mètres.

entries.name: Frappe primordiale
entries: Les dégâts supplémentaires de votre Frappe primale passent à 2d8.

classFeatures.name: Amélioration de caractéristique
entries: Vous recevez le don {@feat Amélioration de caractéristique|PHB24} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html} de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les condition.

classFeatures.name: Sorts de bêtes
entries: Lorsque vous utilisez la Forme Sauvage, vous pouvez lancer des sorts sous forme de bête, à l'exception des sorts qui possèdent une composante matérielle avec un coût spécifié ou qui consomment leur composante matérielle.

classFeatures.name: Bénédiction épique
entries: Vous obtenez un don de  {@filter Don épique feat|feats|category=EB} ou un autre {@5etools don|feats.html}de votre choix pour lequel vous remplissez les conditions requises. Le {@feat Don de Voyage Dimensionnel|PHB24} de sorts est recommandé.

classFeatures.name: Archidruide
entries: La vitalité de la nature s'épanouit constamment en vous, vous offrant les bienfaits suivants.

entries.name: Forme sauvage persistante
entries: Lorsque vous lancez l'initiative et qu'il ne vous reste plus aucune utilisation de Forme sauvage, vous récupérez une utilisation dépensée.

entries.name: Magicien de la nature
entries: Vous pouvez convertir des utilisations de Forme sauvage en un emplacement de sort (aucune action requise). Choisissez un certain nombre de vos utilisations non dépensées de Forme sauvage et convertissez-les en un seul emplacement de sort, chaque utilisation contribuant à hauteur de 2 niveaux de sort. Par exemple, si vous convertissez deux utilisations de Forme sauvage, vous obtenez un emplacement de sort de niveau 4. Une fois cet avantage utilisé, vous ne pouvez plus l'utiliser avant d'avoir terminé un repos long.

entries.name: Longévité
entries: La magie primordiale que vous utilisez vous permet de vieillir plus lentement. Pour dix ans, votre corps ne vieillit que d'un an.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle of the Let
entries: The Circle of the Let is made up of mystics et sages who safeguard ancient knowledge et rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or steting stones to whisper primal secrets in {@language Druidic}. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith et serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the let where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.

subclassFeatures.name: Bonus Cantrip
entries: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice. This cantrip doesn't count against the number of druid cantrips you know.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle Spells
entries: Your mystical connection to the let infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, et 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the let where you became a druid. Choose that let—arctic, coast, desert, forest, grasslet, mountain, swamp, or Underdark—et consult the associated list of spells.

Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, et it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

entries.caption: Arctic
rows: {@spell commune with nature}, {@spell cone of cold}

entries.caption: Desert
rows: {@spell create food et water}, {@spell protection from energy}

subclassFeatures.name: Natural Recovery
entries: Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation et communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), et none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to two levels worth of spell slots. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

subclassFeatures.name: Let's Stride
entries: Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical {@quickref difficult terrain||3} costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them et without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such as those created by the {@spell entangle} spell.

subclassFeatures.name: Nature's Ward
entries: When you reach 10th level, you can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} by elementals or fey, et you are immune to poison et disease.

subclassFeatures.name: Nature's Sanctuary
entries: When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature et become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle of the Moon
entries: Druides of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the wilds. Their order gathers under the full moon to share news et trade warnings. They haunt the deepest parts of the wilderness, where they might go for weeks on end before crossing paths with another humanoid creature, let alone another druid.

Changeable as the moon, a druid of this circle might prowl as a great cat one night, soar over the treetops as an eagle the next day, et crash through the undergrowth in bear form to drive off a trespassing monster. The wild is in the druid's blood.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle Forms
entries: The rites of your circle grant you the ability to transform into more dangerous animal forms. Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Wild Shape to transform into a {@filter beast with a challenge rating as high as 1|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1]|type=beast|speed type=!fly;!swim|miscellaneous=!swarm} (you ignore the Max. CR column of the Beast Shapes table, but must abide by the other limitations there).
Starting at 6th level, you can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as your druid level divided by 3, rounded down.

entries.caption: Circle of the Moon Beast Shapes

subclassFeatures.name: Combat Wild Shape
entries: You gain the ability to use Wild Shape on your turn as a bonus action, rather than as an action.
Additionally, while you are transformed by Wild Shape, you can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot to regain {@dice 1d8} hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

subclassFeatures.name: Primal Strike
entries: Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance et immunity to nonmagical attacks et damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Elemental Wild Shape
entries: At 10th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape at the same time to transform into an {@creature air elemental}, an {@creature earth elemental}, a {@creature fire elemental}, or a {@creature water elemental}.

subclassFeatures.name: Thouset Forms
entries: By 14th level, you have learned to use magic to alter your physical form in more subtle ways. You can cast the {@spell alter self} spell at will.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle of Dreams
entries: Druides who are members of the Circle of Dreams hail from regions that have strong ties to the Feywild et its dreamlike realms. The druids' guardianship of the natural world makes for a natural alliance between them et good-aligned fey. These druids seek to fill the world with dreamy wonder. Their magic mends wounds et brings joy to downcast hearts, et the realms they protect are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream et reality blur together et where the weary can find rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Balm of the Summer Court
entries: At 2nd level, you become imbued with the blessings of the Summer Court. You are a font of energy that offers respite from injuries. You have a pool of fey energy represented by a number of {@dice d6}s equal to your druid level.

As a bonus action, you can choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you et spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. Roll the spent dice et add them together. The target regains a number of hit points equal to the total. The target also gains 1 temporary hit point per die spent.
You regain all expended dice when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Hearth of Moonlight et Shadow
entries: At 6th level, home can be wherever you are. During a short or long rest, you can invoke the shadowy power of the Gloaming Court to help guard your respite. At the start of the rest, you touch a point in space, et an invisible, 30-foot-radius sphere of magic appears, centered on that point. {@quickref Cover||3||Total cover} blocks the sphere.

While within the sphere, you et your allies gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) et Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks, et any light from open flames in the sphere (a campfire, torches, or the like) isn't visible outside it.
The sphere vanishes at the end of the rest or when you leave the sphere.

subclassFeatures.name: Hidden Paths
entries: Starting at 10th level, you can use the hidden, magical pathways that some fey use to traverse space in the blink of an eye. As a bonus action on your turn, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, you can use your action to teleport one willing creature you touch up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Walker in Dreams
entries: At 14th level, the magic of the Feywild grants you the ability to travel mentally or physically through dreamlets.

When you finish a short rest, you can cast one of the following spells, without expending a spell slot or requiring material components: {@spell dream} (with you as the messenger), {@spell scrying}, or {@spell teleportation circle}.

This use of {@spell teleportation circle} is special. Rather than opening a portal to a permanent {@spell teleportation circle}, it opens a portal to the last location where you finished a long rest on your current plane of existence. If you haven't taken a long rest on your current plane, the spell fails but isn't wasted.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle of the Shepherd
entries: Druides of the Circle of the Shepherd commune with the spirits of nature, especially the spirits of beasts et the fey, et call to those spirits for aid. These druids recognize that all living things play a role in the natural world, yet they focus on protecting animals et fey creatures that have difficulty defending themselves. Shepherds, as they are known, see such creatures as their charges. They ward off monsters that threaten them, rebuke hunters who kill more prey than necessary, et prevent civilization from encroaching on rare animal habitats et on sites sacred to the fey. Many of these druids are happiest far from cities et towns, content to spend their days in the company of animals et the fey creatures of the wilds.

Members of this circle become adventurers to oppose forces that threaten their charges or to seek knowledge et power that will help them safeguard their charges better. Wherever these druids go, the spirits of the wilderness are with them.

subclassFeatures.name: Speech of the Woods
entries: At 2nd level, you gain the ability to converse with beasts et many fey.

You learn to speak, read, et write {@language Sylvan}. In addition, beasts can understet your speech, et you gain the ability to decipher their noises et motions. Most beasts lack the intelligence to convey or understet sophisticated concepts, but a friendly beast could relay what it has seen or heard in the recent past. This ability doesn't grant you friendship with beasts, though you can combine this ability with gifts to curry favor with them as you would with any nonplayer character.

subclassFeatures.name: Spirit Totem
entries: Starting at 2nd level, you can call forth nature spirits to influence the world around you. As a bonus action, you can magically summon an incorporeal spirit to a point you can see within 60 feet of you. The spirit creates an aura in a 30-foot radius around that point. It counts as neither a creature nor an object, though it has the spectral appearance of the creature it represents.
As a bonus action, you can move the spirit up to 60 feet to a point you can see.
The spirit persists for 1 minute or until you're {@condition incapacitated}. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
The effect of the spirit's aura depends on the type of spirit you summon from the options below.

entries.name: Bear Spirit
entries: The bear spirit grants you et your allies its might et endurance. Each creature of your choice in the aura when the spirit appears gains temporary hit points equal to 5 + your druid level. In addition, you et your allies gain advantage on Strength checks et Strength saving throws while in the aura.

entries.name: Hawk Spirit
entries: The hawk spirit is a consummate hunter, aiding you et your allies with its keen sight. When a creature makes an attack roll against a target in the spirit's aura, you can use your reaction to grant advantage to that attack roll. In addition, you et your allies have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks while in the aura.

entries.name: Unicorn Spirit
entries: The unicorn spirit lends its protection to those nearby. You et your allies gain advantage on all ability checks made to detect creatures in the spirit's aura. In addition, if you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores hit points to any creature inside or outside the aura, each creature of your choice in the aura also regains hit points equal to your druid level.

subclassFeatures.name: Mighty Summoner
entries: Starting at 6th level, beasts et fey that you conjure are more resilient than normal. Any beast or fey summoned or created by a spell that you cast gains the following benefits:

items: The creature appears with more hit points than normal: 2 extra hit points per Hit Die it has.
The damage from its natural weapons is considered magical for the purpose of overcoming immunity et resistance to nonmagical attacks et damage.

subclassFeatures.name: Guardian Spirit
entries: Beginning at 10th level, your Spirit Totem safeguards the beasts et fey that you call forth with your magic. When a beast or fey that you summoned or created with a spell ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, that creature regains a number of hit points equal to half your druid level.

subclassFeatures.name: Faithful Summons
entries: Starting at 14th level, the nature spirits you commune with protect you when you are the most defenseless. If you are reduced to 0 hit points or are {@condition incapacitated} against your will, you can immediately gain the benefits of {@spell conjure animals} as if it were cast using a 9th-level spell slot. It summons four beasts of your choice that are challenge rating 2 or lower. The conjured beasts appear within 20 feet of you. If they receive no commets from you, they protect you from harm et attack your foes. The spell lasts for 1 hour, requiring no {@status concentration}, or until you dismiss it (no action required).
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle of Spores
entries: Druides of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay. They see within mold et other fungi the ability to transform lifeless material into abundant, albeit somewhat strange, life.

These druids believe that life et death are parts of a gret cycle, with one leading to the other et then back again. Death isn't the end of life, but instead a change of state that sees life shift into a new form.

Druides of this circle have a complex relationship with the undead. Unlike most other druids, they see nothing inherently wrong with undeath, which they consider to be a companion to life et death. But these druids believe that the natural cycle is healthiest when each segment of it is vibrant et changing. Undead that seek to replace all life with undeath, or that try to avoid passing to a final rest, violate the cycle et must be thwarted.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle Spells
entries: Your symbiotic link to fungus et your ability to tap into the cycle of life et death grants you access to certain spells. At 2nd level, you learn the {@spell chill touch} cantrip. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, et 9th level you gain access to the spells listed for that level in the Circle of Spores Spells table.

Once you gain access to one of these spells, you always have it prepared, et it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

subclassFeatures.name: Halo of Spores
entries: Starting at 2nd level, you are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores that are harmless until you unleash them on a creature nearby. When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage to that creature unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. The necrotic damage increases to {@damage 1d6} at 6th level, {@damage 1d8} at 10th level, et {@damage 1d10} at 14th level.

subclassFeatures.name: Symbiotic Entity
entries: At 2nd level, you gain the ability to channel magic into your spores. As an action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to awaken those spores, rather than transforming into a beast form, et you gain 4 temporary hit points for each level you have in this class. While this feature is active, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you deal your Halo of Spores damage, roll the damage die a second time et add it to the total.
Your melee weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage to any target they hit.

entries: These benefits last for 10 minutes, until you lose all these temporary hit points, or until you use your Wild Shape again.

subclassFeatures.name: Fungal Infestation
entries: At 6th level, your spores gain the ability to infest a corpse et animate it. If a beast or a humanoid that is Small or Medium dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to animate it, causing it to stet up immediately with 1 hit point. The creature uses the {@creature zombie} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}. It remains animate for 1 hour, after which time it collapses et dies.
In combat, the zombie's turn comes immediately after yours. It obeys your mental commets, et the only action it can take is the {@action Attack} action, making one melee attack.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), et you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Spreading Spores
entries: At 10th level, you gain the ability to seed an area with deadly spores. As a bonus action while your Symbiotic Entity feature is active, you can hurl spores up to 30 feet away, where they swirl in a 10-foot cube for 1 minute. The spores disappear early if you use this feature again, if you dismiss them as a bonus action, or if your Symbiotic Entity feature is no longer active.

Whenever a creature moves into the cube or starts its turn there, that creature takes your Halo of Spores damage, unless the creature succeeds on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. A creature can take this damage no more than once per turn.
While the cube of spores persists, you can't use your Halo of Spores reaction.

subclassFeatures.name: Fungal Body
entries: At 14th level, the fungal spores in your body alter you: you can't be {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition poisoned}, et any critical hit against you counts as a normal hit instead, unless you're {@condition incapacitated}.

subclassFeatures.name: Circle of Stars
entries: The Circle of Stars allows druids to draw on the power of starlight. These druids have tracked heavenly patterns since time immemorial, discovering secrets hidden amid the constellations. By revealing et understeting these secrets, the Circle of the Stars seeks to harness the powers of the cosmos.

Many druids of this circle keep records of the constellations et the stars' effects on the world. Some groups document these observations at megalithic sites, which serve as enigmatic libraries of lore. These repositories might take the form of stone circles, pyramids, petroglyphs, et underground temples-any construction durable enough to protect the circle's sacred knowledge even against a great cataclysm.

subclassFeatures.name: Star Map
entries: {@i 2nd-level Circle of the Stars feature}

You've created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. It is a Tiny object et can serve as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells. You determine its form by rolling on the Star Map table or by choosing one.

entries.caption: Star Map
rows: A scroll covered with depictions of constellations
A stone tablet with fine holes drilled through it
A speckled owlbear hide, tooled with raised marks
A collection of maps bound in an ebony cover
A crystal that projects starry patterns when placed before a light

entries: While holding this map, you have these benefits:

items: You know the {@spell guidance} cantrip.
You have the {@spell guiding bolt} spell prepared. It counts as a druid spell for you, et it doesn't count against the number of spells you can have prepared.
You can cast {@spell guiding bolt} without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, et you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries: If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to magically create a replacement. This ceremony can be performed during a short or long rest, et it destroys the previous map.

subclassFeatures.name: Starry Form
entries: {@i 2nd-level Circle of the Stars feature}
As a bonus action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form, rather than transforming into a beast.
